jobs.title: Motor Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Design Engineering Lead is responsible for the design, construction, and maintenance of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, equipment testing, and maintenance procedures. The role may also involve recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. 设置该岗位的目的:

Purpose of the Job:
-

主要任务与职责:
- 负责高速永磁电机和潜水异步电机的本地化开发与优化，包括结构强度设计、参数计算与性能分析。
- 参与本地化电机相关技术方案的指定与评审，确保设计方案的可行性和先进性
- 负责电机样机的试制、测试及问题分析，提出改进措施并优化产品性能
- 协助解决电机生产过程中出现的技术问题，提供技术支持和改进指导
- 跟踪行业技术发展趋势，参与新技术、新工艺的研究与应用
- 编写相关技术文档，包括设计说明书、测试报告及专利申请

Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Responsible for the localization development and optimization of high-speed permanent magnet motors and submersible asynchronous motors, including structural strength design, parameter calculation, and performance analysis.
- Participate in the specification and review of technical solutions related to localized motors, ensuring the feasibility and advancement of design plans.
- Responsible for prototyping, testing, and problem analysis of motors, proposing improvements, and optimizing product performance.
- Assist in resolving technical issues during motor production, providing technical support and guidance for improvement.
- Track industry technology development trends and participate in the research and application of new technologies and processes.
- Prepare related technical documents, including design specifications, test reports, and patent applications.

职位要求：
· 具备扎实电机理论和控制理论基础，熟悉电磁分析软件、机械设计软件和相关标准
· 熟悉电机设计和制造工艺
· 熟悉永磁同步电机、异步电机等常用电机的工作原理
· 具备较好的语言表达、沟通协调、团队协助能力，具备敬业精神及良好的职业道德
· 电子电气相关专业本科及以上学历，3年以上电机设计或制造、控制相关工作经验；
· 展示在满足客户需求方面的响应能力和及时性；
· 有效平衡多项优先事项和相互竞争的需求；
· 保护机密信息；
· 以高度诚信行事；
· 需要具备英语口语和书写能力。

Qualifications:

· Solid foundation in motor theory and control theory, familiar with electromagnetic analysis software, mechanical design software, and relevant standards.
· Familiar with motor design and manufacturing processes.
· Familiar with the working principles of commonly used motors such as permanent magnet synchronous motors and asynchronous motors.
· Good verbal communication, coordination, and teamwork skills, with a professional attitude and strong work ethics.
· Bachelor's degree or higher in electronics or electrical engineering, with more than 3 years of experience in motor design, manufacturing, or control-related work.
· Demonstrate responsiveness and promptness in serving customer needs;
· Balance many priorities and competing demands effectively;
· Protect confidential information;
· Act with a high level of integrity;
· English language ability, oral and writing are required.

What we offer you

• 10~15 days’ annual leave and 5 days’ sick leave

• Long Service Award

• Annual Physical Examination

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance

• Team Building

• Festival Gifts

• Good working atmosphere and personal development opportunity

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer has a long, proud history of engineering excellence and we’re now expanding our reach even further. We’re looking for an experienced Large Machine Specialist to help shape the next chapter of our international growth.

If you're driven by complex technical challenges, thrive in front of customers, and want to influence major industrial projects across global markets, this could be your ideal move.
What You’ll Do

• Drive order intake by supporting our regional sales teams and turning high‑value opportunities into delivered projects.

• Act as the technical authority on large machines (690V and above), advising customers and internal teams alike.

• Visit key accounts across the UK and overseas, strengthening relationships and positioning Sulzer as the supplier of choice.

• Co‑develop account strategies, opportunity pipelines, and tailored solutions alongside Sales and Key Account Managers.

• Provide expert input into RFI/RFP proposals, ensuring we offer the most robust and commercially sound solutions.

• Keep the pipeline flowing through Salesforce, ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and project visibility.

• Build strong networks with engineering, purchasing, and project stakeholders — from first conversation to successful delivery.

This is a role where your know‑how genuinely makes the difference

What You Bring

We’re looking for someone who can combine technical expertise with commercial instinct:

• Proven experience working with large motors or rotating equipment.

• A track record of developing opportunities into successful orders.

• Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder‑management skills.

• Confidence in customer‑facing situations and a talent for building trust.

• Solid understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce experience is a bonus).

• A flexible, self‑driven approach and the willingness to travel internationally.

Why This Role Matters

Large machines are a cornerstone of our service offering — and the demand is expanding beyond UK borders. This role gives you the platform to:

• Directly shape Sulzer’s international growth.

• Strengthen customer relationships in new global markets.

• Bring new ideas, technical solutions, and account strategies to life.

• Play a vital part in the continued development of a high‑value service line.

You'll be stepping into a well‑established capability, with the opportunity to take it further than ever before.

What we offer you

• Highly autonomous, home‑based role with full ownership of your schedule and the freedom to manage your own diary.

• Competitive base salary with an annual performance‑related bonus (including accelerators).

• Choice of a company car or car allowance.

• Aviva Private Medical Insurance (individual cover) plus a comprehensive benefits package.

• Global travel and the opportunity to work on major, high‑profile industrial projects.

• Significant autonomy, technical influence, and real visibility within the organisation.

• Join a supportive, expert team within a globally recognised engineering leader.

• Strong prospects for career progression, with a role that carries long‑term importance and strategic impact.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Assistant is responsible for supporting project teams by performing administrative and coordination tasks, including updating schedules, tracking resources, and assisting with documentation.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Field Service Coordinator .

In this role you will be accountable for:
• Preparing, coordinating and supporting execution of Field Service activities in collaboration with project team
• Analyzing requests from both internal and external stakeholders/customers
• Updating the manpower plan/project information for the Field Service projects in ERP and tracking costs during the projects
• Generating purchase requisitions for the Field Service projects
• Consulting with subcontractors and suppliers with regard to project preparation, delivery times and consumables procurement
• Managing and maintaining inventory of Field Service tool containers & special tools
• Organizing all travel related topics for the Field Service team
• Carrying out cost calculations and close out costings within the scope of concluded agreements
To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A vocational degree as a Technician
• 5 + years of experience in the field of rotating equipment
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

What we offer you

Sulzer offers an excellent package of benefits (CAO Metalektro), including:
• A more than competitive salary
• A generous number of holidays (40)
• A solid pension scheme
• Training opportunities

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Logistiek medewerker (BBL opleiding)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Kom werken bij het Sulzer Turbo Services, onderdeel van Sulzer Services, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde onafhankelijke aanbieders van reparatie, revisie en onderhoud binnen de turbine-industrie. Vanuit Venlo (Lomm) of op locatie, bieden wij onze klanten wereldwijd solide, klantgerichte en flexibele ondersteuning voor hun compressoren, stoom- en gasturbines. Sluit je aan bij onze trotse en hoogopgeleide internationale crew als Logistiek medewerker (BBL opleiding). Vind je het leuk om te werken en leren binnen een internationaal opererend bedrijf waar alle facetten van logistiek aanbod komen, zoals warehousing, import en export werkzaamheden, dan ben je bij ons op de juiste plaats.

Door mee te werken in de operatie leer je als logistiek medewerker alle facetten van het logistieke proces kennen. Door vanuit de verschillende werkzaamheden (opslag, import en export) mee te werken, krijg je een compleet beeld van de gehele logistieke keten. Je werkt 4 dagen per week op onze locatie in Lomm en 1 dag per week ga je naar school.

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Het in ontvangst nemen van goederen, het laden en lossen van toegeleverde goederen, het uitpakken, sorteren en labelen van goederen
• Het verwerken van binnenkomsten, uitgiftes en terugboekingen van goederen in het systeem
• Het opbergen van goederen in stellingen in diversen magazijnen
• Het voorbereiden en gereedmaken voor verzending van goederen
• Het graveren van onderdelen met behulp van een automatische graveermachine
• Het vervoeren van goederen van en naar in- en uitplaatsen met behulp van de aanwezige transportmiddelen op een zo efficiënt mogelijke wijze (intern transport)
• Het uitgeven van goederen aan de hand van werkopdrachten, uitgifte- en materiaalbonnen

Om in deze functie te slagen, moet je:
• Een proactieve houding hebben en leergierig zijn
• Teamplayer zijn die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische wereld en graag het werk van een logistiek medewerker wilt leren
• Flexibel zijn en open houding hebben
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands hebben
• Het leuk vinden om te leren werken binnen een internationaal opererend bedrijf

What we offer you

Lid zijn van een compacte lokale logistiek team binnen een multinationale matrixorganisatie
• Flexibele werktijden
• Opleidingsmogelijkheden
• Bedrijfsrestaurant op de vestiging met lekkere en gezonde opties

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Summary
Hands-on technician in the disassembly, inspection, assembly, and testing of gas turbine engines, subassemblies, components, and accessories.

Responsibilities

• Work independently and with team members to disassemble, inspect, conduct minor repairs, assemble, and modify gas turbine engines, turbines, accessories, and support systems.

• Read and interpret work instructions and inspection manuals to determine material compliance. Record findings in project logs and submit to next department.

• Use calibrated measuring equipment such as calipers, micrometers, etc.

• Adhere to detailed work instructions and procedures assigned by the supervisor and monitored by a quality inspector.

• Acquire personal tools and hardware to perform the work. Specialized tools provided by Sulzer.

• Operate instrumentation to perform pressure and flow tests.

• Review all phases of tasks, as specified by work instructions, perform self-inspection or peer inspection of critical processes ensuring adherence to quality standards.

• Inspect, operate, and maintain shop equipment, facilities, and support systems.

• Package engines for shipment to the customer.

• Complete any other tasks within the company to support objectives and to develop individual skills.

• Foster a positive working environment and relationships with colleagues.

• Perform all tasks at the highest level of safety awareness.

• Properly utilize provided PPE at all times.

• Properly utilize lifting and rigging fixtures and tooling.

• Occasional travel may be required. 1-2 weeks a year in variable weather conditions.

• Able to work in high noise level conditions utilizing proper PPE.

• Able to lift 60lbs.

• Able to maintain certification to operate powered industrial vehicles (forklifts, etc.).

This is a 1st shift hourly position; 7:30–4:00 with expectation to work significant overtime.

Requirements

• High School Diploma or GED

• Up to 3 months of hands-on jet engine or diesel mechanic experience

Preferred Qualifications

• 1+ year experience in Diesel or Gas Turbine Engine Repair

• Formal training in power plant mechanics and operation

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Outside Sales
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Key Responsibilities:

• Conducts Sales visits to customers in assigned market

• Reviews the customer request for quotation (RFQ’s) to ensure necessary information is available and that the customer’s requirements conform to the company’s capabilities.

• Responsible for representing Sulzer during the commercial portion of the proposal.

• Determines and recommends the pricing to be included in the quotation to the customer, within established guidelines.

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and to participate in project initiation.

• Presents the proposal/quotation to the customer, including equipment description and specification, pricing, and delivery schedule, and reviews and negotiates necessary revisions with the customer.

• Responds and assists to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance .

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in one of the following engineering disciplines: Chemical / Industrial / Process / Physics

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience with water or water related industries

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in sales/business development

• Ability to interpret customer requirements and to communicate to appropriate personnel

• Analytical capability as required in reviewing, assessing, and interpreting customer requirements and developing responsive design specifications and parameters.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Key Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with strategically important clients. This role involves developing account plans, identifying sales opportunities, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality service. The Key Account Manager acts as the main point of contact for key clients and works to ensure their satisfaction and loyalty.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large organization.

Key
• Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients.
Develop and execute strategic account plans.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions.
Monitor account performance and customer satisfaction.
Prepare reports on account status and market trends.
Resolve client issues and ensure timely delivery of services.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Proven experience in account management or sales.
Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities.
Proficiency in CRM software.
Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida.
Vale alimentação e refeição no local.
Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass.
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
Previdência privada.

jobs.title: Field Service & Repair Technician

titleByLocale.it: Servizio di campo e riparazione tecnico

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Rattaché(e) au head of projects new business, au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, vous serez amené(e) à travailler en atelier et sur sites clients, sur des machines tournantes, dans le secteur industriel.

Sur ce poste, vous serez responsable de:

• Interventions de démontage, expertise et remontage des machines tournantes industrielles standards et spécifiques dans le respect des cahiers des charges

• Réalisation du diagnostic et rédaction des rapports d'expertise

• Réalisation des réparations de pièces et du contrôle des pièces réparées,

• Remontage des machines, réglage/ajustage

• Commissioning / Pre-commissioning / mise en service de machines tournantes

• Réparations sur site

• Respect de la politique de qualité, sécurité et environnement en interne et sur sites clients

• Participation à la mise en place d'actions d'amélioration continue

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin de:

• Formation Bac + 2 en mécanique ou équivalent, vous possédez 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire en envrionnement industriel

• Compétences en lecture de plan et en dessin industriel

• Connaissances en ajustage, montage, pivoterie, étanchéité, contrôle dimensionnel, géométrique et calcul de chaînes de côtes

• Maitrise des outils office 365

• Rigueur, méthodes et polyvalence

Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ?
Contactez Rick IMALET POGO à Rick.Imaletpogo@sulzer.com et nous serons heureux de vous répondre!

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Opportunité de travailler au sein d’une organisation locale de services d’un leader international sur son marché

• Avantage 2 : Des missions variées vous permettant d’avoir un impact réel et de développer vos compétences

• Avantage 3 : Rejoindre un site en pleine croissance et contribuer à son évolution

• Avantage 4 : Un package d’avantages attractifs conformément à notre politique de rémunération locale

jobs.title: SJR96219 Técnico Mecânico
jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Perform maintenance and technical support on installed products and equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve malfunctions.
Determine when products should be upgraded or replaced.
Provide onsite training for customer support personnel.
Follow standard procedures and safety protocols.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic technical and diagnostic skills.
Ability to follow procedures and instructions.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Willingness to work in field environments.

jobs.title: Chef de Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Engineer is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes coaching junior professionals and solving complex problems through investigation and analysis.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
Votre mission principale :

• Incarner le lien et piloter les interlocuteurs internes et externes en vue de la livraison du contrat / projet sur les activités pièces de rechange / retrofit / projets neufs.

• Mener le projet à son terme en satisfaisant le client (coût, qualité et délai) et en optimisant le résultat financier pour Sulzer (revenu, marge et cash).

Le chef de projet confirmé intervient sur les projets à forts enjeux et complexes dans l’entreprise

Activités significatives

• Organiser et superviser les réunions de revue de contrat (handover), d'enclenchement et de suivi en interne (KOM), en intégrant et pilotant l’ensemble des compétences transversales nécessaires à l’accomplissement du projet.

• Procéder, dès les phases initiales et en cours de réalisation, aux analyses de risque des projets, à leurs mises à jour nécessaires ; définir et piloter les plans d’actions correctives et préventives correspondants

• Assurer la communication régulière vers les clients (réunion d’enclenchement, réunion de suivi, reporting…), en maintenant le bon niveau de coopération par un relationnel adapté.

• Créer et maintenir des plannings projets (MS Project), outil principal de pilotage des projets.

• Piloter et coordonner les activités & les équipes en interne, en conformité avec le planning des projets, en assurant notamment la collaboration et les interfaces entre le BE, la Gestion production, les Achats, la Production, la Qualité, la force de vente et le Tendering.

• Créer et maintenir les indicateurs clé (fiabilité des engagements, documentation…) au niveau de chaque projet en charge.

• Obtenir les validations documentaires (technique, qualité, approvisionnement) en lien avec les clients et les fournisseurs.

• Etablir les prévisions de facturation, marge et cash-flow au niveau de chaque projet géré.

• Favoriser la négociation de modification de commande (« change order ») avec le client pour améliorer les conditions contractuelles du contrat initial, le revenu et la marge du projet.

• Documenter le projet sur toute sa durée pour prévenir tout cas de litige.

• Déployer et formaliser le retour d’expérience sur l’activité projet.

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en mécanique (culture technique mécanique), acquises via une formation d’ingénieur et une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement mécanique

jobs.title: Supervisor(a) Técnico de Turbomáquinas
Analista de Aplicação
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

O Analista de Aplicação é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de vendas e realizar análise técnica das configurações dos produtos para determinar preços específicos do cliente.
Este perfil de emprego destina-se a profissionais experientes que aplicam conhecimento prático de uma área de trabalho e trabalham de forma independente com supervisão geral. Principais Responsabilidades:
Responsável por preparar e enviar propostas comerciais de serviços (Sulzer Pumps, bombas não-Sulzer e turbomáquinas) recebidas pela Salesforce e outras entidades legais da Sulzer, garantindo a entrega no prazo;
• Responsável por definir o escopo do trabalho conforme o relatório de inspeção e as especificações técnicas;
• Alinhar o escopo do serviço e o orçamento com os fornecedores;
• Criação da base de custo para a proposta;
• Preparar a proposta e inserir pedidos no SAP.

Habilidades Necessárias:
• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica;
• Experiência no departamento comercial (equipamentos rotativos como bombas, compressores, motores, etc.) atendendo indústrias pesadas;
• Conhecimento técnico em bombas e/ou equipamentos rotativos
• Inglês Intermediário

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Vale alimentação, refeição no local e transporte público/fretado
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Previdência privada
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: FP&A Controller - D365
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic FP&A Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international stakeholders, leverage your expertise in finance analytics, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you!

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial goals.

• Periodically refresh and update predictive financial forecasts to reflect the latest business trends and market conditions.

• Conduct thorough profitability and performance reporting, identifying key financial metrics.

• Perform detailed plan analytics and risk assessments, continuously improving financial planning and analysis processes.

• Provide recommendations to the business based on in-depth financial analysis, supporting strategic decision-making.

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making processes.

• Deliver comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions.

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity.

• Handle period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects.

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting.

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and maintain strong internal controls for the processes performed by this role.

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations, maintaining the highest standards of financial compliance.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or similar finance roles; exposure or interest in the industrial sector is a plus.

• Strong skills in financial modelling, forecasting, and data analytics, with a solid understanding of global finance processes and standards; proficiency in Tagetik, Qlik, and/or integrated ERP systems is advantageous. Nice to have experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to deliver key insights to leadership, collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to drive structured solutions, and comfortable working with a level of independence.

• Fluency in English

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives

• Restaurant Tickets

• Permanent contract

• Accident insurance

• Central workplace in Nuevos Ministerios

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role

jobs.title: Helper Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen
and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

What we offer you

USA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary
The Order Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the order processing function by handling routine tasks, updating systems, and communicating with internal teams. This role follows standard procedures and makes smaller decisions autonomously.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

Key
• Responsibilities
Process routine customer orders and update systems.
Track delivery schedules and report delays.
Communicate with internal teams to resolve basic issues.
Maintain accurate records of order transactions.
Support reporting and documentation tasks.
Assist in customer service inquiries related to orders.
Skills &
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic understanding of order processing systems.
Good communication and organizational skills.
Attention to detail and ability to follow procedures.
Customer-focused mindset.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

jobs.title: Project manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef de Projet dynamique et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Le/la Chef de Projet sera responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et de la clôture réussie de projets variés, en veillant à l'atteinte des objectifs dans le respect des délais et du budget.

Responsabilités:

• Définir les objectifs du projet, le périmètre, les livrables et les critères de réussite en collaboration avec les parties prenantes.

• Élaborer des plans de projet détaillés, y compris les échéanciers, les budgets et l'allocation des ressources.

• Gérer les équipes de projet, attribuer les tâches et superviser leur progression.

• Identifier et gérer les risques et les problèmes du projet, en élaborant des plans d'atténuation.

• Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes sur l'état d'avancement du projet.

• Assurer le respect des normes de qualité et des procédures internes de Sulzer Maroc S.A.R.L. A.U.

• Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Évaluer les performances du projet et documenter les leçons apprises.

• Préparer et présenter des rapports d'avancement et des revues de projet.

Qualifications

• Diplôme universitaire (Bac+5 minimum) en Ingénierie, Gestion de projet ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience avérée (minimum 5 ans) en gestion de projet, idéalement dans un environnement industriel ou technique.

• Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2 ou certification équivalente un atout).

• Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle, orale et écrite, en français et en anglais.

• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe, à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément et à respecter les délais.

• Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet (ex: MS Project, Asana, Jira).

• Fortes compétences en leadership, résolution de problèmes et prise de décision.

• Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et souci du détail.

• Capacité à s'adapter à un environnement de travail dynamique et à gérer le changement.

Intéressé(e) ? Veuillez nous envoyer votre candidature, comprenant un CV complet et une courte lettre de motivation, via l’outil en ligne.
Vous avez une question concernant le poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO ( rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com ). Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature !

What we offer you

• Vos avantages : Sulzer offre un bon ensemble d’avantages conformément à la politique de rémunération locale

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

QC Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Quality Control Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.
Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.
Document inspection results and report deviations.
Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.
Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.
Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.
Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.
Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Support Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and operational support to the sales team. This includes processing orders, maintaining customer records, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure smooth sales operations. The role requires strong organizational skills and a customer-focused mindset.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Responsible for providing aftermarket support for Chinese industry.
- Offer quotations and spare parts list to customers or after-sales;
- Provide preliminary selection to after-sales for retrofit projects;
- Maintain close communication with plants to ensure orders delivery on time and enhance customers satisfaction;
- Assist after-sales in utilizing sales tools to track and manage registered quotations;
- Follow up on payments with intermediaries and key account;
- Other office work assigned by team leader

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine FA will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating and monitoring of resources such as labor, tools and technical assistants as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. Will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. Will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of Gas Turbines.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Manage, perform, coordinate the management of HD Gas Turbine site activities

• Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair and calibration after installation

• Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment

• Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair and maintenance at customer's sites

• Perform administrative functions such as: writing technical reports, ordering materials, securing quotations, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely, and thorough basis

• Signs off on all changes implemented.

• Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage

• Coach, mentor and train other team members as required, to impart and perpetuate field engineering and/or product knowledge.

• Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages

• Ensure all parts needed for the job are shipped to the site

• Perform walk-downs during installation to ensure that the customer’s contractors are working properly.

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our Sulzer vision and align with our organization’s core values.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Heavy Duty Gas Turbine maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Familiar with safety code and procedure for startup and commissioning

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Relevant experience of minimum 15 years of working on Outage of Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine. Or came from customer power plant experience

• Proficient in English.

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

• Past worked in the OEM is preferable

• Solid understanding of Gas Turbine Operation & Controlling Parameters.

• Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Step into a leadership role where you can drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement at Sulzer’s Leeds Service Centre — a key facility specialising in the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of rotating equipment for customers across power generation, oil & gas, water, and other heavy industries. Known for its technical capability and fast‑turnaround support, the centre plays a vital role in helping customers minimise downtime and maximise performance.

In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening quality standards, shaping improvement initiatives, and supporting a high‑performing, customer‑focused operation.
Your main responsibilities:

• Investigate and resolve quality issues using structured root‑cause analysis, ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions

• Lead and champion continuous improvement initiatives using LEAN methodology, working closely with the local management team

• Oversee the internal audit programme and support successful outcomes in customer and third‑party audits

• Monitor supplier performance and collaborate with procurement to enhance quality, conformance, and reliability

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or significant experience in a relevant service or repair environment

• Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and experience maintaining or managing quality management systems

• Proven success in leading LEAN or continuous improvement projects, with strong structured problem‑solving abilities

• Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills

• An understanding of repair processes, rotating equipment, and supplier quality standards

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds Service Centre — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience.

Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:
Core Benefits

• Competitive salary & annual bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Descrizione

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Entra in un ruolo di leadership in cui puoi guidare la qualità, la conformità e il miglioramento continuo presso il Centro di assistenza Sulzer di Leeds, una struttura chiave specializzata nella riparazione, revisione e manutenzione di apparecchiature rotanti per i clienti di generazione di energia, petrolio e gas, acqua e altre industrie pesanti. Conosciuto per la sua capacità tecnica e il supporto rapido, il centro svolge un ruolo fondamentale nell'aiutare i clienti a ridurre al minimo i tempi di inattività e massimizzare le prestazioni.

In questa posizione, avrai l'opportunità di avere un impatto significativo rafforzando gli standard di qualità, dando forma a iniziative di miglioramento e supportando un'operazione ad alte prestazioni e incentrata sul cliente.

Principali Responsabilità

- Indagare e risolvere i problemi di qualità utilizzando un'analisi strutturata delle cause alla radice, garantendo solide azioni correttive e preventive
- Guidare e sostenere le iniziative di miglioramento continuo utilizzando la metodologia LEAN, lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di gestione locale
- Supervisionare il programma di audit interno e supportare i risultati positivi negli audit dei clienti e di terze parti
- Monitorare le prestazioni dei fornitori e collaborare con gli approvvigionamenti per migliorare la qualità, la conformità e l'affidabilità

Requisiti

- Una qualifica riconosciuta in ingegneria meccanica o significativa

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Steigen Sie in eine Führungsrolle ein, in der Sie Qualität, Compliance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung im Servicezentrum Leeds von Sulzer, einer wichtigen Einrichtung, die sich auf die Reparatur, Überholung und Wartung rotierender Anlagen für Kunden in den Bereichen Stromerzeugung, Öl & Gas, Wasser und anderen Schwerindustrien spezialisiert hat. Bekannt für seine technische Leistungsfähigkeit und die Unterstützung bei der schnellen Umstellung, spielt das Zentrum eine entscheidende Rolle, um Kunden dabei zu helfen, Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren und die Leistung zu maximieren.

In dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, durch die Stärkung der Qualitätsstandards, die Gestaltung von Verbesserungsinitiativen und die Unterstützung eines leistungsstarken, kundenorientierten Betriebs eine sinnvolle Wirkung zu erzielen.

Wichtigste Aufgaben

- Qualitätsfragen mit strukturierter Grundanalyse untersuchen und lösen, solide Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen gewährleisten - Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung mit LEAN-Methodik leiten und unterstützen, eng mit dem lokalen Management-Team zusammenarbeiten - das interne Auditprogramm überwachen und erfolgreiche Ergebnisse bei Kunden- und Drittaudits unterstützen - die Leistung der Lieferanten überwachen und mit der Beschaffung zusammenarbeiten, um Qualität, Konformität und Zuverlässigkeit zu verbessern

Anforderungen

- Eine anerkannte Qualifikation im Maschinenbau oder eine bedeutende Erfahrung in einem relevanten Service- oder Reparaturumfeld - Starke Arbeitskenntnisse der ISO 9001 und Erfahrung in der Wartung oder Verwaltung von Qualitätsmanagementsystemen - Bewährte Erfolge bei führenden LEAN- oder kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprojekten mit starken strukturierten Problemlösungs-Fähigkeiten - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Führung und Einflussnahme - Verständnis von Reparaturprozessen, rotierenden Geräten und Lieferantenqualitätsstandards

Was wir Ihnen anbieten

Hauptvorteile

- Leistungsfähiges Gehalt & Jahresbonus - 33 Tage, Urlaub - Definierter Rentenbeitrag - Mitarbeiterassistenzprogramme - Rabatte auf Shopping, Unterhaltung & Lifestyle - Costco Mitgliedschaftsoption - Ermäßigtes persönliches Autoleasing für Sie, Familie & Freunde - Long Service Awards - Laufendes Lernen durch Sulzer Learning Pathways

Vor-Ort-Perks

- Kostenloses, sicheres Parken mit EV-Ladung - Mehrstimmiger Gebetsraum - Neu modernisierte Arbeitsbereiche

Gemeinschaft und Wohlbefinden

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Entrez dans un rôle de leadership où vous pouvez conduire la qualité, la conformité et l'amélioration continue au Sulzer, le Centre de Service Leeds — une installation clé spécialisée dans la réparation, la révision et l'entretien des équipements rotatifs pour les clients dans les secteurs de la production d'électricité, du pétrole et du gaz, de l'eau et d'autres industries lourdes.

Dans cette position, vous aurez l'occasion d'avoir un impact significatif en renforçant les normes de qualité, en formant des initiatives d'amélioration et en soutenant une opération hautement performante et axée sur le client.

Principales responsabilités

- Étudier et résoudre les problèmes de qualité en utilisant une analyse structurée des causes profondes, en veillant à la mise en place de mesures correctives et préventives solides - Mener et promouvoir des initiatives d'amélioration continue en utilisant la méthodologie du réseau LEAN, en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion locale - Superviser le programme d'audit interne et appuyer les résultats fructueux des audits des clients et des tiers - Surveiller les performances des fournisseurs et collaborer avec les fournisseurs pour améliorer la qualité, la conformité et la fiabilité

Besoins

- Une qualification reconnue en génie mécanique ou une expérience significative dans un environnement de service ou de réparation pertinent - Une connaissance pratique solide de la norme ISO 9001 et une expérience en matière de maintenance ou de gestion de systèmes de gestion de la qualité - Un succès manifeste dans la conduite de projets LEAN ou d'amélioration continue, avec de solides capacités structurées de résolution de problèmes - Excellente communication, leadership et influence des compétences - Une compréhension des processus de réparation, des équipements rotatifs et des normes de qualité des fournisseurs

Ce que nous vous offrons

Prestations de base

- Salaire compétitif et régime de primes annuelles - 33 jours, vacances - Cotisations définies - Programmes d'aide aux employés - Réductions sur les achats, les divertissements et le mode de vie - Option d'adhésion Costco - Location de voitures personnelles avec rabais pour vous, votre famille et vos amis - Long Service Awards - Apprentissage continu par Sulzer Chemins d'apprentissage

Perques sur place

- Parking gratuit et sécurisé avec recharge EV - Salle de prière multi-faith - Espaces de travail récemment modernisés

Communauté & Bien-être

- Lively Sports & Social Club avec événements et tirages de prix - Gym 24/7 sur place - Machines de vente subventionnées - Cantine subventionnée offrant des aliments chauds et froids

Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: SJR95936 Supervisor(a) Técnico
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

É responsável por instalar, configurar, calibrar e reparar produtos e sistemas técnicos nos locais de campo dos clientes. Esta função executa uma variedade de tarefas de manutenção e suporte técnico e pode fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente.
Este perfil de trabalho destina-se a pessoal experiente em nível de suporte que geralmente trabalha de forma autônoma e só requer supervisão mais próxima em situações não rotineiras.
Principais responsabilidades

Realizar manutenção e suporte técnico em produtos e equipamentos instalados;
Solucionar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas;
Determinar quando os produtos devem ser atualizados ou substituídos;
Fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente;
Coordenar com as equipes de engenharia para questões complexas.

Habilidades e qualificações

Requer formação profissional e experiência de trabalho;
Fortes habilidades técnicas e diagnósticas;
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em ambientes de campo;
Familiaridade com os procedimentos de instalação e calibração.

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Previdência privada
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are global specialists in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over 20 years of expertise, we deliver tailored solutions that ensure reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround for critical rotating equipment. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we are the trusted partner for clients worldwide.

We are seeking an Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer to join our team at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven – a key hub for turbine operations and customer support. Job Responsibilities

• Prepare accurate and timely quotations for gas turbine repair and overhaul projects.

• Analyse inspection reports and project specifications to calculate costs.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, and other internal teams.

• Ensure smooth commercial and technical handover to Project Engineers.

• Monitor and report on key metrics such as order value, margin reviews, and win rates.

• Maintain and update pricing models and standard scopes of work.

• Build strong relationships with customers and suppliers to reduce risk and maximise opportunities.

Job Qualifications

• Strong financial acumen and ability to forecast costs and margins.

• Excellent organisational and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Experience in estimating within the rotating equipment MRO industry.

• Knowledge of industrial gas turbines and associated equipment (desirable).

• A recognised qualification in engineering (preferred).

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Annual performance-based bonus aligned with both individual and company results

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to a wide range of retail and entertainment discounts — including the option to join Costco for exclusive member savings

• Discounted personal car leasing available for employees, family members, and friends

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme, offering guidance on personal and professional matters

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways and structured on-the-job training, helping you grow your career with us

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

• Purpose of the Job: Responsible for the inspection activities required in the SASOS workshop Main Duties involved but not limited to:
•  Bulk Strip and Detail Strip Inspection of Gas Turbines.
•  Provision of engine bulk strip and detailed defect reports.
•  Carry out stage inspections during engine build.
•  Controlling the workshop Control Order Files and support documentation.
•  Assisting the Company Quality Assurance representative in the absence of the supervisor.
•  Ensuring all measuring equipment in the workshop is approved calibrated and certified accordingly IAW the QMS manuals.
•  Development and revision of workshop procedures as and when required.
•  Sourcing suitable and effective alternatives to the OEM for required materials/repairs/overhauls.
•  Shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors.
•  Assist with in a timely manner the shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors. Progress and expedite all sub-con activity effectively.
•  Obtaining the most cost effective and minimum turn time for engine material requiring repair/overhaul/replacement.
•  Issuing of certificates of conformity for all materials being issued to and purchased by customers.
•  Assisting with shop floor fitting duties as designated by the Charge Hand or Operations Manager.
•  All other duties as relevant to the post and deemed reasonable by the Company.

Education requirements (desirable):
•  Minimum NC Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent), preferably HNC Mech. Eng. Where formal qualifications are not held, suitable proven experience is
• essential.

Job experience:
 Previous experience in a similar role

• Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):
•  Working knowledge of industrial gas turbines and/or power turbines and associated equipment
•  Ability to understand and communicate illustrated parts catalogues.
•  Ability to understand engineering drawings.

What we offer you

• The duties involved include but are not limited to:

•  Experience working as a senior workshop member in a fabrication, repair or construction environment.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
The Opportunity:

Sulzer is looking for an experienced Machinist to undertake machining of components and parts on driven machinery in accordance with Sulzer standards and specification.

ENVIRONMENTAL, SAFETY AND HEALTH

• Direct responsibility for the Health, Safety and Environment of all employees who either directly work in your area of control, or who visit the operational areas you are responsible for, either internal or external visitors. Including full legal & company compliance in areas under your responsibility.

• Develop a positive safety culture through the Sulzer Behavioral Safety Program.

• Follow safety rules and regulations, attend safety meetings, and contribute towards having a safe work environment.

Your Responsibilities : (NOT LIMITED TO)

• Ensure quality standards and engineering standards are conformed to in accordance with engineering drawings.

• Ensure product is compliant with Sulzer and Customer specific quality and engineering standards

• Be able to work independently and make decisions in conjunction with the supervisor regarding tooling, jigs and fixtures.

• Pre and final machining of components in accordance with specifications.

• Follow departmental standards, both written and verbal.

• Fully inspect work done according to specific requirements.

• Read, analyze, understand, and follow engineering drawings

• Read, understand, and follow instructions given on the production order.

• Use specific engineering measuring equipment such as micrometers, Vernier’s etc.

• Operate different machines, follow the safety standards, and use guards where applicable.

• Any other reasonable work instructions to be followed.
What We’re Looking For:

• Detailed knowledge of the various machining practices including turning, milling, shaft grinding, drilling and marking off, experience required.

• Sound knowledge of CNC and manual machining practices required experience in Mazatrol and Haas control. Knowledge on Fanuc and Siemens an advantage.

• Qualified Trade Tested Fitter or Fitter/Turner

• Communication skills

• Drive & motivation

• Ability to act independently.

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change.

• Attention to detail.

• Team driven.

• Quality and customer service orientated.

• Show initiative.

What we offer you

Medical Aid
Pension Fund

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Expediting and Document Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Expeditor is responsible for overseeing the timely production of our industrial equipment manufactured by subcontractors, ensuring on-time delivery and meeting quality standards.

Purpose of the Job:

The Expeditor is responsible for overseeing the timely production of our industrial equipment manufactured by subcontractors, ensuring on-time delivery and meeting quality standards.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
• As an Expediter, you will oversee the following tasks:
• 1. Establish the project Doc management system and procedure
• 2. Manage & maintain the project Doc sheet & schedule with other stakeholders
• 3. Monitoring and expediting the project Doc and production of raw materials & goods to ensure timely delivery.
• 4. Communicating regularly with the suppliers to get updates on order status & progression.
• 5. Solving problems and managing recovery plans in case of damaged goods or manufacturing delays with the suppliers and the project team.
• 6. Ensuring that the suppliers’ schedules are aligned with our internal requirements.
• 7. Coordinate the goods delivery with the logistics groups.
• 8. Developing and implementing new processes to improve internal work efficiency.
• 9. Maintaining an efficient document management system to ensure accessibility of documents.
• 10. Coordinating document validation, approval, and modification processes.
• 11. Providing support to internal and external teams regarding documentation.
• 12. Collaborating with other departments to ensure smooth communication and effective exchange of documents.

What we offer you

NA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: VTL Machine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Summary: Works under limited supervision, sets up and operates machine tools without assistance, following department policy and procedures. Manufactures and reconditions components parts to customer, OEM, and industry standards using conventions, machine tools, including VTL, lathes, milling machines, grinders, etc. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches, and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Constantly measures components, parts and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges and tools.

Essential Functions:

• Sets up and operates conventional machine tools, under limited supervision.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up, including methods of mounting, leveling aligning, holding and fastening work.

• Interprets blueprints, charts, tables, handbook formulas, sketches, and written and verbal orders. Lays out work according to requirements. Selects and grinds own cutting tools.

• Works within close tolerances to meet customer/contract specifications and applies knowledge of qualities of metals and alloys being machined.

• Performs any bench work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications.

• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001.

· Safety obligations:
o All employees understand and are able to explain the structure and objectives of the SBP.
o All employees follow the safety rules.
o All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation.

• Maintains machine tools as required to keep machines in good operating condition.

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.

• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in–process work during or prior to a shift change as required.

• Assis other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experience coworkers.

• Works overtime as required.

• Participates in 5S and housekeeping assignments.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Supervisory Responsibilities:
· None
Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a machine shop operating all types of conventional machine tools including lathes, milling machine, boring machines, and drills.

• Ability to read and interpret standard and metric drawings and blueprints, applying knowledge of tool geometry, feeds, speed and basic math skills.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
As TFS Sales of West Area, in charge of the maintenance and development of Xinjiang markets, including key account management, marketing planning, increasing the market share of upstream, refinery, petrochemical, chemicals (including coal chemicals) ,AWO business.
• Take measures to expand the market share in accordance with the company's transformation and growth initiative, which focuses on shifting towards the after-sales market while taking into account the new-build markets and new-end markets.

• Develop and execute the sales plan for the assigned customers or industry, ensuring the achievement of the established sales targets.

• Take the lead in the sales process, from prospecting potential customers, conducting needs research, presenting solutions, to business negotiation, contract signing, and payment collection, and effectively manage and promote the entire sales process.

• Sales of Services(Installation/Maintenance/AWO), meet clients' requirement; collect maintenance information of clients; build up and develop customer relationship, enhance market share.

• Collect market information and propose positive maintain and development strategy in Xinjiang Area Market.

• Take measures to expand the market share in accordance with the company's transformation and growth initiative, which focuses on shifting towards the after-sales market while taking into account the new-build markets and new-end markets.

• Co-ordinate with PM, for products delivery and site services.

• Other tasks assigned by Line Manager.

What we offer you

Target bonus: 25% of the annual salary

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
