jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Conoscenza solida di tutti i processi produttivi e commerciali relativi alla riparazione di pompe e alla produzione di parti della pompa e o attrezzature strettamente correlate richieste
• Forte capacità PC, con competenza nel software Microsoft

jobs.title: Quality Specialist I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

• Desenvolver, implementar e controlar programas e sistemas de gestão, garantia e controle da qualidade;

• Conduzir análises, pesquisas e melhorias contínuas em métodos, processos, formulações e padrões de qualidade;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a modificação de metodologias relacionadas à confiabilidade, ensaios e processos produtivos;

• Realizar acompanhamento técnico e suporte especializado às áreas envolvidas em auditorias, inspeções e projetos internos.

Habilidades Necessárias

• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica/Produção e áreas afins;

• Conhecimento das normas de execução e critérios de aceitação de Ensaios Não Destrutivos (END);

• Conhecimento em Metrologia e interpretação de desenho mecânico;

• Conhecimento em Gestão da Qualidade;

• Inglês intermediário.

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida.
Vale alimentação e refeição no local.
Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass.
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
Previdência privada.
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Sales Manager è responsabile della gestione di un team di rappresentanti delle vendite, dell'impostazione degli obiettivi di vendita e della garanzia che il team soddisfi gli obiettivi di performance. Questo ruolo supporta l'esecuzione delle strategie di vendita e fornisce coaching e sviluppo ai membri del team. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di 4+ esperti ai dipendenti di livello superiore. Principali responsabilità Superare e supportare il team di vendita nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Impostare gli obiettivi di vendita e monitorare le metriche delle prestazioni. Rappresentanti di vendita di treni e mentori. Sviluppare e implementare piani di vendita e strategie. Mantenere gli account dei clienti chiave e risolvere le escalation. Collabora con team di marketing e operazioni. Segnala le prestazioni di vendita alla leadership senior. Competenze & Qualifiche Tipicamente una laurea universitaria (o un'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e 9+ anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante sono minimamente necessari per essere in grado di gestire e coordinare uno o più team di livello di esperti. jobs.title: SAP Module Consultant (PP/MM)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Specialist is responsible for supporting and maintaining IT systems and infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency and user satisfaction. This role manages technical projects and provides advanced support across departments. Job Responsibilities

• Design and delivery of SAP solutions that meet business requirement, whilst also ensuring global process and system harmonization.

• Provide 2nd/3rd level support for production incident resolution.

• Provide SAP training to key user/project team.

• Responsible for executing assigned activities including :

• Configuring the SAP system and system documentation.

• Performing system testing.

• Writing functional specifications in the development of RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements & Forms) .

• Maintaining SAP user manuals.

• Developing and supporting SAP integration with other 3rd-party systems.

• Support system upgrades, patches.

• Adoption of best practices & compliance management by developing new SAP tools, features & enhancements.

• Coordinate activities with technical, security and Basis teams.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in technical or business studies.

• Minimum 5 years on working experience in SAP module PP (Production Planning. Knowledge of SAP MM (Material Management) would be a plus.

• Fluent English and Chinese required – other languages are an advantage.

• Good understanding on how to turn the business requirements into an ERP processes.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Air Compressor Maintenance Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air compressors and related systems. This role ensures equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently while meeting company, customer, and regulatory standards. Responsibilities

• Install, maintain, inspect, and repair industrial air compressors and auxiliary equipment

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize downtime

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues and recommend repairs

• Conduct routine inspections and performance testing of compressor systems

• Replace worn or defective parts, including motors, valves, seals, belts, and filters

• Read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and work orders

• Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, and industry regulations

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs accurately

• Support equipment upgrades, modifications, and system improvements

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and management teams as needed

• Always maintain a clean and safe work environment

• Assist other trades and perform additional duties or work assignments as directed by the management team

• 3+ years of experience maintaining or repairing industrial air compressors or rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills

• Experience with reciprocating, centrifugal, or rotary screw compressors preferred

• Ability to read technical drawings and service manuals

• Familiarity with safety standards and lockout/tagout procedures

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid.

If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Any other European language is a plus

• Analytical and problema solving skills

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un coordinatore contabile dinamico per unire il nostro team Finance & Accounting a Madrid, Spagna.

Questa è un'opportunità entusiasmante per collaborare con gli stakeholder internazionali ed esterni, sfruttare le tue competenze nei conti pagabili, contribuendo al successo di un nuovo ufficio nel centro di Madrid.

Se vi piace creare impatto e desideroso di avanzare la vostra carriera all'interno di un'organizzazione globale e guidata dalla missione, vogliamo sentire da voi! In questa posizione sarai membro del nostro team Accounts Payable Controls con sede nel nostro ufficio di Madrid, a supporto delle nostre aziende europee. Potrai lavorare insieme a un centro di servizio condiviso esterno che è responsabile dei dati master, dell'elaborazione delle fatture e dei pagamenti. Inoltre, lavorerai a stretto contatto con altre funzioni di finanza di paese, appalti e fornitori esterni. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:

• Gestire in modo indipendente l'attività quotidiana in conti pagabili, in collaborazione con il team di finanza del paese e il centro servizi condiviso esterno

• Gestire l'escalation nei conti in arrivo domande relative da parte dei fornitori

• Rivedere le proposte di pagamento e garantire un allineamento completo con i requisiti di conformità del paese.

• Monitorare e controllare i conti pagabili invecchiamento.

• Assistere nella preparazione di bilanci mensili, trimestrali e annuali secondo IFR.

• Standardizzazione del processo di guida e riduzione delle inefficienze, agendo come guida per i team di servizi condivisi.

• Supporta attivamente vari progetti, come implementazioni di sistema e ottimizzazioni di processo

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o campi correlati

• 3 anni di esperienza in Contabili

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali

• Conoscenza dei sistemi ERP (preferibile SAP o D365)

• competenze linguistiche

• Qualsiasi altra lingua europea è un vantaggio

• Analitica e problem solving competenze

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto permanente.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Biglietti del ristorante

• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.

• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.

• Godetevi ottimi servizi di ufficio e una posizione perfetta a Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, rendendo la vostra esperienza di lavoro sia confortevole e conveniente.

• Altri vantaggi

Nessun visto o permesso di lavoro può essere fornito per questo ruolo.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen dynamischen Accounts Payable Coordinator, der sich unserem Finance & Accounting Team in Madrid, Spanien, anschließt.

Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, mit internationalen und externen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten, Ihre Expertise in Bezug auf Zahlungskonten zu nutzen und gleichzeitig zum Erfolg eines neu gegründeten Büros in Madrid beizutragen.

Wenn Sie gerne Wirkung erzielen und Ihre Karriere in einer globalen und missionsgeführten Organisation vorantreiben möchten, möchten wir von Ihnen hören! In dieser Position werden Sie Mitglied unseres Accounts Payable Controls-Teams in unserem Büro in Madrid sein und unsere europäischen Unternehmen unterstützen. Sie arbeiten mit einem externen Shared Service Center zusammen, das für Stammdaten, Rechnungsverarbeitung und Zahlungen zuständig ist. Darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Länder Finanzfunktionen, Beschaffung und externen Anbietern zusammen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Verwalten Sie das tägliche Geschäft in Form von Zahlungskonten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Finanzteam des Landes und dem externen Shared Service Center

• Verwalten von Eskalationen bei eingehenden zahlungspflichtigen Anfragen von Lieferanten

• Überprüfen Sie Zahlungsvorschläge und stellen Sie eine vollständige Angleichung an die Compliance-Anforderungen des Landes sicher.

• Überwachen und kontrollieren Sie die Alterung von Konten.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach IFR.

• Prozessstandardisierung vorantreiben und Ineffizienzen reduzieren, als Leitfaden für die Shared-Services-Teams.

• Aktive Unterstützung verschiedener Projekte, wie Systemimplementierungen und Prozessoptimierungen

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Accounts Payable

• Sehr gute schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Soutenir activement divers projets, tels que les implémentations de systèmes et les optimisations de processus

• Billets de restaurant

jobs.title: OTC Billing Accountant (French / Italian)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The OTC Billing Accountant supports end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash activities with a strong focus on collections, billing, cash forecasting, and credit management. The role works closely with Legal Entities, Sales, Project Management, and Finance stakeholders to optimize cash flow, manage credit risk, and drive process standardization across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Invoicing

• Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices based on contracts, service agreements, and purchase orders.

• Review and reconcile billing data, ensuring timely invoice dispatch in compliance with customer and regulatory requirements (e.g. B2B e‑invoicing).

• Collaborate with Sales, Project Management, Customer Service, and Collections teams to resolve billing queries.

• Support intercompany billing, month‑end and year‑end close activities, including billing‑related journal entries and reconciliations.

• Ensure compliance with OTC controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements. Supporting internal and external audits.

Collections & Cash forecasting

• Perform structured follow‑ups with customers (phone/email) to ensure timely payments in line with contractual terms. Driving overdue reduction across assigned Legal Entities through proactive management of customer collections.

• Identify, analyze, and resolve payment‑impacting disputes, coordinating with PMs, Sales, and Local Finance to ensure timely resolution.

• Monitor AR performance, maintain accurate records, and perform AR, revenue, and ageing analysis.

• Participate in stakeholder meetings, propose corrective actions, and escalate AR‑related risks when required.

• Support cash forecasting by providing reliable AR data and trends, payment expectations and accurate information in systems

Credit Management

• Perform customer credit risk assessments using external credit tools and reports and recommend and monitor customer credit limits in line with internal policies.

• Monitor credit exposure, ensure timely reporting, and escalating risks as needed. Close collaboration with Sales and Local Finance to support effective credit decisions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Solid financial background with hands‑on experience in Order‑to‑Cash processes, such as Billing, Cash Collections, and/or Credit Management. Experience in a Finance or Shared Services environment is a strong advantage.

• Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or project‑based environments is preferred.

• Robust knowledge and experience in billing processes is a plus.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of French or Italian is a big plus.

• Strong understanding of the end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash cycle, including accounting principles, revenue recognition, and billing processes within Global Business Services or Finance Shared Services organizations.

• Highly proactive and ownership‑driven mindset: you anticipate issues, take initiative to resolve them, and follow through to completion without losing sight of priorities.

• Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills, with a structured, data‑driven and continuous‑improvement (Lean) approach to challenges.

• Strong focus on ownership of results: reliability in execution and delivery on commitments.

• Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills; success in this role requires continuous interaction with project teams, Sales, and Finance stakeholders, including the ability to influence and align across teams.

• Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala or similar) is highly valued.

• Proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participat

jobs.title: Winder/ Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Falkirk is a strategic investment site, built to be one of the most advanced rotating equipment service centres in the UK.

That investment is real — bigger machines, heavier lifts, and a 2 MW high‑voltage test bed that lets us fully load‑test motors and generators before they go back to site. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Dismantling, rewinding, rebuilding and testing AC and DC motors, including traction motors

• LV motor rewinds and full electro‑mechanical overhauls

• Strip, clean and prepare stators and armatures for rewinding

• Manufacture and fit coils to original design — random wound and formed coils

• Dip, bake and varnish windings using dip tanks or VPI where required

• Carry out static electrical tests and record results

• Basic mechanical fitting on associated equipment like pumps and gearboxes

What we’re looking for

• Time‑served Winder, Fitter or Electrical Machine Repair background

• Solid experience stripping, rewinding, assembling and testing AC/DC motors

• Comfortable in a mechanical / electrical workshop environment

• Can read drawings, follow procedures, and work methodically

• Takes pride in quality and doing the job right first time

• Formal qualifications help — hands‑on experience matters more.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer Falkirk è un sito di investimento strategico, costruito per essere uno dei centri di servizio di attrezzature rotanti più avanzati nel Regno Unito.

Questo investimento è reale: macchine più grandi, ascensori più pesanti e un banco di prova ad alta tensione da 2 MW che ci consente di caricare motori e generatori a pieno carico prima di tornare in cantiere.

Responsabilità - Smantellamento, riavvolgimento, ricostruzione e collaudo motori a corrente continua e CC, compresi motori di trazione - Riavvolgi motore LV e revisioni elettromeccaniche complete - Strip, pulizia e preparazione di cariche e armature per riavvolgimenti - Fabbricazione e montaggio di bobine per la progettazione originale. Flessione casuale e bobine formate - Avvolgimenti di dip, cuocere e verniciare utilizzando serbatoi dip o VPI se necessario - Eseguire prove elettriche statiche e registrare risultati - Montaggio meccanico di base su apparecchiature associate come pompe e riduttori

Cosa offriamo - Un salario di base competitivo - Un sistema bonus aziendale - Opportunità di straordinario pagate - 33 giorni di congedo annuale. - Contributi pensionistici definiti. - L'accesso a Medicash aiuta a coprire i costi di salute quotidiana come ottica dentale e fisioterapia più una gamma di benefici benessere. - Assistenza riservata tramite programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti. - Accesso a sconti sullo shopping lifestyle di intrattenimento più opportunità di richiedere l'adesione a Costco. - Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

- Opportunità di apprendimento continuo attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways. - Come titolare del premio Bronze del MoD Defence Dapport Recognition Scheme, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, riservisti e volontari adulti con politiche per la formazione, campi e schieramento, più una rete militare interna crescente.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro per pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer Falkirk ist ein strategischer Investitionsstandort, der als eines der modernsten rotierenden Geräte-Servicezentren in Großbritannien gebaut wurde.

Diese Investition ist real: größere Maschinen, schwerere Aufzüge und ein 2-MW-Hochvoltprüfstand, mit dem wir Motoren und Generatoren vor Ort vollständig laden können.

Verantwortung - Entwirren, Umwickeln, Umbauen und Testen von AC- und DC-Motoren, einschließlich Zugmotoren - LV-Motor-Rückwinden und vollständige elektromechanische Überholungen - Band, sauber und vorbereitet Statoren und Armaturen für das Umwickeln - Herstellung und Montage von Spulen in Originalausführung - zufällige Wund- und Formspulen - Dip, backen und Lackwicklungen mit Tauchbehältern oder VPI, wo erforderlich - Durchführung statischer elektrischer Prüfungen und Aufzeichnungsergebnisse - Grundlegende mechanische Befestigung an zugehörigen Geräten wie Pumpen und Getrieben

Anforderungen - Zeitverdienter Winder, Fitter oder Elektrische Maschine Reparatur-Hintergrund - Solide Erfahrung Abisolieren, Umwickeln, Zusammenbauen und Testen AC/DC Motoren - Komfortabel in einer mechanischen / elektrischen Werkstattumgebung - Zeichnungen lesen, Verfahren befolgen und methodisch arbeiten - Stolz auf Qualität und die Arbeit zum ersten Mal - Formalqualifizierungen helfen – praktische Erfahrung ist mehr.

Was wir bieten - Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt - unternehmensweites Bonussystem - Bezahlte Überstunden - 33 Tage Jahresurlaub. - Definierte Rentenbeiträge. - Zugang zu Medicash, die Ihnen helfen, die täglichen Gesundheitskosten wie Zahnoptik und Physiotherapie plus eine Reihe von Wohlbefinden Vorteile zu decken. - Vertrauliche Unterstützung über Employee Assistance Programme. - Zugang zu Rabatten auf Shopping Entertainment Lifestyle plus Möglichkeit, für Costco Mitgliedschaft zu beantragen. - Vergünstigte persönliche Auto Leasing für Sie Ihre Familie und Freunde. - Long Service Awards feiern Ihr Engagement.

- Kontinuierliche Lernmöglichkeiten durch Sulzer Learning Pathways. - Als Bronze-Preisträger des MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme begrüßen und unterstützen wir Veteranen, Reservisten und Adult Volunteers mit Richtlinien für Ausbildung, Camps und Einsatz sowie einem wachsenden internen militärischen Netzwerk.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleicher Chancenstellung. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind bestrebt, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Arbeitgeber 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA ausgezeichnet zu werden.

Description Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche patrimoine d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Sulzer Falkirk est un site d'investissement stratégique, construit pour être l'un des centres de services d'équipement rotatif les plus avancés au Royaume-Uni.

Cet investissement est réel — des machines plus grandes, des ascenseurs plus lourds et un banc d'essai à haut-volt de 2 MW qui nous permet de tester complètement les moteurs et les générateurs avant de retourner sur place.

Responsabilités - Décollage, rembobinage, reconstruction et essai des moteurs à courant alternatif et à courant continu, y compris les moteurs de traction - Remontage des moteurs à VL et retouche électromécanique complète - Décollage, nettoyage et préparation des stators et des armatures pour le rembobinage - Fabrication et adaptation des bobines à la conception originale — enroulements aléatoires et enroulés formés - Enroulements à l'aide de cuves à trempe ou de VPI, au besoin - Effectuer des essais statiques et enregistrer les résultats - Montage mécanique de base sur les équipements connexes tels que les pompes et les boîtes de vitesses

Exigences - Arrière-plan de réparation de la machine électrique, de la machine à atterrer ou du ventouse - Expérience solide décapage, remontage, assemblage et essai des moteurs AC/DC - Confortable dans un environnement mécanique / électrique - Peut lire des dessins, suivre des procédures et travailler méthodiquement - Prend la fierté de la qualité et faire le travail dès la première fois - Les qualifications officielles aident - l'expérience pratique compte plus.

Ce que nous offrons - Un salaire de base compétitif - Régime de bonus à l'échelle de l'entreprise - Possibilités d'heures supplémentaires payées - 33 jours de congé annuel. - Cotisations définies de pension. - Accès à Medicash vous aidant à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie plus une gamme de avantages pour le bien-être. - Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés. - Accès à des réductions sur le style de vie de divertissement shopping plus possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco. - Location de voiture personnelle à prix réduit pour votre famille et vos amis. - Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.

- En tant que titulaire du prix Bronze du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la Défense nationale, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes bénévoles dans des politiques d'entraînement, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne en expansion.

Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Clean Line Operatives
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

As a Process / Clean Line Operative, you’ll be responsible for preparing and cleaning turbine components to the highest standards, supporting the delivery of world-class engineering services. Job Responsibilities

• Clean and process turbine components using chemical tanks, grit blasting, vapour blasting, and hand cleaning.

• Operate specialist equipment such as ball burnishing machines.

• Maintain high standards of quality and safety in all tasks.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the workshop.

• Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

Job Qualifications

• A flexible, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently.

• Ability to follow technical instructions and safe working practices.

• Previous experience in a cleanline or workshop environment is preferred, but full training will be provided.

What we offer you

• A competitive hourly rate

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

Your Role:

As a Fitter, you’ll be responsible for the hands-on repair and overhaul of gas turbines, power turbines, and associated equipment. You’ll work as part of a skilled workshop team, ensuring high standards of engineering, safety, and documentation throughout the build process. Job Responsibilities

• Strip, inspect, sub-assemble, and rebuild turbine components.

• Accurately record critical measurements and report non-conformances.

• Maintain clean and organised workstations, ensuring tooling and chemicals are stored correctly.

• Complete all build documentation and submit for review.

• Support apprentice training and contribute to a culture of safety and quality.

• Input working hours into company systems and assist with non-conformance reporting

Job Qualifications

• Previous experience in a similar workshop or engineering role.

• Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment (advantageous).

• Experience in fabrication, repair, or construction environments.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Good communication and organisational skills.

• A team-oriented, adaptable approach.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• Annual performance-based bonus

• Private medical insurance

jobs.title: Principal Structure Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

This position is part of the Engineering department.
As a Structural Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Structural Engineer reports to Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids.

• Calculation of main metal structures of skids

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Civil Structure Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

jobs.title: Master Planner
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

target bonus: 16.67% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses.
- Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors.
- Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications.
- Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment.
- Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities.
- Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred.
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment.
- Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits.
- Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
- Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages.
- Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems.
- OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems.
- Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions.
- Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces.

Work Environment:
- Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations.
- May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations.

Key Competencies:
- Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills
- Attention to detail and safety awareness
- Strong communication and teamwork
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Responsabilità chiave: - diagnosticare, riparare e mantenere sistemi di accensione compresi quadri di comando, bobine, pickup e imbracature di cablaggio. - Install, calibrare e fornire strumenti di risoluzione dei problemi quali sensori di pressione, temperatura e velocità. - Effettuare test funzionali e convalida del sistema per garantire prestazioni del motore adeguate e conformità alle specifiche. - Interpretare schemi di cablaggio, P&ID e manuali tecnici per supportare attività di risoluzione dei problemi e installazione. - Effettuare la manutenzione preventiva e ispezioni su motori, compressori e relative apparecchiature.

- Assistenza con startup, arresti e attività di messa in servizio. - Identificare le cause principali dei guasti del sistema e attuare azioni correttive. - Mantenere registrazioni accurate dei servizi, report di taratura e documentazione. - Garantire l'osservanza degli standard di sicurezza, delle politiche aziendali e delle normative del settore. - Collaborate con le operazioni, ingegneria e team di manutenzione per ottimizzare l'affidabilità delle apparecchiature.

Qualificazioni richieste: - Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente; certificazione tecnica o laurea in strumentazione, elettrica, o disciplina meccanica preferita. - Forte comprensione dei sistemi meccanici, compresi motori e attrezzature rotanti. - Conoscenza operativa dei sistemi elettrici (AC/DC), sensori e circuiti di controllo. - Capacità di leggere e interpretare schemi, diagrammi di cablaggio e documentazione tecnica. - Professionalità con strumenti diagnostici, multimetri e apparecchiature di taratura. - Forte capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione dei problemi.

- Patente di guida valida e capacità di viaggiare in luoghi di lavoro come richiesto.

Qualificazioni preferite: - Esperienza con motori a gas naturale e pacchetti compressori. - Fa.41% con sistemi di controllo (PLC/SCADA) e sistemi di gestione motori. - Formazione OEM o certificazioni relative a sistemi di accensione o strumentazione. - Conoscenza di classificazioni di aree pericolose e pratiche di lavoro sicure.

Requisiti fisici: - Capacità di lavorare in ambienti industriali, comprese le condizioni di esposizione al rumore, calore ed esterno. - Capacità di sollevare fino a 50 lbs ed eseguire compiti fisicamente impegnativi. - Capacità di salire scale, lavorare in altezza e in spazi ristretti.

Ambiente di lavoro: - Ruolo basato sul campo con viaggi verso i siti dei clienti, comprese le posizioni remote. - Può richiedere la disponibilità di servizio e orari di lavoro prolungati durante interruzioni o operazioni critiche.

Competenze chiave: - Attitudini meccaniche con competenze elettriche/strumentistiche cross-funzionali - Attenzione ai dettagli e consapevolezza della sicurezza - Comunicazione forte e lavoro di squadra - Auto-YVVV con la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente

Cosa ti offriamo

12 giorni lavorativi a pagamento

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses.
- Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors.
- Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications.
- Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment.
- Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities.
- Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred.
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment.
- Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits.
- Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
- Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages.
- Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems.
- OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems.
- Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions.
- Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces.

Work Environment:
- Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations.
- May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations.

Key Competencies:
- Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills
- Attention to detail and safety awareness
- Strong communication and teamwork
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Job Summary Die Jr. Machinery Mechanic ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Reparatur von Industriemaschinen unter enger Aufsicht. Diese Einstiegs-Rolle unterstützt Senior Mechaniker bei Diagnostik, Durchführung von grundlegenden Reparaturen, und die Gewährleistung der Ausrüstung ist sicher und betriebsbereit. Dieses Jobprofil ist für die Unterstützung auf der Einsteiger-Ebene Mitarbeiter, die spezifische Anweisungen und Verfahren, mit Überwachung für nicht-routinemäßige Situationen. Aufgaben können nach der Grundausbildung oder Demonstration durchgeführt werden.

- Installieren, kalibrieren und Fehlerbehebung Instrumentierung wie Druck, Temperatur und Geschwindigkeitssensoren. - Durchführung von funktionalen Tests und Systemvalidierung, um eine ordnungsgemäße Motorleistung und Einhaltung der Spezifikationen zu gewährleisten. - Verkabelungsdiagramme, P&IDs und technische Handbücher zur Unterstützung der Fehlerbehebung und Installationsaktivitäten. - Durchführung von vorbeugenden Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten an Motoren, Kompressoren und verwandten Geräten.

- Unterstützung bei Starts, Abschaltungen und Inbetriebnahmen. - Identifizierung der Ursachen von Systemausfällen und Durchführung von Korrekturmaßnahmen. - Pflege der genauen Serviceaufzeichnungen, Kalibrierberichte und Dokumentation. - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards, Unternehmenspolitiken und Industrievorschriften. - Zusammenarbeit mit Betriebs-, Engineering- und Wartungsteams, um die Zuverlässigkeit der Ausrüstung zu optimieren.

Erforderliche Qualifikationen: - High School Diplom oder gleichwertige; technische Zertifizierung oder assoziierten Grad in Instrumentierung, elektrische oder mechanische Disziplin bevorzugt. - Starkes Verständnis der mechanischen Systeme, einschließlich Motoren und rotierenden Ausrüstung. - Arbeitskenntnisse der elektrischen Systeme (AC/DC), Sensoren und Steuerkreise. - Fähigkeit, Schematik zu lesen und zu interpretieren, Wicklungsdiagramme und technische Dokumentation. - Kompetenz mit Diagnose-Tools, Multimetern und Kalibriergeräte. - Starke Fehlersuche und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten.

- Gültiger Fahrer, Führerschein und die Fähigkeit, zu den Stellen zu reisen, wie erforderlich.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen: - Erfahrung mit Erdgasmotoren und Kompressorenpaketen. - Vertrautheit mit Kontrollsystemen (PLC/SCADA) und Motormanagementsystemen. - OEM-Schulungen oder Zertifizierungen in Bezug auf Zünd- oder Instrumentierungssysteme. - Kenntnisse über Gefahrenbereicheklassifizierungen und sichere Arbeitspraktiken.

Physikalische Anforderungen: - Fähigkeit, in industriellen Umgebungen zu arbeiten, einschließlich der Exposition gegenüber Lärm, Hitze und Outdoor-Bedingungen. - Fähigkeit, bis zu 50 Pfund heben und körperlich anspruchsvolle Aufgaben. - Fähigkeit, Leitern zu klettern, Arbeit in Höhen und in engen Räumen.

Arbeitsumgebung: - Feld-basierte Rolle mit Reisen zu Kunden-Websites, einschließlich entfernten Standorten. - Kann erfordern On-Call-Verfügbarkeit und verlängerte Arbeitszeiten während Ausfälle oder kritische Operationen.

Schlüsselkompetenzen: - Mechanische Eignung mit funktionsübergreifenden elektrischen/Instrumentations-Fähigkeiten - Achtung vor Detail- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein - Starke Kommunikation und Teamarbeit - Selbstbeherrschung mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten

Was wir Ihnen anbieten

• 12 bezahlte Feiertage

• 15 Tage bezahlter Auszeit (PTO)

• Medizin, Zahnmedizin, Sehvermögen, Leben und Behinderung

• 401K mit 6% Unternehmen Spiel

• Programm zur Unterstützung der Arbeitnehmer

• Wellness-Programm für Arbeitnehmer

• Neue Cafeteria vor Ort, alle Mahlzeiten subventioniert (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleicher Chancenstellung. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind bestrebt, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Arbeitgeber 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA ausgezeichnet zu werden.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi Le mécanicien de la Jr. Machinery est chargé de faciliter l'entretien et la réparation des machines industrielles sous surveillance étroite. Ce rôle de premier niveau soutient les mécaniciens supérieurs dans le diagnostic des problèmes, la réalisation des réparations de base et la sécurité et le fonctionnement de l'équipement.

Responsabilités clés : - Diagnostiquer, réparer et entretenir les systèmes d'allumage, y compris les panneaux de commande, les bobines, les pick-up et les faisceaux de câblage. - Installer, étalonner et dépanner les instruments tels que les capteurs de pression, de température et de vitesse. - Effectuer des essais fonctionnels et la validation du système pour assurer la bonne performance du moteur et la conformité aux spécifications. - Interpréter les schémas de câblage, les P&ID et les manuels techniques pour appuyer les activités de dépannage et d'installation. - Effectuer des travaux d'entretien préventif et des inspections sur les moteurs, les compresseurs et l'équipement connexe.

- Aider à démarrer les moteurs, à arrêter les moteurs et à mettre en service les activités. - Identifier les causes profondes des défaillances du système et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives. - Tenir des dossiers de service précis, des rapports d'étalonnage et de la documentation. - Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité, des politiques de l'entreprise et des règlements de l'industrie. - Collaborer avec les équipes d'exploitation, d'ingénierie et d'entretien pour optimiser la fiabilité de l'équipement.

Qualifications requises : - Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent; certification technique ou diplôme associé dans les domaines de l'instrumentation, de l'électricité ou de la discipline mécanique. - Connaissance approfondie des systèmes mécaniques, y compris les moteurs et l'équipement rotatif. - Connaissances de travail des systèmes électriques (AC/DC), des capteurs et des circuits de commande. - Capacité de lire et d'interpréter les schémas, les schémas de câblage et la documentation technique. - Compétence avec les outils de diagnostic, les multimètres et l'équipement d'étalonnage. - Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes.

- Conducteur valide, permis et capacité de voyager sur les sites d'emploi au besoin.

Qualifications privilégiées : - Expérience des moteurs au gaz naturel et des ensembles de compresseurs. - Familiarisation avec les systèmes de commande (PLC/SCADA) et les systèmes de gestion des moteurs. - Formation ou certifications des OEM liées aux systèmes d'allumage ou d'instrumentation. - Connaissance des classifications des zones dangereuses et des pratiques de travail sécuritaires.

Exigences physiques : - Capacité de travailler dans des environnements industriels, y compris l'exposition au bruit, à la chaleur et aux conditions extérieures. - Capacité de soulever jusqu'à 50 livres et d'accomplir des tâches exigeantes physiquement. - Capacité de monter des échelles, de travailler en hauteur et dans des espaces confinés.

Environnement de travail : - Rôle sur le terrain dans les déplacements des clients, y compris les endroits éloignés. - Peut exiger la disponibilité sur appel et des heures de travail prolongées pendant les pannes ou les opérations critiques.

Compétences clés : - Capacité mécanique avec compétences électriques/instrumentation interfonctionnelles - Attention aux détails et sensibilisation à la sécurité - Communication et travail d'équipe forts - Automotivation avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 12 jours fériés payés

• 15 jours de congé payé (TOP)

• Médical, dentaire, vision, vie et handicap

• 401K avec 6% de correspondance d'entreprise

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Programme de mieux-être des employés

• Nouvelle cafétéria sur place, tous les repas subventionnés (Centre de service La Porte)

Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

jobs.title: Sales Manager_South China
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of junior sales staff, ensuring daily sales operations run smoothly, and supporting the achievement of sales targets. This role provides coaching, monitors performance, and ensures compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities

• Develop pump services sales in south of China and achieve the sales target.

• Supervise daily activities of the sales team.

• Assign tasks and monitor progress toward goals.

• Ensure adherence to sales processes and policies.

• Handle customer issues and escalate when necessary.

• Track and report team performance.

• Support implementation of sales initiatives.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 5+ years of sales experience in pumps industry are minimally required.

• Good knowledge on pump technology and experience with pump service sales is preferred.

• Experience in sales or customer service supervision.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting.

• Problem-solving and organizational abilities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income
