descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le coordonnateur du crédit et des recouvrements de l'Ordre d'encaissement est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration des nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun.

Principales responsabilités :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie

• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation

• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration

• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

Exigences et compétences minimales en matière d'emploi :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée

• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte

• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 30 jours Bonus de Noël ( Aguinaldo )

• Caisse d'épargne : 8 % par mois

• Reconnaissance du régime de retraite et de l'ancienneté

• Assurance maladie majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, soins dentaires et assurance vision

• 12 jours de vacances pour commencer avec une prime de 50 %

jobs.title: SAP PS Inhouse Consultant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group IT Sr. Specialist is responsible for managing IT systems and services at the group level, ensuring operational excellence and supporting strategic IT initiatives. This role provides advanced technical expertise and leads cross-functional IT projects. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Job Purpose

As part of the SAP CoE the SAP PS consultant is responsible for supporting the business by implementing Change Requests, being part of and SAP roll-outs and projects and supporting in the Incident and Problem Management on our SAP platforms.

Requirements for this role include the below:

• 1. Manage all activities related to the PS module
• 2. Responsibility to do changes to SAP system configuration and to global master data in the PS modules
• 3. Responsible to provide on-going key user training
• 4. Responsible for configuring and for implementing localizations with the key users and consultants during rollouts
• 5. Develop, configure, test and roll-out SAP PS module settings based on the Sulzer template
• 6. Provide detail functional specifications to assist technical team in the development of RICEF
• 7. Basic knowledge of ABAP debugging for issue analysis
• 8. Adoption of best practices and compliance management by developing new SAP tools, features and enhancements
• 9. Ability to manage diversified team located across the globe through project requirement, design, development, code/test case reviews, testing and deployment phases
• 10. Ability to multitask under high stress & aggressive timelines
• 11. Experience working with top management to manage expectations and escalate issues/risks
• 12. Experience in a similar position in-house in an international corporation
• 13. Deep knowledge in Project structures (WBS, Networks, Activities, Milestones)
• 14. Deep knowledge in Budgeting, Cost Planning, Result Analysis
• 15. Deep knowledge in Integration with FI/CO, PLM, SD, MM, PP
• 16. Knowledge of standard PS reports & reporting tools
• 17. Basic understanding of Fiori apps for Project System
• 18. Basic knowledge in SD & CS processes
• 19. Required to travel in case of roll outs
• 20. Excellent problem solving & client facing skills

Desired experience and qualifications

Work experience :
• Minimum 8 - 10 years’ experience with responsibilities outlined.
• Experience in a multi-national company environment in a matrix environment
• Preferably experience on S4/HANA

Expertise (e.g. professional, technical): PS C ertified, ITIL Certified
Experience with at least two SAP ECC Implementation or redesign with implementation functional team experience.

Education: Level: Engineering Degree from Technical College.
Languages: English

Soft skills:
• Ability to act independently
• Attention to detail
• Customer service oriented
• Flexibility and ability to adapt to
• Interpersonal skills and cultural awareness
• Planning and Organization skills
• Problem solving skills
• Ability to work in a global team

Other:
• Timely completion of service incidents, requests, problems and / or escalations relating to Service Operations to agreed SLA's, OLA's and best effort depending on priority of the ticket.
• Measured By:
• Internal Service Level Agreements
• Published IT Service Level Agreements
• Internal Key Performance Indicators and customer satisfaction
• Available for travel as needed for work-assignments, training/conferences, meetings
• Availability to work outside normal office hours

What we offer you

• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 d

jobs.title: AP Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Key Responsibilities

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

Skills & Qualifications

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Lead Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales team by providing technical guidance and ensuring that proposed solutions meet customer needs. This role also contributes to product development feedback and customer onboarding.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximising enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers.

• Act as the primary contact for all product lines

• Ability to evaluate market environment in terms of products, pricing, distribution network, and to develop new strategies and action plains in the target markets.

• To take responsibility for their contribution to the RFC for Order Intake for the customers/allocated territory that he/she is responsible for.

• Collaborate with technical and operations teams to ensure service projects meet Sulzer’s quality standards.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Negotiation skill and relationship management skill

• Commercial acumen, customer service skill, Influencing and persuasion skill, general computer skill

• Ability to act independently

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change

• Customer focus

• Result-oriented

• Fluent in English

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Minimum Diploma or Bachelor degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in sales or engineering services, preferably in rotating equipment.

• Strong networking in energy, manufacturing, oil & gas, power plant industries, or general industries.

• Strong technical knowledge of rotating equipment.

Career Opportunities

jobs.title: Works Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
oversees the tendering and execution phases of projects by defining methodologies, resources, and schedules, serving as the main technical liaison with clients, and ensuring scope, quality, time, and cost objectives are met. Main tasks and responsibilities
During TENDERING PROCESS:

• Technical coordinator in detailed step/methodology, identification of the required tools, equipment and manpower.

• Point of contact between the potential client and Sulzer team for technical details, data collection, analysis, possible root causes in order to avoid reoccurrence after repair by Sulzer.

• Create Planning/schedule from mobilization, execution, testing and commissioning up to Owner’s acceptance and document submission.
During PROJECT EXECUTION:

• Project Manager roles, i.e. to manage scope, quality, time and cost of the project

• Sourcing possible local resources of skilled manpower, tools, equipment, workshop

• Attending meeting with the Client, provide response for their inquires, comments and concerns.

• Coordinate/ discuss with the respective Sulzer’s team/ division.

• Supervision of Sulzer’s team and subcontractor at site

• Project progress internal meeting and report
Technical support In developing Sulzer Philippines Service Center facility and organization

• Service center design review, construction supervision and testing of each installed equipment.

• Assess the local demand/need of further expansion of facilities

• Involve in the hiring process, training and supervision of the technical team.

• Establish Quality Control documents, procedures, reporting and documentation system.

• Create a high quality product/services to the customer’s satisfaction that will support Sulzer’s business expansion in the Philippines.

• Build and maintain close connection with client and potential client, to be able to provide a solution when needed.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Proficiency in project planning and scheduling tools

• Skilled in root cause analysis and troubleshooting techniques.

• Ability to source and manage local manpower, tools, and equipment.

• Strong client relationship management

• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken) for coordination with global teams.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

• Having >5 years experience as a manager, mainly in repairing rotating equipment

• Having knowledge in maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment, such as turbine, compressor, generator

• Proven track record as a Project Manager or Technical Coordinator in repair, maintenance, or commissioning projects.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical benefit

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Repair Engineer
Inside Sales Support (Aftermarket)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support will be responsible for supporting FRC Wastewater treatment systems after they have been commissioned for operation. You will be responsible for proactively reaching out to customers to ensure they have a stock of spare parts. You will assist customers with ordering spare parts and answering questions about performance or technical issues.
Essential Functions: (80%)

• Call customers with FRC equipment to assist them with ordering spare parts.

• Assemble detailed project specific spare parts list, provide to Project Manager.

• Respond to customer questions regarding spare parts and upgrades.

• Function as entry point for questions from customers and sales representatives regarding technical and performance questions for installations provided by FRC.

• Follow up to confirm customer questions have been answered.

• When required, forward questions to the right person within organization and ensure adherence to FRC's 24-hour response philosophy.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, FRC representatives, consultants, engineers and managers through responsive, effective and honest communications.

• Proactive communication with customers about the need for and functionality of spare parts, (Discontinued items, Upgrades, etc.)

• Contact vendors for specific project/non-standard part quotes.

• Generate Spare parts quotes for customers.

• Calculate the mark-up of the spare parts, based on the margin schedule.

• Create and Process sales Orders on Purchase orders received for Spare Parts.

• Organize / Process customer's order shipment details.

Secondary Functions: (20%)

• Capture and maintain detailed notes related to customer contacts, conversations about spares, warranty issues, and upgrades.

• Prepare a monthly report providing a structured overview of all documented notes and communications concerning spares, warranty matters, and system upgrades.

• Coordinate with QA/Logistics manager and Project Manager(s) to resolve warranty complaints.

Qualifications:

• 2-year technical diploma or degree

• or

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a related industrial field (mechanical/manufacturing)

• Preferable experience with shipping

Key Skills, Knowledge and Competencies:

• Proficient computer skills: Microsoft Office, knowledge of an inventory / bookkeeping program, and online freight management (i.e., UPS, FedEx).

• A strong customer focus is essential, working with both internal and external customers.

• Fluent English skills verbally and written.

• Mechanical aptitude.

• Preferable basic mechanical and/or electrical knowledge.

• Highly self-motivated

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to listen and understand others.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster strong working relationships.

• Ability to work independently and follow through on work assignments with minimal direction.

• Detail oriented.

• Positive attitude towards change and growth

• Has cultural flexibility. Is capable to deal with the different corporate cultures and cultures of production plants of FRC's clients.

• Is allowed to legally work in the U.S.

Environmental, safety & health requirements:

• Complies with QESH policy

• Complies and participates with SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Performs its functions following and understanding the Job Safety Analysis (JSA), is aware of the workplace hazards

• Avoids and reports unsafe behaviors and unsafe conditions

• Uses and maintains personal protective equipment

• Reports accidents and near accidents

• Complies with environmental and safety rules, policies, work instructions, manuals, etc.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist - Turbine Repair Shop

titleByLocale.it: Macchinista manuale - Negozio di riparazione turbina
titleByLocale.fr: Machiniste manuel - atelier de réparation de turbines

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts.

Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

Country-specific benefits

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.
• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.
• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.
• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).
• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.
• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.
• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.
• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment. Required Qualifications
• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .
• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.
• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.
• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.
• Must supply basic personal hand tools. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.
• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.
• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.
• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components. Competencies
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.
• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices. What we offer you Country-specific benefits
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Business Controller will serve as the primary financial liaison between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key
financial and project management activities. Also ensure seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial processes.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate tracking and management of sales and backlogs

• Monitor customer order contract profitability and utilization metrics

• Link strategic plans to operational and financial drivers, aligning sales and operations planning, resource management, capital projects, other expenses, and working capital planning.

• Generate, model, and execute action plans to address performance gaps and improve overall site performance

• Provide business planning, forecasting, and budgeting know how and support to the relevant stakeholders

• Supervision and coordination of tasks with the Coe & BPO team.

• Variance analysis

• Responsible for managing internal reports.

• Support to the Head Office on financial matters.

What you need you to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Controlling

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• Experience within the manufacturing sectors is preferred

• Strong Knowledge of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning

• Excellent communication skills to liaise between local operations, BPO and CoE

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Capacity to remain flexible and effective when facing challenges

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Used to work with databases and reporting tools

• Proficiency in English (C1)

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Rivas (Madrid)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Record to Report accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• Accounting teams

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Local Accounting Managers

• Country Finance Heads

• RTR GPO

• External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in advanced pump design and manufacturing. From energy and water to chemicals and industrial markets, we support critical infrastructure and essential industries worldwide. With over 13,500 employees globally, a CHF 3.5 billion turnover, and shares listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange, Sulzer combines global scale with local expertise. Our Leeds facility sits at the heart of our engineering excellence delivering complex, high-value solutions to customers across the UK and beyond.

We are looking for a commercially astute Business Controller to join our Leeds operation. This is not a traditional reporting role, we need a true finance business partner—someone who will sit alongside senior stakeholders, challenge thinking, influence decisions and actively shape the commercial and operational performance of the business.
Key Responsibilities

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing strategic and operational decisions

• Provide clear, actionable financial insights to drive profitability, efficiency and growth

• Partner closely with operations, sales, and engineering to support large, complex projects

• Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes

• Analyse order intake, margins, cost structures, and working capital performance

• Identify risks and opportunities, ensuring robust financial control

• Drive continuous improvement across finance systems and processes

• Support investment decisions and business cases

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as a Business Controller / Finance Business Partner in a manufacturing or engineering environment

• Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders

• Experience supporting high-value, complex operations

• Advanced knowledge of SAP and strong data analysis capability

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent)

• A proactive, hands-on mindset with the ability to operate both strategically and tactically

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• Annual bonus scheme linked to personal and company performance.

• Private medical insurance (individual cover through Aviva)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Working Pattern
Due to the nature of the role, regular onsite presence in Leeds is required. That said, we take a mature and flexible approach to ways of working, recognising the importance of balance and autonomy. Occasional home working can therefore be supported where appropriate, although this is not a fully hybrid role. We also offer a flexi-time policy, enabl

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è leader mondiale nel settore dell'ingegneria dei fluidi, specializzata nella progettazione e produzione di pompe avanzate. Dall'energia all'acqua, dai prodotti chimici ai mercati industriali, sosteniamo infrastrutture critiche e industrie essenziali in tutto il mondo. Con oltre 13500 dipendenti a livello globale, un fatturato di 3,5 miliardi di franchi e azioni quotate in Borsa Svizzera, Sulzer unisce la scala globale con le competenze locali.

Stiamo cercando un Business Controller astuto commerciale per partecipare alla nostra operazione Leeds. Questo non è un ruolo di reporting tradizionale, abbiamo bisogno di un vero partner di business finanziario. qualcuno che si siederà accanto a senior stakeholder, sfidare il pensiero, influenzare le decisioni e modellare attivamente le performance commerciali e operative del business.

Responsabilità chiave

- Agire come consulente fidato per la leadership senior, influenzando decisioni strategiche e operative - Fornire informazioni finanziarie chiare e attuabili per stimolare redditività, efficienza e crescita - Collaborare strettamente con operazioni, vendite e ingegneria per sostenere grandi e complessi progetti - Lead budgeting, previsione e pianificazione finanziaria a lungo termine - Analizzare l'assunzione di ordini, margini, strutture dei costi e prestazioni di capitale di esercizio - Identificare rischi e opportunità, garantire un solido controllo finanziario - Guidare il miglioramento continuo tra sistemi e processi finanziari - Sostenere gli investimenti

decisioni e casi commerciali

Cosa stavamo cercando?

- Esperienza professionale come Business Controller / Finance Business Partner in un ambiente di produzione o ingegneria - Forte accumulazione commerciale con la fiducia di sfidare e influenzare gli stakeholder - Esperienza di supporto ad alto valore, operazioni complesse - Conoscenza avanzata di SAP e forte capacità di analisi dei dati - Contabile qualificato (ACA, ACCA, CIMA o equivalente) - Una mentalità attiva e pratica con la capacità di operare sia strategicamente che tatticamente

Cosa ti offriamo

Recentemente abbiamo investito in modo significativo per modernizzare la nostra struttura Leeds. creando uno spazio di lavoro più luminoso, più efficiente e più avanzato, progettato per sostenere un lavoro di alta qualità e una grande esperienza dei dipendenti. Oltre alle nostre strutture aggiornate, potrete beneficiare di:

Vantaggi principali

- uno stipendio competitivo - un sistema di bonus annuale legato alle prestazioni personali e aziendali.

- Assicurazione medica privata (copertina individuale tramite Aviva) - 33 giorni. vacanza - Contributo pensionistico definito - Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti - Sconti sullo shopping, sull'intrattenimento e sullo stile di vita - Opzione di appartenenza Costco - Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi, famiglia & amici - Long Service Awards - L'apprendimento continuo attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways - Supporto delle Forze Armate. Come titolare del MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, sosteniamo attivamente veterani, riservisti e volontari adulti Cadet.

Ciò include politiche che consentono il tempo per la formazione, i campi e l'impiego, oltre all'accesso a una rete militare interna in crescita.

Vantaggi in loco

- Parcheggio gratuito e sicuro con ricarica EV - Sala di preghiera multi-fede - Aree di lavoro recentemente ammodernate - Comunità & Benessere - Lively Sports & Social Club con eventi & premi - Palestra in loco 24/7 - Macchine per la vendita di bevande - Mensa sovvenzionata che offre cibo caldo e freddo

Schema di lavoro

Per la natura del ruolo, è necessaria una regolare presenza in loco a Leeds, che ci consente di adottare un approccio maturo e flessibile ai modi di lavorare, riconoscendo l'importanza dell'equilibrio e dell'autonomia. Il lavoro occasionale a domicilio può quindi essere sostenuto, se del caso, anche se non si tratta di un ruolo completamente ibrido.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Fluid Engineering, spezialisiert auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Pumpen. Von Energie und Wasser über Chemie bis hin zu Industriemärkten unterstützen wir kritische Infrastruktur und wichtige Industrien weltweit. Mit weltweit über 13.500 Mitarbeitern, einem Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Milliarden und Aktien, die an der Schweizer Börse notiert sind, vereint Sulzer globales Niveau mit lokaler Expertise. Unsere Leeds-Anlage steht im Zentrum unserer technischen Exzellenz und liefert komplexe, hochwertige Lösungen für Kunden in Großbritannien und darüber hinaus.

Wir suchen einen kommerziell klugen Business Controller für unseren Leeds-Betrieb. Dies ist keine traditionelle Berichtsrolle, wir brauchen einen echten Finanz-Geschäftspartner – jemand, der neben hochrangigen Stakeholdern sitzt, Denken herausfordert, Entscheidungen beeinflusst und die kommerzielle und operative Leistung des Unternehmens aktiv mitgestaltet.

Wichtige Aufgaben

- Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungspositionen tätig werden, strategische und operative Entscheidungen beeinflussen - klare, praktikable finanzielle Erkenntnisse liefern, um Profitabilität, Effizienz und Wachstum zu fördern - eng mit Operationen, Verkäufen und Engineering zusammenarbeiten, um große, komplexe Projekte zu unterstützen - Leitende Budgetierung, Prognose und langfristige Finanzplanungsprozesse - Analyse Auftragseingang, Margen, Kostenstrukturen und Working Capital Performance - Risiken und Chancen identifizieren, solide Finanzkontrolle gewährleisten - kontinuierliche Verbesserung über Finanzsysteme und Prozesse vorantreiben - Investitionen unterstützen

Entscheidungen und Geschäftsfälle

Was wir, suchen

- Bewährte Erfahrung als Business Controller / Finance Business Partner in einem Fertigungs- oder Engineering-Umfeld - Starker kommerzieller Rahmen mit dem Vertrauen, hochrangige Stakeholder herauszufordern und zu beeinflussen - Erfahrung, die hochwertige, komplexe Operationen unterstützt - Fortgeschrittenes Wissen über SAP und starke Datenanalysefähigkeit - Qualifizierter Buchhalter (ACA, ACCA, CIMA oder gleichwertig) - Ein proaktives, hands-on-Geist mit der Fähigkeit, strategisch und taktisch zu operieren

Was wir Ihnen anbieten

Wir haben kürzlich erheblich in die Modernisierung unserer Leeds-Anlage investiert, indem wir einen hellen, effizienteren und fortschrittlicheren Arbeitsplatz geschaffen haben, der für hochwertige Arbeit und eine großartige Mitarbeitererfahrung sorgt. Neben unseren verbesserten Einrichtungen profitieren Sie von:

Hauptvorteile

- Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt - Jährliches Bonussystem im Zusammenhang mit der persönlichen und betrieblichen Leistung.

- Private Krankenversicherung (Einzelversicherung durch Aviva) - 33 Tage, Urlaub - Definierter Rentenbeitrag - Employee Assistance Programme - Rabatte auf Shopping, Unterhaltung und Lifestyle - Costco Mitgliedschaftsoption - Discounted Personal Car Leasing für Sie, Familie & Freunde - Long Service Awards - Laufendes Lernen durch Sulzer Lernpfade - Unterstützung der Streitkräfte – Als Silver Award Inhaber des MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme unterstützen wir aktiv Veteranen, Reservisten und Adult Volunteers.

Dazu gehören auch Maßnahmen, die neben dem Zugang zu einem wachsenden internen militärischen Netzwerk Zeit für Schulungen, Lager und Einsätze ermöglichen.

Vor-Ort-Perks

- Kostenloses, sicheres Parken mit EV-Ladung - Multi-Glaubenssaal - Neu modernisierte Arbeitsbereiche - Community & Wellbeing - Lively Sports & Social Club mit Events & Preisauszeichnungen - 24/7 Fitness-Studio - Subsidierte Verkaufsautomaten - Subsidierte Kantine mit warmen und kalten Speisen

Arbeitsmuster

Aufgrund der Art der Rolle ist eine regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort in Leeds erforderlich. Wir gehen jedoch reif und flexibel auf die Arbeitsweise ein und erkennen die Bedeutung von Balance und Autonomie an. Gelegentlich kann die Heimarbeit daher unterstützt werden, wenn auch nicht vollständig hybrid.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le rôle

Sulzer est un leader mondial de l'ingénierie des fluides, spécialisé dans la conception et la fabrication de pompes de pointe. De l'énergie et de l'eau aux marchés chimiques et industriels, nous soutenons les infrastructures critiques et les industries essentielles dans le monde entier. Avec plus de 13 500 employés dans le monde, un chiffre d'affaires de 3,5 milliards de CHF et des actions cotées à la Bourse suisse, Sulzer combine l'échelle mondiale avec l'expertise locale.

Nous cherchons un contrôleur commercial astucieux pour rejoindre notre entreprise Leeds. Ce n'est pas un rôle de reporting traditionnel, nous avons besoin d'un vrai partenaire financier – quelqu'un qui sera assis aux côtés des acteurs seniors, défier la pensée, influencer les décisions et façonner activement la performance commerciale et opérationnelle de l'entreprise.

Principales responsabilités

- Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs et influencer les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles - Fournir des renseignements financiers clairs et concrets pour stimuler la rentabilité, l'efficacité et la croissance - S'associer étroitement aux opérations, aux ventes et à l'ingénierie pour appuyer des projets complexes de grande envergure - Budgeter les chefs de file, prévoir et planifier les finances à long terme - Analyser les entrées de commandes, les marges, les structures de coûts et le rendement du fonds de roulement - Identifier les risques et les possibilités, assurer un contrôle financier solide - Favoriser l'amélioration continue des systèmes et des processus financiers - Appuyer l'investissement

décisions et affaires

Ce que nous, sommes à la recherche

- Expérience de contrôleur d'entreprise / partenaire d'affaires des finances dans un environnement de fabrication ou d'ingénierie - Forte acuité commerciale avec la confiance pour remettre en question et influencer les intervenants supérieurs - Expérience appuyant des opérations complexes et de grande valeur - Connaissances avancées du SAP et capacité solide d'analyse des données - Comptable qualifié (ACA, ACCA, CIMA ou équivalent) - Une attitude proactive et pratique avec la capacité d'opérer stratégiquement et tactiquement

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous avons récemment investi considérablement dans la modernisation de notre installation Leeds, en créant un espace de travail plus lumineux, plus efficace et plus avancé conçu pour soutenir un travail de haute qualité et une expérience de travail excellente.

- Un salaire compétitif - Un régime de bonus annuel lié aux performances personnelles et d'entreprise.

- Assurance médicale privée (couverture individuelle par Aviva) - 33 jours de congé - Cotisations à la pension - Programmes d'aide aux employés - Réductions sur les achats, les divertissements et le mode de vie - Option d'adhésion à Costco - Location de voitures personnelles avec rabais pour vous, votre famille et vos amis - Prix Long Service - Apprentissage continu par Sulzer Chemins d'apprentissage - Soutien des forces armées - En tant que titulaire du Prix Silver du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère, nous soutenons activement les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes bénévoles.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Development Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file du développement ServiceNow

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is transforming its IT operating model to better meet business needs and achieve operational excellence. The ServiceNow Development Lead is a key role within the IT Service Management function, responsible for the technical leadership, governance, and delivery of development activities on the ServiceNow platform.

The role ensures that ServiceNow solutions are designed and built in a scalable, secure, and upgrade‑safe manner, aligned with platform strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities. Acting as the technical lead for ServiceNow development, the incumbent provides hands‑on expertise, sets development standards, mentors internal developers, and ensures high‑quality delivery across ITSM and other ServiceNow capabilities. Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and end to end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform. ‑to‑end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform.

• Translate functional and business requirements into robust technical designs, ensuring alignment with ServiceNow best practices and platform strategy.

• Define, implement, and enforce development standards, guidelines, and guardrails (coding standards, scoped applications, update set management, CI/CD, documentation).

• Lead solution design for ServiceNow customizations, configurations, integrations, and automation, ensuring upgrade safety and long-term maintainability. ‑term maintainability.

• Act as the technical authority for ServiceNow development, performing design and code reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

• Guide and mentor internal ServiceNow developers and administrators, supporting capability building and knowledge sharing.

• Coordinate and oversee development work delivered by external partners, ensuring adherence to Sulzer standards and quality expectations.

• Collaborate closely with ServiceNow platform owners, product owners, process owners, architects, and ITSM stakeholders.

• Ensure effective use of ServiceNow platform capabilities, promoting “configuration over customization” and reuse of standard functionality.

• Own the technical lifecycle of developments across environments (development, test, production), supporting release and deployment activities.

• Support integration design and implementation (REST, APIs, middleware, MID Server), ensuring reliable and secure data exchange.

• Monitor and continuously improve platform performance, stability, and technical debt.

• Maintain technical documentation, design artefacts, and development of runbooks.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and innovation across IT Service Management and adjacent domains.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments. ‑on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments.

• ServiceNow certifications (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS certifications).

• Proven experience in a technical lead or senior developer role, guiding development teams and delivery (internal and external).

• Strong expertise in ServiceNow development and configuration, including:

• JavaScript (server‑side and client‑side)

• Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts

• Flow Designer and IntegrationHub

• Service Portal / UI Builder

• ACLs, data policies, and security model

• PowerShell scripting

• Solid experience with ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, SPM; exposure to additional modules (ITOM, ITAM, HRSD) is an advantage.

• Experience designing and managing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and MID Servers.

• Strong understanding of Servi

jobs.title: Head of HR - SEA Cluster
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Director is responsible for leading HR strategy and operations for a business unit or function. This role supports organizational goals through effective talent management, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3–5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1–3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business goals supporting 3 divisions across multiple countries in the region
- Lead talent acquisition, development, and retention efforts.
- Oversee payroll, compensation, benefits, and performance management.
- Lead labor cost budgeting process across multiple countries in the region.
- Partner with Legal Counsel to drive compliance culture.
- Ensure compliance with HR policies and labor laws.
- Partner with leadership to drive organizational effectiveness.
- Lead HR projects to improve in operational performance.
- Lead a team of HR professionals in the region.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Requires a minimum of 8 - 10 years of relevant working experience in a similar industry in managerial capacity.
- A degree in relevant field such as business management or Human Resources is preferred.
- Strong HR leadership and strategic planning experience.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to lead HR teams and initiatives.
- Able to multi-task and detail oriented.

What we offer you

Fixed Transport Allowance, Bi-yearly heathy lifestyle incentive and enrichment allowance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: RB211 Agent de formation des turbines à gaz

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced RB211 Gas Turbine Training Officer to support our growing MRO operations. This is a fantastic internal opportunity for a time-served, hands-on RB211 specialist who is passionate about developing others and driving technical excellence across our workforce.
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced RB211 Gas Turbine Training Officer to support our growing MRO operations. This is a fantastic internal opportunity for a time-served, hands-on RB211 specialist who is passionate about developing others and driving technical excellence across our workforce.
Department
Engineering / Field Service / Operations Training

Location
Aberdeen (Netherley) / On-site

Reports To
Operations Manager

Role Purpose

To design, deliver, and continuously improve training programmes focused on the RB211 gas turbine , ensuring personnel are competent, compliant, and capable in the strip, inspect, build and troubleshooting of the equipment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Training Delivery

• Deliver classroom and practical training on:

• RB211 gas turbine systems and components

• Strip , inspect, build and operation, maintenance, and fault diagnosis

• Health, Safety & Environmental procedures

• Conduct hands-on training in workshop and field environments

• Assess trainee competency through tests, practical evaluations, and observations

2. Course Development & Material Management

• Develop and maintain structured training package, including:

• Training manuals

• Presentations and technical guides Assessment tools

• Ensure training content is:

• Technically accurate

• Aligned with Sulzer standards

• Updated to reflect operational feedback and modifications

3. Competency & Compliance

• Maintain competency matrices for personnel working on RB211 units

• Ensure all training meets: Company standards & Regulatory requirements (client-specific)

• Support audits and provide training records as required

4. Technical Support & Knowledge Transfer

• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for RB211 gas turbines

• Support operations and maintenance teams with, Technical queries & Fault investigations

• Capture lessons learned from field activities and integrate into training

5. Continuous Improvement

• Gather feedback from trainees and operations teams

• Identify gaps in knowledge, skills, or training delivery

• Drive improvements in training efficiency, effectiveness, and engagement

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Strong working knowledge of RB211 gas turbine systems

• Experience in turbine maintenance, overhaul, or field service

• Previous experience delivering or supporting technical training

• Relevant engineering qualification (e.g. HNC/HND or equivalent experience)

Desirable

• Formal training/assessor qualification (e.g. Train the Trainer, A1 Assessor)

• Experience in offshore or oil & gas environments

• Familiarity with competency management systems

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Ability to simplify complex technical information

• Strong organisational and documentation skills

• Analytical approach to problem-solving

• High attention to detail and safety focus

Working Conditions

• Combination of classroom, workshop, and field-based training

• Occasional travel to client sites may be required to assist with enigne installation/removal and troubleshooting

• Flexible working to support operational demands

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and ph

jobs.title: IT Apprentice (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The IT Jr. Support is responsible for performing basic IT support tasks such as setting up equipment, assisting users, and following standard procedures. This role works under supervision and supports routine IT operations. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with hardware and software setup and configuration.

• Provide basic technical support to users.

• Follow standard procedures for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Maintain IT equipment and workspace organization.

• Escalate issues to senior support staff as needed.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Qualifications

• Basic understanding of IT hardware and software.

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office is a plus.

A requirement is that you will register yourself for the BBL program "ICT Support Technician" or "ICT system engineer" in Nijmegen (ROC), Arnhem (Rijn IJssel), or Breda (Curio). You attend school one day a week and work four days at our company.
Minimum B1 Dutch language level is required.

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

jobs.title: Head Field Service Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Head of the new Field Service Hub in South-West Netherlands, you will develop and manage the Field Service activities and smaller in-house repairs in the workshop as well as the local Field Service team. You will be responsible for the calculation and execution of site commissioning, service and repair jobs including all relevant HSE requirements at customer sites. You will support related warranty complaints and resolutions together with warranty department.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and evaluate customer inquiries, specifications and technical documentation

• Provide technical and commercial support to customers and their projects

• Conduct site visits to assess conditions, safety requirements, and define needed personnel, equipment and tools

• Prepare cost calculations and quotations in the ERP system, including scheduling and coordination of subcontractors and leased personnel

• Support field service activities on site, especially during the initial phase

• Lead, train and develop the local field service team

• Plan and schedule service jobs including internal and external resources

• Define and coordinate services from subcontractors, obtain quotations and manage execution

• Ensure all required documentation is available prior to job execution

• Prepare all relevant documentation for invoicing after completion of field service activities

• Report business activities and customer interactions in the CRM system

• Provide technical support and training to customers and internal stakeholders

• Collaborate closely with local sales teams and the wider service network

• Handle and resolve customer complaints

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with all relevant safety standards

Your Profile

• Solid experience in field service and pump repair

• Experience in leading or coordinating small teams

• Ability to calculate and estimate repair and service jobs

• Knowledge of refinery, petrochemical or power plant environments, especially regarding safety requirements

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT systems (ERP/CRM)

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with a proactive mindset

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Negotiation and influencing skills

• Commercial awareness and understanding of service business

• Intercultural awareness and ability to work in an international environment

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Engineer serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mechanical Designer - Full Time - Whitby, Canada

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our FRC team within the Sulzer Pumps division of Sulzer Canada as a Mechanical Designer to help us take FRC to the next level.

Job Description

In this role you will be accountable for:

• Modeling 3D layouts and creating drawing sets for installation and construction of our equipment and products using SolidWorks as well as AutoCAD

• Preparing design concepts, sketches, or models of our equipment for approval

• Consulting with engineers and production staff during manufacturing stage

• Assisting the Applications Team to generate sales equipment and layout drawings

• Preparing and interpreting engineering designs, drawings and specifications as they pertain to our equipment or layouts

• Other duties and special projects as assigned
​
To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience with SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM or a related software package

• Knowledge of SolidWorks modeling, sheet metal design and pipe routing

• Familiarity with data management and revision control

• Proficiency in MS Office (formulas, formatting, Outlook)

• Experience in sheet metal design would be an asset

• Experience with welding would be an asset

• Experience using Autodesk Revit for draft and pre-construction drawings would be an asset

• Knowledge of waste management, or water treatment equipment/industry would be an asset

• Willingness to take occasional criminal record/drug tests for US clients

​If you possess a post-secondary degree or diploma in mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology/technician, drafting, mechanical design or similar discipline, take the next step and make the most of your design skills.

Location: We are based in Whitby, ON, with easy access to Highway 401.
Required: Valid Canadian passport and ability to travel to the US.

What we offer you

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule
