jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Compressors and Expanders
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for provision of technical support to customer, sales & operations in the form of detailed Engineering analysis and design, feasibility study and solutions offering to support growth of repairs, spares, upgrades and retrofits of Centrifugal Compressors and Expanders. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert and manage engineering requests associated to tendering and project execution for Turbo-machinery Services in the region.

• Conduct site equipment inspection, root cause analysis and technical forums to support sales team to identify repairs, upgrades and retrofit opportunities

• Challenge traditional Sulzer thinking to ensure we remain ahead of the competition without taking excessive risk

• Review Technical specifications, provide comments/exceptions, input Technical know-how as required to ensure proposals are technically fit for purpose

• Identify and document areas of technical risk and level of design review associated with Projects at an early Tender stage

• Liaise with oversea Sulzer competence centers, specialist functions (e.g. Aero, welding, rotor-dynamic, C&I, etc) and key sub-contractors to clarify client requirements and ensure technical aspects have been adequately addressed

• Consolidate technical offer and associated technical documentation (e.g. data sheets, calculations, technical bid assessment questionnaires) as necessary to satisfy client's Tender requirements

• Provide an Engineering presence, when required, on customer visits, for assessment, bid clarification, client kick off meetings, project execution etc

• Lead and coordinate the different engineering resources associated to the project for the execution on-time and on budget

• Review ITP, inspection reports, and closing report to ensure upmost quality of the work and deliverables

• Develop guidelines, procedures and work instructions to support continuous improvement of quality of Compressor and Expander Services in Oceania

• Be part of the large Sulzer Services specialist and experts community and Support development of Turbine Services capabilities in the Asia region to support the business growth strategy

• All other duties as relevant to the post

Competencies and behaviour required (what strengths are needed)

• Customer service skills

• Communication skills

• Influencing and persuasion skills

• Time management skills

• Ability to act independently

• Attention to details

• Culture of Continuous improvement

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to different team, culture and environment

Qualifications/Experience Required

• Bachelor or Master in Mechanical Engineering

• 5 years minimum experience in service of Centrifugal Compressors and/or Expanders

• Experience in Oil &Gas, Fertilizers and Petrochemical industry

• Design and drafting skills

• General computer skills

• Analytical skills

Qualifikation/Erfahrung erforderlich

qualité des services de compression et d'expansion en Océanie - Faites partie de la grande communauté de spécialistes et experts des services Sulzer et Soutien au développement des capacités de Turbine Services dans la région Asie pour soutenir la stratégie de croissance des entreprises - Toutes les autres tâches pertinentes pour le poste

jobs.title: Senior Accountant RTR
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a/an Senior accountant (RTR) to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As a Senior accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key Responsabilities:

• Serve as a key member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Oversees and governs the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis to solve discrepancies

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Provide documentation and explanations for internal and external audits

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English. French is a big plus

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vib

jobs.title: Master Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support.. The Role

The Master Scheduler reports to the Planning & Scheduling Manager and is responsible for driving pre-production readiness across the Leeds site. You’ll own the master production schedule, coordinating materials, labour, subcontractors and capacity ahead of manufacturing to ensure everything is in place for efficient execution. Acting as the central link between engineering, procurement, project management and operations, you’ll ensure plans are realistic, aligned and deliverable, setting projects up for the successful delivery of complex, engineer-to-order pump packages.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimise the master production schedule across engineer-to-order pump packages

• Coordinate pre-production planning including materials, labour, subcontract services, and capacity

• Ensure alignment between demand, project timelines, and manufacturing capability

• Work closely with procurement to ensure material availability supports schedule requirements

• Identify and manage constraints, risks, and bottlenecks within the production plan

• Provide clear visibility of schedules, priorities, and delivery risks to stakeholders

• Monitor schedule adherence and drive continuous improvement in planning performance

• Support on-time, in-full delivery through effective cross-functional coordination

About You

• Proven experience in a master scheduling, production planning, or supply chain role within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and scheduling best practices, with SAP experience preferred

• Experience working in a project-based or engineer-to-order environment is beneficial

• Ability to balance competing priorities and manage complex schedules

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Proactive, analytical approach with strong problem-solving capability

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, or similar industries is desirable

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & pr

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Large Machines
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don’t just maintain equipment — we keep the world’s most essential industries running. With 14 UK service centres and over 100 global sites, we deliver industry-leading solutions for the service, repair, and lifecycle optimisation of pumps, turbines, compressors, motors, and generators. From local site support to complex large machine refurbishments and upgrades, our expertise keeps operations efficient, reliable, and sustainable.

As we continue to invest in growth and expand our market share, we are looking for a Sales Manager – Large Machines to play a pivotal role in shaping our success. This is not a standard sales role — it’s a strategic, technical, and customer-facing position where your expertise will directly influence growth across the UK.
You will:

• Own and drive the sales strategy for large rotating machines, including HV motors and generators

• Partner with regional sales teams to identify, develop, and convert high-value opportunities

• Build strong relationships with customers, stakeholders, and internal engineering teams

• Influence the market through insights on competitors, emerging technologies, and industry trends

• Support the development of innovative service solutions alongside engineering and operations

• Maintain a strong pipeline and deliver against ambitious growth targets

What You’ll Need to Succeed :

• Significant experience in large motors, generators, or rotating equipment

• A strong track record in technical sales or solution selling

• Deep understanding of aftermarket services and lifecycle management

• The ability to engage confidently with both engineers and senior decision-makers

• Proven experience delivering sales strategy and growth

• Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills

• A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently

• Willingness to travel across the UK and engage with customers on-site

What we offer you

• A fully remote home based role.

• A competitive basic salary

• Competitive annual bonus aligned to both company performance and individual contribution, with strong earning potential for high achievers

• The option of a car or car allowance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Con 14 centri di assistenza UK e oltre 100 siti globali, forniamo soluzioni leader del settore per il servizio, la riparazione e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita di pompe, turbine, compressori, motori e generatori. Dal supporto del sito locale a complesse ristrutturazioni e aggiornamenti di macchine di grandi dimensioni, la nostra esperienza mantiene le operazioni efficienti, affidabili e sostenibili. • Possedere e guidare la strategia di vendita per grandi macchine rotanti, tra cui motori e generatori HV

• Costruire relazioni forti con clienti, stakeholder e team di ingegneria interna

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di soluzioni di assistenza innovative affiancate all'ingegneria e alle operazioni

• Esperienza significativa in grandi motori, generatori o attrezzature rotanti
• Un forte track record nel settore delle vendite tecniche o della vendita di soluzioni
• Una profonda comprensione dei servizi post-vendita e della gestione del ciclo di vita
• La capacità di impegnarsi con fiducia sia con gli ingegneri che con i decisori senior
• Esperienza comprovata che offre strategia di vendita e crescita
• Ottima comunicazione, influenza e capacità di costruzione di relazioni
• Una mentalità proattiva e imprenditoriale con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente
• Volontà di viaggiare attraverso il Regno Unito e coinvolgere i clienti in loco Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo a casa completamente remoto.
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Bonus annuale competitivo allineato sia alle prestazioni aziendali che al contributo individuale, con forte potenziale di guadagno per gli alti conseguitori
• L'opzione di un'indennità di automobile o di automobile

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an HR Specialist, you will be involved in employee lifecycle administration, HR compliance, recruitment, and broader HR initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to contribute to a culture of excellence and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

• Support HR projects and initiatives, such as performance management cycles, training activities, and employee engagement programs.

• Ensure full compliance with French labor legislation and internal HR standards.

• Assist with end-to-end recruitment and onboarding, including posting job ads, screening CVs, coordinating interviews, and preparing new hire documentation.

• Respond to employee queries related to HR policies, procedures, and benefits.

• Prepare HR reports and analyze workforce data to identify trends and propose improvements.

• Assist with payroll preparation and related administrative processes.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in an HR generalist or specialist role, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Strong understanding of Moroccan labor law and HR best practices.

• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.

• High level of professionalism and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

What we offer you

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits: EID allowance (“prime mouton”), Meal allowance , Retirement contribution

• Healthcare coverage

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

• Potential to increase the contract to full time

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate. Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support and assistance on customer requests - on phone and on site.

• Carry out unplanned on-site services and troubleshooting on electrical installation incl. electrical rotating equipment (motors and generators).

• Prepare and perform planned preventive maintenance checks (PM) on electrical machines incl. AC/DC motors and generators, using applicable tools.

• Receive and study any relevant engineering documents related to a project to formulate project roadmaps.

• Observe, follow and support all Safety Policies, Environmental Policies and ISO Procedures

• Manages and oversees tasks as assigned by O.L.s.

• Responsible for developing innovative processes and procedures using the latest technologies to support business growth.

• Attend weekly production meetings.

• Help develop field service procedures for various fault case scenarios.

• Maintain accurate and up to date notes of the projects FSE is involved and furnish reports as required immediately after the conclusion of the project or as requested by the customer.

• Communicate with the O.L.s, and field service team members, as necessary regarding the progress of a project.

• Immediately follow up on customer requests by doing the need-full to resolve the issue in the most efficient way possible.

• Be part of the quick response team, to provide service/updates to the customers as soon as possible.

• Stay in constant communication with O.L. to be able to assist in shop projects as required .

• To learn repair procedures which may be task specific from the Senior Colleagues and implement and improve on it.

• To communicate to the team as required regarding customer specific directives on milestones to be achieved in a course of the project.

• Must be enthusiastic to cross the boundaries of current technical expertise to learn more.

• Role will involve travel to customer sites for diagnosis and repair.

Qualifications:

• 4 years' experience in the following field of electrical engineering.

• Electric motor, generators repairs and design.

• Transformer repair and design

• Switch gear design and diagnostics

• Power Semiconductors

• Proficient in basic power theory,

• Know how in the following topics

• Operations of induction motors

• Operations of synchronous motors

• Transformer principle

• Operation of semiconductors.

• Winding Insulation Tests

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Fornire assistenza tecnica e assistenza sulle richieste dei clienti - al telefono e sul sito.
• Eseguire i servizi in loco non pianificati e la risoluzione dei problemi sull'installazione elettrica incl. apparecchiature elettriche rotanti (motori e generatori).

• Responsabile per lo sviluppo di processi e procedure innovative utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie per sostenere la crescita aziendale.
• Partecipare a riunioni settimanali di produzione.
• Aiutare a sviluppare procedure di servizio sul campo per vari scenari di caso di guasto.
• Mantenere note accurate e aggiornate dei progetti FSE è coinvolto e fornire report come richiesto subito dopo la conclusione del progetto o come richiesto dal cliente.
• Comunicare con gli O.L. e i membri del team di assistenza sul campo, se necessario per quanto riguarda il progresso di un progetto.
• Seguire immediatamente le richieste dei clienti facendo il necessario per risolvere il problema nel modo più efficiente possibile.
• Partecipa al team di risposta rapida, per fornire assistenza/aggiornamento ai clienti il prima possibile.
• Rimanere in costante comunicazione con O.L. per essere in grado di assistere in progetti di negozio come richiesto .
• Per imparare le procedure di riparazione che possono essere attività specifiche dai Colleghi Senior e implementare e migliorare su di esso.
• comunicare al team come richiesto per quanto riguarda le direttive specifiche del cliente sulle pietre miliari da raggiungere in un corso del progetto.
• Deve essere entusiasta di attraversare i confini delle attuali competenze tecniche per saperne di più.
• Role coinvolgerà il viaggio ai siti dei clienti per la diagnosi e la riparazione. Qualifiche:
• 4 anni di esperienza nel campo seguente dell'ingegneria elettrica.
• Motore elettrico, riparazioni di generatori e progettazione.

• Semiconduttori di potenza
• Proficiente nella teoria del potere di base,
• Sapere come nei seguenti argomenti
• Operazioni di motori ad induzione
• Operazioni di motori sincroni

• Operazione di semiconduttori.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Specialist is responsible for managing quality-related projects and processes with limited supervision. This includes coaching junior professionals, conducting investigations, and ensuring compliance with quality standards.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Purpose of the job

To design, integrate, and sustain long‑term capability health across Sales and Operations by creating end‑to‑end capability systems that enable consistent performance, adaptability, and future growth.

This role is accountable for architecting (not just executing) frameworks for assessment, development, transition, and continuous improvement—grounded in real operational and commercial work and scalable across the region.

Main tasks and responsibilities
1. Capability Architecture & Design

• Design role‑based capability frameworks across Sales and Operations, including:
• Core capabilities

• Proficiency levels

• Observable behaviors and outcomes

• Ensure frameworks support progression and knowledge transfer over time.
2. Assessment & Diagnostic Frameworks

• Design practical, credible assessment approaches that reflect real job performance

• Ensure assessment outputs inform development priorities, role readiness, and transitions
3. Learning & Enablement Architecture

• Design learning journeys and enablement models that support capability progression, not just content delivery

• Define the right balance of on‑the‑job learning, coaching, and formal training
4. Transition & Progression Design
Design readiness and transition criteria for role changes, increased complexity, and leadership pathways.
5. Sales Excellence & Commercial Capability

• Apply capability design principles to Sales Excellence topics, including:
• Sales capability models aligned to growth vectors

• Enablement of value‑based and solution selling

• Sales manager coaching capability

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• BSc degree in Engineering, Technical Education, HR Development, or related field

• Having Minimum 5-8 years experience in technical training or competency development.

• Experience in implementing competency frameworks and managing trainer networks.

• Experience in consulting, business transformation, strategy

Competencies and Behavior required

• Performance management system operation

• Passion for workforce development and technical excellence.

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail in assessment and reporting.

• Ability to work across cultures and regions with adaptability.

• Familiarity with apprenticeship models and vocational education systems.

• Thinks in end‑to‑end systems, not isolated initiatives

• Comfortable designing frameworks that evolve over time Stakeholder management

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance

• Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application

• Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments

• Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories

• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting

• Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network

• Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order

• Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers

• Indirect management & co-ordination with multidisciplinary functions as part of the bid preparation

• Preparation of high-quality technical/commercial offers in line with market requirements

• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

• Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices, and measures in place to mitigate the risks.

• Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department

• Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage

• Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors

• Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team

• Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

Work experience : >5 years
Expertise (e.g. professional, technical):

• Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)

• Structured way of working, ability to break down complex issues together with the bid team

• Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: pump design, international tender or sales, project management or equivalent

• Ideally intercultural competences

• Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and accessories

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Empl

incontri di chiarimento del campo di competenza con i clienti, se necessario, e fornire tutto il supporto necessario alle vendite per garantire che la soluzione offerta soddisfi le specifiche/il requisito del cliente, evidenziando il nostro vantaggio competitivo - jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary:
This role supports the engineering, configuration, and validation of High Stator Turbo (HST) Compressors within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department. Responsibilities include developing sales‑order‑specific mechanical and automation designs, reviewing electromechanical schematics, and creating the bill of materials (BOM) within the ERP system.

The position collaborates with cross‑functional teams (Project Managers, Tendering, Sales, and Manufacturing, to prepare technical submittals) ensure accurate order configuration, and release finalized engineering packages to Production. The role also provides hands‑on mechanical support, including product testing and troubleshooting

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and hold hand-off meetings as needed to ensure team alignment

• Prepare and manage submittal packages to ensure timely, accurate customer approvals

• Learn the HST products, serve as the SME, and bring that expertise to the local team

• Assist in designing and building HST infrastructure in the USA

• Support Tendering Activities

• Support ORE Activities as needed

• Train HST team as necessary.

• Support Procurement and MRB, Quality Assurance Team

• Act as liaison between other teams in Finland and China

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the SAP ERP system

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and BOMs prepared by other ORE team members to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Design motor control electrical schematics by interpreting specifications, quotes, purchase orders, and company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and electrical production assembly

• Support the Project Engineer with motor control design documentation for sales order submittals.

• Review sales-order-specific electrical schematics (drawings and BOMs) created by other ORE team members

• Provide electrical review and support to other departments assigned by the ORE Manager

• Support field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as necessary

Education & Experience:

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Tendering Engineer to act as a high-level technical lead and strategic partner to management. You will be the central pivot point for the bidding process, balancing technical accuracy with commercial strategy while facilitating complex global communication between regional and international stakeholders. This role requires a candidate capable of driving strategic business decisions while mentoring junior staff and managing day-to-day technical tenders.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare quotations for major projects in close coordination with sales personnel, regional managers, distributors, representatives, and alliance managers .

• Assist management with major project tender signoffs as required by the company’s Delegation of Authority (DoA) framework .

• Propose innovative solutions to clients based on your extensive technical expertise and seniority to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction .

• Supervise the activities of Application Engineers I and II, providing guidance to ensure team alignment, productivity, and professional growth .

• Act as the critical bridge between Sales, internal operations, project management, and factories located outside the PU NAM region .

• Actively support the achievement of regional sales plan objectives through technical proposal excellence .

• Analyze customer specifications, define scope, evaluate "buy-out" components (e.g., seals, couplings, actuators), and manage post-submission technical/commercial clarifications .

• Maintain and supervise data accuracy in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce/RFT) to ensure reliable sales forecasts and workload reporting .

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education: Bachelor’s degree (Licenciatura) in Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical, or related Engineering .

• Experience: * Mandatory: Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Application Specialist specifically within the pump industry .

• Desirable: 2 years of experience in group supervision or leadership activities.

• Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in English (reading, speaking, and writing) is required .

• Technical Competencies (Advanced Level Required): * Expertise in hydraulics, centrifugal pumps, and their accessories

• Software Proficiency: * Advanced: Microsoft Office, pump selection and costing software, and CRM (SalesForce or similar) .

• Basic: SAP .

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bonus over law

• Development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Schlagen Sie Ihren Kunden innovative Lösungen vor, die auf Ihrem umfangreichen technischen Fachwissen und Ihrer Seniorität basieren, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Aktivitäten der Anwendungsingenieure I und II und bieten Sie Anleitungen, um Teamausrichtung, Produktivität und berufliches Wachstum sicherzustellen.
• Handeln Sie als entscheidende Brücke zwischen Vertrieb, internen Abläufen, Projektmanagement und Fabriken außerhalb der Region PU NAM.
• Aktive Unterstützung der Erreichung regionaler Verkaufsplanziele durch technische Vorschlagsqualität.
• Analysieren Sie Kundenspezifikationen, definieren Sie den Umfang, bewerten Sie "Buy-Out" -Komponenten (z. B. Dichtungen, Kupplungen, Aktoren) und verwalten Sie technische / kommerzielle Klarstellungen nach der Einreichung.

• Wünschenswert: 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Gruppenaufsicht oder Führungsaktivitäten.
• Sprachkenntnisse: Erweiterte Englischkenntnisse (Lesen, Sprechen und Schreiben) sind erforderlich.
• Technische Kompetenzen (Advanced Level Required): * Expertise in Hydraulik, Kreiselpumpen und deren Zubehör
• Softwarekenntnisse: * Erweitert: Microsoft Office, Pumpenauswahl und Kostenrechnungssoftware sowie CRM (SalesForce oder ähnliches).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur principal d'appel d'offres hautement qualifié pour agir en tant que responsable technique de haut niveau et partenaire stratégique de la gestion. Vous serez le pivot central du processus d'appel d'offres, en conciliant précision technique et stratégie commerciale tout en facilitant une communication mondiale complexe entre les parties prenantes régionales et internationales. Ce rôle exige qu'un candidat soit capable de prendre des décisions stratégiques en matière d'affaires tout en orientant le personnel subalterne et en gérant les appels d'offres techniques quotidiens. Principales responsabilités
• Préparer des devis pour les grands projets en étroite coordination avec le personnel commercial, les gestionnaires régionaux, les distributeurs, les représentants et les gestionnaires d'alliance.
• Aider la direction à signer des appels d'offres importants, comme l'exige le cadre de délégation de pouvoir de l'entreprise.
• Proposer des solutions innovantes à vos clients en fonction de votre vaste expertise technique et de votre ancienneté pour assurer un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
• Superviser les activités des ingénieurs d'application I et II, en fournissant des conseils pour assurer l'alignement de l'équipe, la productivité et la croissance professionnelle.
• Agir comme le pont critique entre les ventes, les opérations internes, la gestion de projet, et les usines situées en dehors de la région PU NAM.
• Soutenir activement la réalisation des objectifs du plan de vente régional par l' excellence des propositions techniques .
• Analyser les spécifications du client, définir la portée, évaluer les composants d'achat (p. ex., joints, accouplements, actionneurs) et gérer les clarifications techniques/commerciales postérieures à la présentation.
• Maintenir et superviser l'exactitude des données dans les outils de CRM (p. ex. Salesforce/RFT) afin d'assurer des prévisions de ventes fiables et des rapports sur la charge de travail. Compétences requises
• Études: Baccalauréat (Licenciatura) en génie mécanique, industriel, chimique, ou connexe .
• Expérience: * Obligatoire: minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en tant que spécialiste de l'application spécifiquement dans l'industrie de la pompe.
• Désirable : 2 ans d'expérience en supervision de groupe ou en leadership.
• Compétence linguistique : Une compétence avancée en anglais (lecture, expression orale et écriture) est requise.
• Compétences techniques (niveau avancé requis): * Expertise en hydraulique, pompes centrifuges et leurs accessoires
• Compétences logicielles : * Avancé : Microsoft Office, logiciel de sélection et d'établissement des coûts, et CRM (SalesForce ou similaire).
• Base : SAP . Ce que nous vous offrons

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role
We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry.
You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories

• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy

• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams

• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins

• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices

• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel

• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion

Requirements:

• Strong technical and commercial acumen within the water industry

• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

• 10+ years’ experience in the water industry , including 7+ years living and working in Greece

• Proven experience in technical sales, proposals, or tendering functions

• Strong ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

• Sulzer product knowledge is a strong advantage

• CRM experience (Salesforce preferred)

What we offer you

• Chance to make a meaningful impact by driving growth across the Sales organisation within our Water & Industrial business, with sustainability at the heart of our strategy.

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry in a global environment

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Serviceleder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

jobs.title: Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Order to Cash (OTC) Billing Accountant is responsible for overseeing the billing process, ensuring the accuracy of invoices and managing the accounts receivable ledger.

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on service agreements and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in billing details and compliance with contractual terms

• Closely collaborate with the local Project Manager

• Review and reconcile billing data for completeness and accuracy, making necessary adjustments or corrections

• Collaborate with sales, customer service, and project management teams to gather necessary information for billing and to resolve any billing-related issues

• Maintain and update customer billing information and records in the billing system

• Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities, and follow up as needed; perform dunning activities where required

• Assist with the accounts receivable process, including recording payments and updating customer ledgers

• Perform AR, Revenue & Aging analysis

• Support the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and account reconciliations related to billing

• Generate and analyze billing reports, providing insights and recommendations to improve the billing process and reduce errors. Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team on this

• Ensure compliance with OTC internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements related to billing operations

• Participate in the implementation and improvement of billing systems and procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy

• Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and addressing auditor inquiries related to billing

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, billing or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition and billing process

• Proficiency in interpreting billing reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. Senior Billing Accountants, CoE Accounting Manager, Reporting & Analytics team and Country Finance Heads

Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Le comptable chargé de la facturation de l'Ordonnance à l'encaisse est chargé de superviser le processus de facturation, d'assurer l'exactitude des factures et de gérer le grand livre des comptes débiteurs. Principales responsabilités
• Préparer et délivrer des factures aux clients sur la base de contrats de service et de bons de commande, en assurant l'exactitude des détails de facturation et le respect des conditions contractuelles
• Collaborer étroitement avec le gestionnaire de projet local

• Assurer la conformité avec les contrôles internes, les politiques comptables et les exigences réglementaires du CTB en matière de facturation
• Participer à la mise en oeuvre et à l'amélioration des systèmes et procédures de facturation pour accroître l'efficacité et l'exactitude
• Fournir un appui lors des vérifications internes et externes en préparant les documents requis et en répondant aux demandes de renseignements des vérificateurs concernant la facturation Éducation et expérience

jobs.title: Treasury Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In the role (Probation, 6 months), you will be a member of the Group Treasury Team Pune and in charge of various treasury topics. You will work in a global team of treasury professionals with specific responsibilities, and you will assume regular as well as ad-hoc tasks. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Invoice Management: Operationally support the financing programs with invoice collection, accounts payable oversight, reports to service providers and banks and constant communication to Group Treasury

• Regular balance sanity & checks: Regularly perform sanities on reported Balances and loans from subsidiaries, report findings to Group Treasury

• Bank Account Management: Execute regular bank A/Cs & signatory rights check and perform the bank A/C reconciliation.

• Regular Sanity Checks: Aligning and analyzing the reported figures between different treasury tools.

• FX/Loan Management: Collect, sanitize, correct, and upload transactions from subsidiaries into the treasury management system.

• Knowledge of Intercompany reconciliation & Intercompany netting.

• Ad-hoc tasks, initiatives & database management.

Key Interfaces:

• Group Treasury Team (Switzerland/Spain/USA/Mexico)

• Regional Treasury Managers

• GTR Pune

• Service Providers
Education requirements:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance/accounting or equivalent experience

• Certification in treasury, corporate finance or AR/AP management would be a plus.

Job experience:

• Minimum experience of 2-7 yrs. in corporate treasury, banking or industrial company. Experience in global work environment is a must.

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language):

• Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.

• Excellent command of MS Office especially with MS Excel

• Knowledge of treasury reporting

• Knowledge of BI took Qlik is plus

Company transport

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller Specialist is responsible for executing core financial control activities, including the preparation of financial reports, account reconciliations, and compliance with internal controls. This role supports the accuracy and integrity of financial data and contributes to the organization’s financial planning and reporting processes.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
• Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget

• Refresh predictive financial forecasts periodically

• Conduct profitability and performance reporting

• Perform plan analytics and risk management, managing and continuously improving the financial planning and analysis processes

• Provide recommendation to the business based on in depth financial analysis

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity

• Handle period end closing, and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities and reporting

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations
Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 5 -7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred
Critical success factors

• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards

• Strong financial acumen

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders
Technical & language skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Maneggiare il periodo di chiusura e analisi correlate, assicurando un monitoraggio finanziario accurato e preciso e reporting per i progetti
• Superare la pianificazione, la previsione, la strategia di investimento, le attività di fine periodo e la relazione

• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita Fattori di successo critici
• Competenza nella modellazione finanziaria e nella previsione, competenze avanzate nell'analisi dei dati e nel software finanziario
• Forte comprensione dei processi finanziari globali e degli standard

• Capacità di comunicazione eccellenti per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e la capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con altri stakeholder Capacità tecniche e linguistiche

• La comprensione dei sistemi integrati ERP è un plus

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sr. Application Engineer develops technical proposals for projects including proposing modifications to the standard design and configures the using design and costing tools. Works independently and develops technical responses to the customer.

Essential Functions:

• Applies in-depth knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

• Screens customer's inquiries to ensure they contain all information required to submit a quotation.

• Liaises with sales /customers to obtain any missing information.

• Collects, understands, and interprets customer’s requirements for new and/or operating data from customer’s existing systems.

• Development of the technical proposal/quotation, including equipment description and specifications, and reviews and negotiates necessary technical revisions with the customer.

• Responds to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance, in a timely manner.

• Upon customer order, reviews/approves the scope of supply and creates job file per Sulzer specifications.

• Understands and provides solutions to large and/or complex problems

• Requires independent judgement, initiative and sound decision making

Secondary Functions:

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and participate in project initiation as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering

• 3+ years' experience in design of biological wastewater treatment systems

• 2+ years’ experience in technical sales work with an understanding of how to interpret customer’s technical requirements

• Basic understanding of unit operations and wastewater analysis

• Conceptual system aptitude

• Excellent communication skills

• Self-motivated and takes initiatives

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Open to learning

Travel: This position will not require regular business travel but may be required to visit customers onsite as needed for pilot studies.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: FP&A Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The FP&A Specialist is responsible for supporting financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting. This role applies advanced knowledge to deliver financial insights that support strategic and operational decisions.

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals. Job Responsibilities

• Support the preparation of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term plans.

• Perform variance analysis between actual and budgeted/forecasted results, identifying causes and their implications.

• Collaborate in the preparation of periodic financial reports for local and corporate management.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of financial models to support various business initiatives.

• Participate in process improvement projects within the finance department.

• Collect and analyze financial data from various sources to identify trends and opportunities.

• Maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial data used in analyses.

• Support the preparation of financial presentations for different audiences.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• 2–4 years of previous experience in a similar FP&A, financial analysis, or accounting role.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP preferred) and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data.

• Attention to detail and high level of precision in work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in Spanish; intermediate English is desirable.

• Proactivity and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bonus over low

• Development plan

jobs.title: SAP SD/PS Inhouse Consultant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As part of the SAP CoE the SAP SD/PS consultant is responsible for supporting the business by implementing Change Requests, being part of and SAP rollouts and projects and supporting in the Incident and Problem Management on our SAP platforms. Key responsibilities:

• Manage activities related to the SD & PS modules

• Responsibility to make changes to SAP system configuration and to global master data in the SD & PS modules

• Responsible for providing on-going key user training

• Responsible for configuring and implementing localizations with the key users and consultants during rollouts

• Develop, configure, test and roll-out SAP SD & PS module settings based on the Sulzer template

• Provide detail functional specifications to assist technical team in the development of RICEF

• SAP PS expertise – knowledge of (project structures, versions, budgeting, costing)

• Experience working with global teams and collaborating with senior management.

• Hands ‑ on SAP implementation experience (ECC; S/4HANA preferred).

• Engineering/IT degree; SD and ITIL certifications desirable.

• Strong analytical and customer ‑ focused approach, able to work under pressure; willingness to travel and work flexibly.

jobs.title: Lean/Industrial Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Lean/Industrial Manufacturing Engineer to lead process optimization, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, Industrial Engineering methods, and operational analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and throughput across our service offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to implement solutions that support our business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze current manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping , and other methodologies to enhance operational performance.

• Design, implement, and optimize production workflows, material flows, and plant layouts to minimize waste and reduce lead times.

• Utilize data-driven approaches for capacity analysis, root cause problem-solving, and performance measurement .

• Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, and cross-functional workshops.

• Develop and maintain standard work documentation, operating procedures, and training materials .

• Monitor KPIs and provide actionable reports to management with recommendations for improvement.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain, and maintenance teams.

• Conduct ergonomic and safety analysis to reduce risks and optimize human-centered processes.

• Support new product launches by designing process flows, labor standards, and material handling layouts.

• Participate in cost evaluation, ROI analysis, and capital project justification for process and productivity improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering , with hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

• Proficiency in industrial engineering tools such as AutoCAD similar software .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills .

• Ability to train, mentor, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Knowledge of manufacturing systems, quality standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement metrics .

• Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and statistical analysis tools.

• Knowledge of material planning and warehouse layout optimization.

• Strong leadership capability with a track record of successful Lean initiative deployment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Lean/Industrial Manufacturing Engineer to lead process optimization, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, Industrial Engineering methods, and operational analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and throughput across our service offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to implement solutions that support our business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze current manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping , and other methodologies to enhance operational performance.

• Design, implement, and optimize production workflows, material flows, and plant layouts to minimize waste and reduce lead times.

• Utilize data-driven approaches for capacity analysis, root cause problem-solving, and performance measurement .

• Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, and cross-functional workshops.

• Develop and maintain standard work documentation, operating procedures, and training materials .

• Monitor KPIs and provide actionable reports to management with recommendations for improvement.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain, and maintenance teams.

• Conduct ergonomic and safety analysis to reduce risks and optimize human-centered processes.

• Support new product launches by designing process flows, labor standards, and material handling layouts.

• Participate in cost evaluation, ROI analysis, and capital project justification for process and productivity improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering , with hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

• Proficiency in industrial engineering tools such as AutoCAD similar software .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills .

• Ability to train, mentor, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Knowledge of manufacturing systems, quality standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement metrics .

• Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and statistical analysis tools.

• Knowledge of material planning and warehouse layout optimization.

• Strong leadership capability with a track record of successful Lean initiative deployment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
