jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Servicetekniker til bærekraftig industri

Dette er til deg som ønsker en jobb med mening
Kunne du tenkt deg å jobbe med bransjeledende produkter og kompetanserike kollegaer? Med fokus på bærekraft og en fremtidsrettet visjon, søker vi kollegaer som med sin kompetanse og sitt fokus på en trygg og inkluderende arbeidshverdag, kan være med og forme veien videre sammen med oss. Våre produkter er av høyeste kvalitet, og er lett å være stolte over.
Vi søker deg som er en dyktig tekniker med erfaring/kompetanse innen pumpeteknikk, industrimekanikk, industrirørlegging, VVS eller lignende.
Relevant erfaring og allsidighet kan gjøre opp for manglende formell utdannelse.

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Vi er et sterkt, men ungt og uformelt fagmiljø, med gode karrieremuligheter. Vi har en solid ordrereserve, egen produksjon, og er en aktør i en livsnødvendig industri.
Alle ansatte har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Vi har gode pensjonsordninger, helseforsikring, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger.
Som servicetekniker hos oss, foregår det meste av arbeidet ute hos kunde. Kundegruppen vår strekker seg fra industri til privatpersoner, og kommuner over hele landet. Denne stillingen er tilknyttet servicesenteret vårt i Kristiansand, og ditt nedslagsfelt vil primært være Agder, men en del reising utenfor fylket vil også være aktuelt.
Vi har ca 18 serviceteknikere i divisjonen vår i Sulzer Norge, og disse er fordelt på lokasjonene i Kristiansand, Trondheim, Bergen, Fredrikstad og Asker. Vi vektlegger samarbeid på tvers av lokasjoner.

Stillingen har søknadsfrist mandag 10. august 2026 , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Ønsker å arbeide selvstendig og er løsningsorientert

• Er nøyaktig og verdsetter kvalitet i arbeidet

• Anser digitale verktøy som hjelpemidler og ikke en belastning

• Er positiv, lærevillig, og liker å dele kunnskapen din

• Har generelt god fysisk form, og fokus på HMS

Kvalifikasjoner :

• Fortrinnsvis fagbrev innen tekniske fag, men har du relevant erfaring blir du vurdert

• Førerkort klasse B (om du har kl. BE, og/eller traverskran er det en fordel)

• Gode norskkunnskaper, samt lese og forstå Engelsk

What we offer you

Vi tilbyr:

• Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde

• En sikker og trygg arbeidsplass i vekst, som opererer i flere stabile markeder

• Gode arbeidsforhold med vekt på sikkerhet, opplæring og kvalitet

• Servicebilordning

• Vår helseforsikring sørger for at alle ansatte får rask hjelp til å løse sine plager

• En av markedets beste pensjonsbetingelser

• Ferie og fritidsforsikring for hele familien

• Ulykkesforsikring for hele familien

• God opplæring, og mulighet for videreutvikling internt og eksternt i Sulzer systemet

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur QESH (Qualité, Environnement, Santé, Sécurité) pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des systèmes de gestion intégrés QESH afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire et l'amélioration continue des performances.

Responsabilités du poste

* Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique et les objectifs QESH en accord avec la stratégie du groupe.
* Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations nationales et internationales en matière de qualité, d'environnement, de santé et de sécurité.
* Développer, maintenir et améliorer le système de management intégré QESH (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
* Réaliser des audits internes et externes QESH et suivre les plans d'actions correctives et préventives.
* Analyser les incidents, accidents et non-conformités, et proposer des solutions pour éviter leur récurrence.
* Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance QESH.
* Animer et sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques QESH par des formations et des communications régulières.
* Gérer la documentation QESH (procédures, instructions, enregistrements).
* Assurer la veille réglementaire QESH et anticiper les évolutions.
* Participer à l'analyse des risques professionnels et environnementaux.

Qualifications du poste

* Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé en QESH, QHSE, ou domaine équivalent.
* Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
* Solide connaissance des normes ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001.
* Maîtrise de la réglementation française en matière de QESH.
* Capacité à analyser, synthétiser et résoudre des problèmes complexes.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, pédagogie et leadership.
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
* Maîtrise du Pack Office.
* Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Für den Ausbildungsbeginn 01. September 2027 suchen wir am Standort Bruchsal einen
Auszubildenden Zerspanungsmechaniker (m/w/d).
Deine Aufgaben:
Unsere Auszubildenden im Ausbildungsberuf Zerspanungsmechaniker werden gezielt auf spannende Tätigkeiten im Unternehmen vorbereitet. Zu den Ausbildungsinhalten zählen unter anderem:

• verschiedene Fertigungstechnologien auf konventionellen- oder CNC gesteuerten Werkzeugmaschinen.

• Die Erstellung von CNC-Programme mittels technischer Unterlagen

• Die Planung von Fertigungsprozessen

• Die Einrichtung der Fertigungsmaschinen in unserem modernen Maschinenpark

Alle Auszubildenden sind fest in unsere Ausbildungswerkstatt sowie das Produktionsteam integriert und lernen so auch interne Abläufe aus verschiedenen Blickwinkeln kennen.
Ziel der Ausbildung ist die anschließende Weiterbeschäftigung, z.B. im Bereich Mechanische Fertigung oder Kunden-Service. Der theoretische Teil der Ausbildung findet in der beruflichen Schule in Bretten statt.

Dein Profil:
Von unseren zukünftigen Auszubildenden erwarten wir einen guten Hauptschul- oder Realschulabschluss, besonders in naturwissenschaftlichen bzw. technischen Fächern. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Objective: to ensure high-quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment, both in the workshop and at customer sites, as well as to resolve technical issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the service center team.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Carry out the tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high-quality service to company clients in both mechanical and electrical areas (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation). (Applicable to 1st and 2nd Level Technicians depending on complexity.)

• Assist the Workshop Manager or 1st Level Technicians in problem-solving tasks. (2nd Level Technician)

• Provide technical solutions to day-to-day issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Supervise installations, assemblies, and commissioning works performed by Sulzer's external suppliers in the area, following instructions from the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Act as the liaison with the sales team in their area, supporting them when needed with technical site visits for measurements, assessments, studies, etc., especially when the complexity of the quote/project requires it. (1st Level Technician)

• Collaborate in the extraction and maintenance of drainage wells.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Electromechanical Technician in the industrial sector.

• Vocational Training (Intermediate or Higher Level) in Electromechanics or equivalent professional experience.

• Mechanical and electrical knowledge required.

• Hydraulic knowledge is a plus.

• Ability to interpret manuals, exploded views, and technical drawings.

• Familiarity with equipment, accessories, and assembly components for sales.

• User-level proficiency in MS Office environment.

• English knowledge is a plus.

• Valid driver’s license required.

What we offer you

• Permanent contract

• Initial adaptation period with technical and commercial training, followed by ongoing development programs

• Fixed salary + annual bonus linked to financial and individual performance goals

• Meal vouchers (€13/day)

• Life insurance

• Flexible compensation options, including private health insurance, childcare, transport, and pension savings plans

• Shorter working hours on Fridays and during the summer period

• Flexible working hours for start and end of the day.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques: set-ups, feeds and speeds for both carbide and high speed steel cutting tools, methods and standard operating procedures

• Improves methods for higher quality and improved costs.

• Assist maintenance in diagnosis, repair, and preventative maintenance

• Operate jib cranes and forklifts as directed by Area Superintendent

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures

• Performs other duties as assigned

Skills & Qualifications

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Ability to work overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications.

The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's.

You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities.

Key Duties

• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment

• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials

• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements

What We’re Looking For

• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline

• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation

• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills

• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary

• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday

• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements

• Pension: Benefit from a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme

• On site parking

• Subsidised Canteen on site

• Maternity / Paternity Leave Top Up

• EV Charging on site (At a reduced rate)

• Long Service Award: We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

• Employee Assistance Programme: Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities: Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford.

This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.

• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.

• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.

• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.

• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.

• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.

• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.

• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.

• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.

• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.

• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).

• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).

• Experience with version control software.

• Analytical skills for root cause determination.

• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment.

What we offer you

• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.

• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.

• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Credit & Collections Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Accountant is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner

Key responsibilities

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. CoE Accounting Mana

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'Accounting Officer è responsabile del supporto alle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'ingresso dei dati, la riconciliazione e l'assistenza alla rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza nei registri finanziari e supporta il rispetto degli standard contabili. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. L'Accountant Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections è responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilità creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione di nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Managers e i Credit Control Managers del paese. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di raccolta per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e riducendo al minimo il rischio di debiti cattivi. Il Credit & Collections Accountant svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenere la stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione assicurando che i crediti siano raccolti in modo tempestivo Responsabilità chiave
• Valutare le applicazioni di credito del cliente utilizzando modelli di punteggio di credito e analisi finanziaria per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito
• Analizzare nuovi clienti e consigliare l'accettazione/rigetto per l'installazione nei Dati Master
• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite, tra cui la revisione dei bilanci, i rapporti di credito e la cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e regolare i limiti di credito
• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di credito dei clienti e fare raccomandazioni per minimizzare il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti dei conti
• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli Accountants Senior Credit & Collection, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e assistenza clienti per risolvere i problemi di credito e sostenere la crescita aziendale, gestendo i rischi di credito e per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti
• Eseguire le strategie di raccolta per ridurre i giorni di vendite eccezionale (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa
• Impegnarsi con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso
• Mantenere registri accurati e aggiornati di tutte le attività relative al credito e alle collezioni, tra cui la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini
• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate pertinenti all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Supporta il processo delle collezioni, assicurando pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti
• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento
• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti
• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito
• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni OTC siano in vigore nel CoE e seguiti per i processi eseguiti da questo ruolo Istruzione ed esperienza
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo
• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o un ruolo simile
• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita Fattori di successo critici
• Forte comprensione dei principi di analisi finanziaria, di valutazione dei crediti e di gestione dei rischi e dei processi di raccolta
• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito
• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave a CoE Accounting Mana

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Rechnungsführer ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung von Buchhaltungsvorgängen, einschließlich Dateneingabe, Abstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle gewährleistet die Genauigkeit der Finanzunterlagen und unterstützt die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Der Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Accountant ist verantwortlich für die Bewertung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden und die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, dem Management des Kreditrisikos und der Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Credit Control Managern des Landes. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden zu gewährleisten, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Fehlschulden zu minimieren. Der Credit & Collections Accountant wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation spielen, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Forderungen zeitnah erhoben werden Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten
• Bewerten Sie Kundenkreditanträge mit Kredit-Scoring-Modellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos bei der Kreditverlängerung zu bestimmen
• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie bei der Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten
• Durchführung einer gründlichen Finanzanalyse, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Abschlüssen, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorie, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen
• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisikopositionen von Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Minimierung des Risikos und zur Optimierung der Forderungen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundenserviceteams, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum bei der Verwaltung des Kreditrisikos zu unterstützen sowie Streitigkeiten oder Probleme anzugehen, die Zahlungen verzögern
• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern
• Engagieren Sie sich mit Kunden über Telefon, E-Mail oder andere Kommunikationskanäle, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen auszuhandeln und offene Forderungen zu lösen
• Pflegen Sie genaue und aktuelle Aufzeichnungen aller Kredit- und Inkassoaktivitäten, einschließlich Kreditprüfung, Limits und Bedingungen
• Kommunikation von Kreditrichtlinien und -verfahren an relevante Stakeholder innerhalb der Organisation
• Unterstützen Sie den Inkassoprozess und gewährleisten Sie rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden
• Erstellung von Kredit- und Inkassoberichten und Risikobewertungen für das Management, wobei Trends, potenzielle Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten hervorgehoben werden
• Unterstützen Sie das OTC- und Reporting & Analytics-Team bei den Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue und zeitnahe Finanzberichterstattung in Bezug auf Kredit- und Debitorenkonten
• Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Kreditprozesse und -systeme
• Sicherstellen, dass interne OTC-Kontrollen im CoE vorhanden sind und für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse befolgt werden Bildung und Erfahrung
• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen
• Mindestens 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in OTC, Kreditanalyse, Risikobewertung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle
• Erfahrung in der Fertigung oder Industrie wird bevorzugt Kritische Erfolgsfaktoren
• Starkes Verständnis von Finanzanalysen, Kredit-Scoring und Risikomanagement-Prinzipien sowie der Inkassoprozesse
• Kenntnisse in der Bilanzanalyse und Interpretation von Kreditberichten
• Ausgezeichnete analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Bereitstellung wichtiger Erkenntnisse für z. B. CoE Accounting Mana
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Le comptable de l'Ordre d'encaisser (OTC) est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration de nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun. Principales responsabilités
• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit
• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data
• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit
• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs
• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements
• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie
• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées
• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités
• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation
• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients
• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration
• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns
• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit
• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle Éducation et expérience
• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe
• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire
• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée Facteurs de succès essentiels
• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte
• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit
• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions
• Excellentes compétences en communication pour fournir des idées clés à Mana, la comptabilité du Conseil de l'Europe

jobs.title: IT Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als lokaler IT Spezialist sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson der regionalen IT an unserem Produktionsstandort in Essen. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie den stabilen, regelkonformen und praxisnahen IT-Betrieb vor Ort sicher und übernehmen zugleich eine wichtige Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen zentralen IT-Einheiten, Produktionsbereichen und lokalem Management.
Ihre Aufgaben
Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in mindestens zwei der folgenden Aufgabenfelder mit:

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der lokalen Hyper-V-Infrastruktur

• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie, einschließlich Backup- und Restore-Verfahren, B2D und B2T

• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierter Verkabelung; idealerweise ergänzt um erste Erfahrung in der Integration von OT-Komponenten

• 2nd-Level-Support für Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung, insbesondere im Umfeld von Client- und Mobile-Device-Management

• Betreuung und Management von Drucklösungen, insbesondere Multifunktionsgeräten und Barcodedruckern

• Beschaffung, technische Bewertung und Integration von IT-Komponenten in das Unternehmensnetzwerk

Darüber hinaus wirken Sie regelmäßig an der lokalen Umsetzung konzernweiter IT-Projekte mit. Sie übersetzen zentrale Anforderungen in konkrete standortbezogene Arbeitspakete, koordinieren die technische Realisierung vor Ort und bewegen sich sicher in arbeitsteiligen Organisationsstrukturen.

Die Rolle erfordert neben technischem Know-how ein hohes Maß an Kommunikations- und Abstimmungsfähigkeit: Sie verstehen die Anforderungen des Produktionsumfelds ebenso wie die Erwartungen des Site Managements und agieren als verlässlicher Business Partner zwischen IT und operativem Geschäft.

Je nach Profil und Eignung ist zudem eine Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams möglich, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Client Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit.

Ihr Profil

• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)

• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift, zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als lokaler IT Spezialist sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson der regionalen IT an unserem Produktionsstandort in Essen. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie den stabilen, regelkonformen und praxisnahen IT-Betrieb vor Ort sicher und übernehmen zugleich eine wichtige Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen zentralen IT-Einheiten, Produktionsbereichen und lokalem Management.
Ihre Aufgaben
Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in mindestens zwei der folgenden Aufgabenfelder mit:

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der lokalen Hyper-V-Infrastruktur

• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie, einschließlich Backup- und Restore-Verfahren, B2D und B2T

• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierter Verkabelung; idealerweise ergänzt um erste Erfahrung in der Integration von OT-Komponenten

• 2nd-Level-Support für Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung, insbesondere im Umfeld von Client- und Mobile-Device-Management

• Betreuung und Management von Drucklösungen, insbesondere Multifunktionsgeräten und Barcodedruckern

• Beschaffung, technische Bewertung und Integration von IT-Komponenten in das Unternehmensnetzwerk

Darüber hinaus wirken Sie regelmäßig an der lokalen Umsetzung konzernweiter IT-Projekte mit. Sie übersetzen zentrale Anforderungen in konkrete standortbezogene Arbeitspakete, koordinieren die technische Realisierung vor Ort und bewegen sich sicher in arbeitsteiligen Organisationsstrukturen.

Die Rolle erfordert neben technischem Know-how ein hohes Maß an Kommunikations- und Abstimmungsfähigkeit: Sie verstehen die Anforderungen des Produktionsumfelds ebenso wie die Erwartungen des Site Managements und agieren als verlässlicher Business Partner zwischen IT und operativem Geschäft.

Je nach Profil und Eignung ist zudem eine Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams möglich, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Client Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit.

Ihr Profil

• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)

• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift, zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen.

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mechanical Design Engineer Nordic Water Products, Mariestad About the job

As a design engineer within ORE at Sulzer/Nordic Water, you will primarily work on adapting products and machines in customer projects. This may also include combining several different machines into project-specific solutions and customer-adapted layouts during the sales phase.

You will also work on maintaining and updating manufacturing documentation and technical documentation in the form of exploded views and dimensional drawings for machines in production. You are responsible for delivering a complete BOM (Bill of Materials) and drawing package for the machines to be produced in customer projects.

You will be responsible for developing functional, documented, and quality-assured project-specific solutions within customer orders and projects.
Your work will involve close collaboration with project management, purchasing, aftermarket, and sales departments. You will handle technical inquiries from sales offices both in Sweden and internationally. You will work in an international team with colleagues based in both Sweden and India.

The main tools used are Inventor/Vault, as well as the Office suite and our ERP system Pyramid.

You will continuously work on improving processes, routines, and tools, as well as quality enhancements and cost reductions.

The position is based at our office in Mariestad, Sweden.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Experience in designing stainless steel sheet metal constructions

• Experience with mechanical strength calculations

• Very good knowledge of 3D CAD

• Experience with CE marking and documentation

• Knowledge and experience in manufacturing sheet metal constructions, including bending, welding, and laser cutting

• Very good knowledge of Swedish and English

Experience in leading development projects or customer adaptations from concept to finished product is considered an advantage.
As a person, you are well-organized, solution-oriented, and pragmatic. It is also important that you are cooperative and communicative.

Contact
For further information about the position, contact ORE Manager Jonas Jansson at +46 733 003323.

Selection is ongoing—please submit your application as soon as possible!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo Progettazione meccanica Ingegnere Nordic Water Products, Mariestad Riguardo al lavoro Come ingegnere di progettazione all'interno di ORE a Sulzer/Nordic Water, lavorerai principalmente per adattare prodotti e macchine nei progetti dei clienti. Ciò può anche includere la combinazione di diverse macchine in soluzioni specifiche per il progetto e layout adattati al cliente durante la fase di vendita. Si lavorerà anche sul mantenimento e l'aggiornamento della documentazione di produzione e della documentazione tecnica sotto forma di viste esplose e disegni dimensionali per le macchine in produzione. Lei è responsabile della fornitura di un BOM completo (Bill of Materials) e del pacchetto di disegno per le macchine da produrre in progetti di cliente. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo di soluzioni funzionali, documentate e di qualità specifiche per il progetto all'interno di ordini e progetti dei clienti. Il vostro lavoro coinvolgerà una stretta collaborazione con i servizi di project management, acquisto, aftermarket e vendita. Potrai gestire le richieste tecniche da uffici di vendita sia in Svezia che a livello internazionale. Potrai lavorare in un team internazionale con colleghi con sede in Svezia e India. I principali strumenti utilizzati sono Inventor/Vault, così come la suite Office e il nostro sistema ERP Pyramid. Si lavorerà continuamente per migliorare processi, routine e strumenti, così come miglioramenti di qualità e riduzioni dei costi. La posizione si trova nel nostro ufficio a Mariestad, in Svezia. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea o master in ingegneria meccanica
• Esperienza nella progettazione di costruzioni in lamiera di acciaio inossidabile
• Esperienza con calcoli di resistenza meccanica
• Ottima conoscenza del CAD 3D
• Esperienza con marcatura CE e documentazione
• Conoscenza ed esperienza nelle costruzioni di lamiera di produzione, tra cui piegatura, saldatura e taglio laser
• Ottima conoscenza della lingua svedese e inglese L'esperienza nei principali progetti di sviluppo o adattamenti dei clienti dal concetto al prodotto finito è considerato un vantaggio. Come persona, sei ben organizzato, orientato alla soluzione e pragmatico. È anche importante che tu sia cooperativo e comunicativo. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni sulla posizione, contattare ORE Manager Jonas Jansson al +46 733 003323. La selezione è in corso – si prega di inviare la domanda il più presto possibile! Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Maschinenbauingenieur Nordic Water Products, Mariestad Über den Job Als Konstrukteur bei ORE bei Sulzer/Nordic Water arbeiten Sie vor allem an der Anpassung von Produkten und Maschinen in Kundenprojekten. Dies kann auch die Kombination mehrerer verschiedener Maschinen zu projektspezifischen Lösungen und kundenangepassten Layouts während der Verkaufsphase umfassen. Sie arbeiten auch an der Pflege und Aktualisierung der Fertigungsdokumentation und der technischen Dokumentation in Form von Explosionsansichten und Dimensionszeichnungen für Maschinen in der Produktion. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Lieferung einer kompletten Stückliste (Bill of Materials) und das Zeichnungspaket für die Maschinen, die in Kundenprojekten produziert werden. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung funktionaler, dokumentierter und qualitätsgesicherter projektspezifischer Lösungen innerhalb von Kundenaufträgen und Projekten. Ihre Arbeit umfasst eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Aftermarket und Vertriebsabteilungen. Sie werden technische Anfragen von Verkaufsbüros sowohl in Schweden als auch international bearbeiten. Sie werden in einem internationalen Team mit Kollegen aus Schweden und Indien arbeiten. Die wichtigsten verwendeten Tools sind Inventor/Vault sowie die Office-Suite und unser ERP-System Pyramid. Sie arbeiten kontinuierlich an der Verbesserung von Prozessen, Routinen und Tools sowie an Qualitätsverbesserungen und Kostensenkungen. Die Position befindet sich in unserem Büro in Mariestad, Schweden. Dein Profil
• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium Maschinenbau
• Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Edelstahlblechkonstruktionen
• Erfahrung mit mechanischen Festigkeitsberechnungen
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse von 3D CAD
• Erfahrung mit CE-Kennzeichnung und Dokumentation
• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Herstellung von Blechkonstruktionen, einschließlich Biegen, Schweißen und Laserschneiden

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

What we offer you

• Paid parental leave

• Parental leave

• Health insurance

• 401(k) matching

• Paid time off

• Vision insurance

• Health savings account

• Dental insurance

• Gym membership

• Employee assistance program

• Disability insurance

• 401(k) 6% Match

• Paid holidays

• Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary

The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. o Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

o Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• o Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• o Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• o Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• o Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• o Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• o Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• o Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

o While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Pump Mechanic is responsible for repairing and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications / Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

jobs.title: Ingeniero Tendering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El Ingeniero de Tendering es el responsable de centralizar y elaborar las propuestas técnico-económicas para los centros de servicio de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción. Su misión principal es transformar los hallazgos técnicos de los talleres en cotizaciones competitivas, rentables y rápidas. Este rol requiere una coordinación constante con Operaciones y Planificación para asegurar que los costos y plazos ofrecidos sean realistas, actuando como un facilitador crítico para mejorar la satisfacción del cliente interno y externo.
Responsabilidades Principales

• Elaboración de Cotizaciones: Desarrollar presupuestos detallados para la reparación de bombas centrífugas y servicios en terreno, integrando costos de mano de obra, repuestos y servicios de terceros.

• Análisis Técnico-Económico: Realizar evaluaciones profundas de los requerimientos del cliente para asegurar que la solución propuesta sea técnicamente viable y económicamente óptima para Sulzer.

• Gestión de Proveedores: Buscar, evaluar y negociar con proveedores de servicios externos para mejorar los márgenes de los proyectos y reducir costos operativos.

• Coordinación Interna (S&OP): Trabajar estrechamente con los Supervisores de los Centros de Servicios y el Planificador para validar la disponibilidad de recursos y los tiempos de entrega (Lead Times) antes de enviar ofertas.

• Optimización de Planillas y Herramientas: Desarrollar y mantener herramientas de cálculo (Excel avanzado/Software) que permitan estandarizar los precios y acelerar el tiempo de respuesta al cliente.

• Uso de ERP (SAP): Ingresar y gestionar las cotizaciones en el sistema, asegurando la correcta carga de datos para la posterior conversión en órdenes de venta.

• Seguimiento y Mejora Continua: Analizar la tasa de éxito de las ofertas enviadas y proponer ajustes en la estrategia de precios para mejorar la competitividad en el mercado minero e industrial.

Requisitos y Cualificaciones

• Educación: Ingeniero Civil o Ejecución Mecánica (Excluyente)

• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia demostrable en áreas de servicio técnico, mantenimiento o ingeniería de propuestas para equipos rotativos de alta complejidad.

• Disponibilidad: Disponibilidad para viajar (30%) a los centros de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción para relevamiento técnico de proyectos complejos.

Conocimientos Técnicos

• Sólidos conocimientos en sistemas de bombeo e hidráulica aplicada.

• Habilidad para interpretar planos de fabricación y hojas de datos técnicos.

• Experiencia en evaluación de daños y reportabilidad técnica.

• Capacidad de negociación con proveedores.

• Excel avanzado (macros y tablas dinámicas) para modelamiento de costos.

• Deseable manejo de SAP u otros ERP industriales.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos

• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.

• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro de salud y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Final Inspection Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Sub

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo A Sulzer, non produciamo solo pompe: progettiamo e costruiamo attrezzature critiche che mantengono industrie vitali in movimento in tutto il mondo. Dalla produzione di energia e dalle infrastrutture idriche all'energia, ai prodotti chimici e alla lavorazione industriale, le nostre pompe sono affidabili in alcune delle applicazioni più esigenti del mondo. La nostra struttura Leeds è uno dei centri di produzione di pompe di punta di Sulzer, che combina decenni di esperienza ingegneristica con la moderna tecnologia di produzione a seguito di significativi investimenti e ristrutturazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un'esperta struttura di produzione di Leeds, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni pacchetto di pompe lasci il nostro sito rispettando i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo non è un tipico ruolo di ispezione. Potrai lavorare insieme a team che progettano, producono, assemblano e testano alcune delle più grandi e più tecnicamente avanzate pompe del settore. Alcuni dei nostri prodotti pesano fino a 150 tonnellate, richiedendo un coordinamento eccezionale, precisione e eccellenza ingegneristica per portarli dal concetto alla consegna del cliente. Cosa farai
• Le principali attività di ispezione finale per pacchetti di pompaggio completi e attrezzature rotanti.
• Coordinamento del processo di verifica del montaggio finale prima dell'invio del cliente.
• Revisione e approvazione dei record di produzione finali e documentazione di qualità.
• Garantire i prodotti conformi agli standard ISO 9001 e ai requisiti di qualità interna.
• Verificare che siano state soddisfatte tutte le specifiche del cliente, i requisiti tecnici e gli obblighi contrattuali.
• Sorvegliare e firmare pacchetti di pompa completa e assemblaggi a albero nudo.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management e Quality per risolvere i problemi e garantire la consegna in tempo reale.
• Sostenere le ispezioni dei clienti e le attività di testimone ove necessario.
• Guidare una cultura di qualità, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo attraverso l'operazione. Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza all'interno di ingegneria pesante, attrezzature rotanti, pompe, turbine, motori o ambienti di produzione simili.
• Forte comprensione dei processi di controllo finale, garanzia della qualità e controllo della documentazione.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della qualità ISO 9001.
• Capacità di interpretare disegni di ingegneria, specifiche e documentazione di fabbricazione.
• Esperienza di coordinamento ispezioni che coinvolgono prodotti di grandi dimensioni e complessi ingegnerizzati.
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità organizzative.
• Un approccio proattivo con la fiducia di prendere decisioni di qualità critiche. Cosa ti offriamo Vantaggi del nucleo
• Uno stipendio competitivo
• Un ampio programma di bonus aziendale
• 33 giorni di vacanza
• Sarete idonei ad aderire al piano di cassa Medicash della Società, che vi permette di rivendicare il costo delle spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP.

• Opzione di abbonamento Costco

• Supporto delle Forze Armate – Come titolare del Premio d'Argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, sosteniamo attivamente veterani, reservisti e Volontari per adulti Cadet. De la production d'électricité et de l'infrastructure de l'eau à l'énergie, aux produits chimiques et à la transformation industrielle, nos pompes font confiance à certaines des applications les plus exigeantes au monde. • Expérience de l'ingénierie lourde, des équipements rotatifs, des pompes, des turbines, des moteurs ou des environnements de fabrication similaires.
• Bonne compréhension des processus d'inspection finale, d'assurance de la qualité et de contrôle de la documentation.
• Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la qualité ISO 9001.
• Capacité d'interpréter les dessins techniques, les spécifications et la documentation de fabrication.

The Regional Sales Manager is accountable for shaping and executing Sulzer Pumps’ channel strategy for the Metals & Mining market across North America. This role provides commercial leadership to drive profitable growth, deepen engagement with end users, EPCs, and channel partners, expand Sulzer’s installed base, and accelerate aftermarket revenue across the region.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Growth Leadership: Lead regional growth initiatives by developing and executing a Metals & Mining strategy aligned with Sulzer Pumps’ commercial priorities and long-term objectives.

Executive Customer Engagement: Build and strengthen strategic relationships with mining operators, processing facilities, and engineering firms to identify project opportunities and long-term account potential.

and joint engagement with channel partners to expand pipeline and convert priority opportunities.

Critical Success Factors
Deep understanding of pump applications within mining, mineral processing, and metals operations.
Demonstrated ability to deliver growth through both direct and channel-led commercial models.
Strong capability in strategic account development, executive relationship management, and opportunity capture.
Excellent communication, leadership, and execution skills, with the ability to influence across internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

jobs.title: Workplace AI Architect
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

Definieren und regeln Sie die Einführung von KI in Workplace- und plattformbasierten Lösungen mit einem starken Fokus auf Out-of-the-Box-Funktionen, Integrationen und Sicherheit. Handeln Sie als Orchestrierungspunkt für Softwareentwicklung, Daten & Analytics, Geschäftsanwender und Plattformbesitzer und gewährleisten Sie ein konsistentes Routing von KI-Initiativen. Den Übergang von der Ad-hoc-Nutzung zu einer kontrollierten, skalierbaren Einführung durch klare Governance, Messung und Rückbelastung vorantreiben und KI als Erweiterung bestehender Plattformen und nicht als Parallelfunktion positionieren. • AI Lifecycle Management: Regulieren Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus, der Build, Veröffentlichung, Betrieb und Ruhestand umfasst; sicherstellen Sie Besitz, Inventar und Transparenz für jede KI-Lösung; erzwingen Sie umweltbasierte Kontrollen für Experimente, Verwaltung und Produktion.
• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Definieren Sie, wie der Geschäftswert von KI gemessen wird; erstellen und betreiben Sie ein Chargeback-Modell, damit der Verbrauch transparent ist und die Kosten dem konsumierenden Unternehmen entsprechen; treiben Sie die Annahme voran und verfolgen Sie sie mit der Wertrealisierung.
