Sul ruolo

Nell'ambito della nostra divisione Servizi, questa posizione supporta il responsabile delle vendite ENA Services e il responsabile delle vendite DACH con compiti amministrativi, operativi e di gestione aziendale di alta qualità. In questo ruolo, darai un contributo significativo al regolare svolgimento delle attività quotidiane coordinando la comunicazione, preparando report e documenti di presentazione, supportando le riunioni e garantendo una precisa manutenzione dei dati in Salesforce. Ciò consentirà ai nostri leader commerciali di concentrarsi sulle priorità strategiche e di contribuire in modo significativo all’efficienza dell’organizzazione dei servizi ENA.

Compiti

- Supportare la gestione delle vendite coordinando le riunioni, inclusa la creazione dell'ordine del giorno, i verbali e il monitoraggio delle questioni aperte
- Mantenimento di calendari, organizzazione di viaggi e assunzione di compiti amministrativi nelle attività quotidiane
- Creazione, preparazione e compilazione di report, panoramiche e documenti di presentazione
- Garantire un'elevata qualità dei dati in Salesforce attraverso manutenzione, aggiornamenti e controlli di completezza per ENA e DACH
- Ottenimento, compilazione ed elaborazione strutturata delle informazioni dai team di vendita regionali e dai centri di assistenza
- Preparazione dei documenti della riunione e fornitura tempestiva di informazioni e materiali pertinenti
- Supportare la collaborazione tra vendite, centri di assistenza e altre interfacce interne

Requisiti

- almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale pertinente in un ambiente commerciale, amministrativo o correlato alle vendite
- Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook
- Esperienza con Salesforce o un sistema CRM comparabile
- Formazione commerciale o laurea in ambito aziendale o amministrativo
- Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia parlata che scritta
- Modo di lavorare strutturato, indipendente e affidabile con elevate capacità organizzative e di definizione delle priorità
- Atteggiamento proattivo, elevato orientamento al servizio e aspetto professionale
- Comunicazione chiara e sicura ai vari livelli organizzativi
- Elevato livello di accuratezza, riservatezza e responsabilità
- Capacità di collaborare con team interfunzionali

Offriamo

- Stretta collaborazione con dirigenti commerciali esperti

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service & Installationstekniker till Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB
Vi söker service och installations tekniker till Sulzers växande servicecenter i Veddesta och Malmö. Gillar du att arbeta i en varierande vardag med både arbete i verkstadsmiljö och ute hos kund? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Om företaget

Sulzer är ett världsledande företag inom utveckling, tillverkning och service av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner. Våra kunder arbetar inom områden som olja, gas, vattenrening, gruvdrift och pappersindustri. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Vadstena och vi har kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm. Våra servicecenter finner du i Vadstena, Göteborg,Veddesta,Årsta, Karlstad, Piteå och Arlöv. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.sulzer.com

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sulzers servicecenter har framför allt kunder verksamma inom vatten- och avloppshantering. Din roll kommer i huvudsak bestå av montage, reparation och service av pumpar och pumpstationer. Arbetet utförs antingen i våra serviceverkstäder i Veddesta, Malmö eller direkt ute hos våra kunder, för att felsöka och åtgärda problem på plats. Som installations tekniker kommer du att jobba med ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer av pumpstationer, etc. Resor med övernattning kan förekomma samt även beredskap.

Administrativa uppgifter som ingår i tjänsten är bland annat handläggning av ordrar, skriva servicerapporter samt hantering av in- och ut leveranser.

Du blir en del av våra team som präglas av god stämning och sammanhållning. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna ytterligare en kollega.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som gillar att skruva, meka och lösa tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har läst ett tekniskt program på gymnasiet eller vidareutbildat dig inom området. Alternativt att du har erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Har du erfarenhete av svets arbeten och elinstallationer är det bra oxå. Du innehar körkortsbehörighet B och har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Branschvana

• Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem

• Truckkort

• Certifikat i heta arbeten

• Kunskaper inom el samt styr- och reglerteknik

Som person ser vi att du är engagerad och driven. Du är praktiskt lagd och tycker det är roligt att hitta tekniska lösningar. För dig är det enkelt att prata med både kollegor och kunder samtidigt som du jobbar strukturerat.

På Sulzer finns goda möjligheter till att utvecklas och växa i rollen så tveka inte - det kan vara här som din resa startar!

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%, provanställning tillämpas. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Missa inte chansen och ansök redan idag!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Helper Mechanic - Night Shift
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This position is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.

This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Helper Mechanic - Night Shift

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen
and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

About the role

Project Buyer with Supply Chain mindset to Nordic Water Products AB

You are a proactive and self-driven purchasing professional with experience from project-driven manufacturing or industrial environments. You combine strong analytical skills with commercial awareness and technical understanding, enabling you to manage complex sourcing activities and support successful project execution.

You have experience in project purchasing, supplier negotiations, and supply chain management, and are comfortable working closely with project managers, engineering, production, and suppliers. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a role with a high degree of independence.

As a person, you are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships, drives continuous improvement, and delivers results in a dynamic environment.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience in project purchasing within manufacturing or industrial businesses

• Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

• An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving

• Technical understanding and commercial acumen

• Knowledge of industrial manufacturing processes, sheet metal fabrication and stainless-steel products is meritorious

• A proactive mindset, ability to work independently, and strong teamwork skills

• Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining commercial responsibility, technical challenges, and project-driven work in a dynamic international environment.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Engineering Technician supports engineers in the design, modification, and improvement of products and processes. This includes testing, maintaining, and installing equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. SUMMARY:
The position is responsible for generating and maintaining manufacturing routers and production orders using engineering drawings, BOMs, technical specifications, and quality requirements. Utilizes knowledge of machining and manufacturing processes to establish the most efficient sequence of operations, supporting productivity, quality, cost-effectiveness, and on-time delivery.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Interpret design drawings and Bill of Material (BOM) technical & quality requirements to develop routings for the manufacturing of parts and assemblies tailored to the machining capabilities of the Sulzer Nuclear Service Center.

• Generates production work order packages for the manufacturing of pump replacement parts and assembly of new equipment pumps in accordance with facility capabilities, procedures, and Quality Assurance program requirements.

• Generates service order packages for the disassembly & inspection, and repair of pumps sent to the SNSC for refurbishment.

• Coordinates with Production Planners and Shop Supervisor to ensure that production and service orders are delivered in time to support shipment of assemblies, parts, and pumps to the customer on-time.

Les produits finis de l'ingénieur d'application comprendront des dessins CAO, des recommandations de produit combinées avec des capacités techniques de l'équipement JWC spécifique à l'application client. • Produire des dessins qui démontrent le placement de l'équipement JWC dans les processus du client

• 2-3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle face à la clientèle, idéalement travailler avec les équipes de vente ou de service à la clientèle

• Expérience de design industriel ou école a plus

• Joueur d'équipe, orienté objectif, excellent communicateur avec une bonne aptitude mécanique

• Profitez d'un environnement de travail rapide avec une communication en équipe constante

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. • Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Agir en tant que principal point focal technique pour les activités de compression de gaz au sein du centre de service.

• Aider l'équipe d'ingénierie à déterminer l'approche optimale de l'exécution des travaux.

• Fournir une expertise en dépannage pour les problèmes complexes de réparation et d'exploitation.

• Liaison étroite avec les collègues d'ingénierie et d'autres spécialistes techniques au besoin.

• Assister aux réunions des clients en tant que représentant technique pour les projets de compression de gaz.

• Accompagner les clients durant les activités de test de témoins, en leur fournissant des conseils techniques et un soutien.

• Présenter des résultats techniques, des recommandations et des solutions de réparation aux clients.

• Établir de solides relations avec la clientèle grâce à un soutien technique et à une expertise professionnelles.

• Examiner les résultats de l'atelier et formuler des recommandations pour les solutions de réparation.

• Participer aux enquêtes sur les défaillances dans les centres de services Sulzer et sur les sites clients.

• Fournir des conseils techniques, du coaching et de la formation aux équipes internes au besoin.

Ce que vous apportez

Compétences

• HNC, HND ou diplôme en génie mécanique ou une discipline connexe.

Expérience et connaissances techniques

• Expérience significative avec l'équipement de compression de gaz.

• Expérience d'ingénierie dans les équipements rotatifs, les turbomachines ou les industries connexes.

• Compréhension de l'analyse des vibrations et du diagnostic des machines.

• Expérience en préparation de rapports techniques et en présentation de recommandations techniques.

• Connaissance des méthodes de réparation et des pratiques d'enquête en cas d'échec.

Compétences et comportements

• Fortes compétences en influence et en persuasion.

• Confortable engagement avec les clients et présentation d'informations techniques.

• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication avec la capacité d'interagir à tous les niveaux.

• Compétences organisationnelles solides et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités.

• Compétences efficaces en gestion du temps avec souplesse pour s'adapter à l'évolution des exigences des entreprises.

• Une grande attention aux détails et à l'engagement envers la qualité.

• Capacité de travailler en collaboration entre les équipes multidisciplinaires.

• Utilisateur compétent de Microsoft Office, y compris Word, Excel et Outlook.

• Engagement à respecter les normes, procédures et exigences de sécurité de l'entreprise.

Le candidat retenu doit être disposé à se rendre sur les sites des clients et sur les sites de Sulzer au besoin, tant au Royaume-Uni qu'à l'étranger.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Finance team within the Division Services as Financial Analyst and support the Division FP&A manager and regional controllers with your financial analysis.
In this role you will:

• Support the Division FP&A and regional controllers by delivering comprehensive, complete, and timely financial information for the purpose of business management and decision making

• Enhance and develop new reports in Tagetik and drive BI tool solutions (QlikSense and Sharepoint) to improve processes and drive automatization

• Perform month-end closing activities incl. proper financial analysis on actuals vs. budget and prior month forecast

• Ensure timely submission of legal entities reporting packages and according to Sulzer standards. Support entities in reporting related issues

• Be the Services division point of contact for reporting matters in Tagetik and provide training to legal entities worldwide

• Perform various ad-hoc reporting requests to ease division financials understanding

• Contribute to the monthly preparation of the MIS presentation

• Monitor and control HQ Cost Centres and CAPEX spending

• Actively support in the Budgeting and Forecasting processes

• Support cash forecasting

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Business Administration with a specialization in Accounting, Finance or Controlling

• Three years of experience in financial analysis or controlling, preferably in corporate finance

• Good knowledge of Tagetik with experience in report building

• Advanced financial modelling skills (Excel) and strong knowledge of PowerPoint

• Experience with SAP (FI/CO modules) and business application tools

• Analytically strong person with high energy to drive for result

• Strong problem solving and ability to prioritize responsibilities, tasks and processes

• A flexible and adaptive team player with a positive attitude

• Fluency in English

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Nuevos Ministerios

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Treten Sie unserem Finanzteam innerhalb der Division Services als Financial Analyst bei und unterstützen Sie den Division FP&A Manager und die regionalen Controller bei Ihrer Finanzanalyse.
In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Unterstützen Sie die Division FP&A und die regionalen Controller durch die Bereitstellung umfassender, vollständiger und zeitnaher Finanzinformationen zum Zweck der Unternehmensführung und Entscheidungsfindung

• Verbesserung und Entwicklung neuer Berichte in Tagetik und Drive BI-Toollösungen (QlikSense und Sharepoint) zur Verbesserung von Prozessen und zur Automatisierung von Antrieben

• Durchführung von Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende inkl. einer ordnungsgemäßen Finanzanalyse der Istwerte vs. des Budgets und der Prognose des Vormonats

• Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Übermittlung von Meldepaketen für juristische Personen gemäß den Sulzer-Standards. Unterstützung von Stellen bei der Berichterstattung in Bezug auf Probleme

• Seien Sie der Service-Bereich Ansprechpartner für Reporting-Angelegenheiten in Tagetik und schulen Sie Rechtspersonen weltweit

• Führen Sie verschiedene Ad-hoc-Berichtsanforderungen durch, um das Verständnis der Abteilungsfinanzen zu erleichtern

• Beitrag zur monatlichen Vorbereitung der MIS-Präsentation

• Überwachung und Kontrolle von HQ Cost Centers und CAPEX Ausgaben

• Aktive Unterstützung in den Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozessen

• Unterstützung Cash Forecasting

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft mit Spezialisierung auf Rechnungswesen, Finanzen oder Controlling

• Drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Finanzanalyse oder im Controlling, vorzugsweise im Corporate Finance

• Gute Kenntnisse von Tagetik mit Erfahrung im Berichtsaufbau

• Fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten in der Finanzmodellierung (Excel) und fundierte Kenntnisse in PowerPoint

• Erfahrung mit SAP (FI/CO Module) und Business Application Tools

• Analytisch starke Person mit hoher Energie für das Ergebnis zu fahren

• Starke Problemlösung und Fähigkeit, Verantwortlichkeiten, Aufgaben und Prozesse zu priorisieren

• Ein flexibler und adaptiver Teamplayer mit einer positiven Einstellung

• Fluency in Englisch

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie die Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.

• Essensgutscheine.

jobs.title: Runner/Shop Helper
jobs.description:

About the role

The Runner/Shop Helper supports the Alvin, TX daily warehouse operations under supervision by assisting personnel with routine tasks. This entry-level role focuses on safely performing basic duties while developing proficiency in equipment operation. The position also requires driving a company vehicle to various locations to pick up materials. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Keep the shop clean, safe and organized.

• Transport parts between Alvin and La Porte facilities with company owned vehicle

• Transport parts by forklift to various locations on the property as needed.

• Practice Lean principles in daily work participate in LEAN events.

• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safest working and continual improvement.

Requirements:

• Must have transportation to the Alvin, TX location

• Clean driving record

• Forklift experience is preferred, not required.

• Experience in a warehouse setting.

• Willing to work weekends and OT when needed.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments. Determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements.
Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Develop and lead the regional procurement strategy, objectives, governance and processes for Services across the Middle East & CIS region, covering all product lines including pump services, turbomachinery services, electromechanical services, spare parts, retrofits and field/site services. The role aligns regional procurement priorities with division, global SCM and business strategies, while supporting the needs of service centres, legal entities and project execution teams. It is accountable for improving supplier performance, reducing Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), improving On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, shortening lead times, strengthening contract coverage and reducing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Main tasks:

• Develop regional procurement strategy, objectives and processes for the Services division across Middle East & CIS, in accordance with Sulzer procurement guidelines.

• Align regional priorities with Global Services SCM, division procurement and local business requirements.

• Develop and maintain a high-performance procurement culture that improves KPI delivery and customer service to internal and external stakeholders.

• Work across the division matrix organization, balancing global category strategies, regional needs, local legal entity requirements and service centre execution priorities.

• Deliver regional procurement benefits, savings, cost avoidance and supplier performance improvements across all service product lines.

• Provide specialist advice, guidance and service on leading practice procurement to the region.

• Manage long-term partnerships with key strategic suppliers, in alignment with division procurement, based on quality, cost, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and regional service requirements.

• Assess, qualify and select regional suppliers in close cooperation with product line, service centre, project execution and legal entity teams.

• Drafting of regional framework agreements and execution of contract management

• Coordinate procurement development activities, e.g.: governance, new tools digital developments, e-procurement, supplier development, supplier risk, ESG.

• Standardization and monitoring the procurement processes

• Build and maintain a strong regional network with legal entity procurement managers and operational stakeholders across Middle East & CIS.

Competencies required:

• Result oriented

• Effectively develop and manage the team

• Strong leadership skills

• Excellent communication skills and even better listening skills

• Drive & Motivation

• Willingness and capability to lead discussions and make decisions

• Familiarity with relevant legislative and regulatory requirements, as well as standard contractual terms and conditions

• Strategic mindset and problem-solving skills

• In-depth knowledge of sourcing and procurement principles and best practices

• Strong negotiation skills to use for large commercial deals

• Experience with modern category management, sourcing and procurement systems

• Willingness to travel

Qualifications & Experience Required:
Education requirements:

• Educated to degree level in supply chain management, economics, finance, operations, engineering, or a related area, with a master’s degree preferred

Job experience:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in regional procurement, senior supply management, or operations experience

• Proven track record of delivering large savings and other value to large swaths of spend via a strong team of employees

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical , language, safety):

• Knowledge of customs legislation and procedures

• Familiar with the major ERP systems

• Fluent in English

• Supplier Management Knowledge
(OTIF, Lead-times, Safety Stocks, MOQ, Supplier As

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Élaborer et diriger la stratégie, les objectifs, la gouvernance et les processus d'approvisionnement régionaux pour les services dans la région du Moyen-Orient et de la CEI, qui couvre toutes les gammes de produits, y compris les services de pompes, les services de turbomachines, les services électromécaniques, les pièces de rechange, les rénovations et les services sur le terrain et sur place. Ce rôle aligne les priorités régionales en matière d'approvisionnement sur les stratégies de division, de gestion globale des marchés et d'affaires, tout en répondant aux besoins des centres de services, des entités juridiques et des équipes chargées de l'exécution des projets. Il est responsable de l'amélioration de la performance des fournisseurs, de la réduction du coût de la mauvaise qualité (COPQ), de l'amélioration de la livraison à temps plein (OTIF), de la réduction des délais d'exécution, du renforcement de la couverture contractuelle et de la réduction du coût total de la propriété (TCO). Principales tâches:

• Élaborer une stratégie, des objectifs et des processus d'approvisionnement régionaux pour la division des services du Moyen-Orient et du SIC, conformément aux lignes directrices sur les achats de Sulzer.

• Alignez les priorités régionales sur les besoins de la SCM des services mondiaux, des approvisionnements des divisions et des activités locales.

• Élaborer et maintenir une culture d'approvisionnement à haut rendement qui améliore la prestation de l'ICP et le service à la clientèle aux intervenants internes et externes.

• Travailler dans l'ensemble de l'organisation de la matrice de division, en conciliant les stratégies de catégorie mondiale, les besoins régionaux, les exigences des entités juridiques locales et les priorités d'exécution des centres de services.

• Offrir des avantages d'approvisionnement régionaux, des économies, des économies et des améliorations du rendement des fournisseurs dans toutes les gammes de produits de service.

• Fournir des conseils, des conseils et des services spécialisés sur les pratiques exemplaires d'achat dans la région.

• Gérer les partenariats à long terme avec les principaux fournisseurs stratégiques, en conformité avec l'approvisionnement des divisions, en fonction de la qualité, des coûts, du FITO, de la réactivité, de la conformité et des exigences des services régionaux.

• Évaluer, qualifier et sélectionner des fournisseurs régionaux en étroite collaboration avec la gamme de produits, le centre de services, l'exécution de projets et les équipes de personnes morales.

• Élaboration d ' accords-cadres régionaux et exécution de la gestion des contrats

• Coordonner les activités de développement des achats, p. ex. gouvernance, nouveaux outils développements numériques, achats électroniques, développement des fournisseurs, risque des fournisseurs, ESG.

• Normalisation et suivi des procédures d ' achat

• Mettre en place et maintenir un solide réseau régional avec les responsables des achats des entités juridiques et les intervenants opérationnels du Moyen-Orient et de la CEI.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et encore mieux en écoute

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Global BU Operations Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Global BU Operations Controller , you will drive and coordinate operational controlling activities across our global manufacturing footprint, acting as a trusted business partner to Operations leadership. You will provide financial insights, performance analysis, and strategic guidance to support decision-making, while leading the Operations Controlling team and ensuring alignment with business objectives.

In this role you will:

• Drive operational and cost analysis for the BU at the Operations (factory) level (be responsible end-to-end for all controlling/business partnering aspects of the BU at Operations level); support cost accounting, assist in actuals and forecast analysis, develop and maintain the overall reporting framework for the BU at Operations level, support the resolution of complex issues, be ultimately responsible for the Controlling team for all factory LEs, support ERP system developments, and ensure compliance with global policies.

• Oversee and coordinate the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes at Operations level.

• Deliver effective and timely communication to the BU FICO Head and other internal or external stakeholders.

• Create and monitor governance procedures to maintain a core set of management reports (e.g. DOA, control matrix, etc.).

• Be accountable for the production of core finance management reporting and analysis.

• Coordinate with Legal to ensure that risk management policies and procedures are implemented and managed appropriately.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the controlling function.

• Monitor and develop monthly reports for revenues and expenditures of a factory and all factory sites consolidated; manage and steer factory costs; assist in the analysis of NWC balances.

• Perform continuous project improvement analysis, new product development analysis, strategic sourcing analysis, and other ad-hoc analyses.

• Provide production and cost information required to perform the end-to-end financial close and internal reporting process.

• Provide inputs for the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes for the Finance organization.

• Provide key operational decision-makers with accurate and timely financial information, leading to the minimization of costs and the maximization of profitability.

• Empower the Operations Team to manage the day-to-day aspects of the processes, providing operational steering.

• Liaise with Procurement regarding order intake.

• Allocate resources to the production process.

• Support the GPOs in establishing procedures for the Cost Accounting function, including the selection and implementation of relevant reporting and tools.

• Deliver effective and timely communication on all relevant issues to internal and external stakeholders.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the Cost Accounting function.

• Drive the implementation of DXC and Financial Services within Operational LEs.

To succeed you need:

Experience & Education

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 9 years of relevant professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Business Partnering roles.

• Previous management experience, with a proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

• Prior experience in an Engineering and/or Manufacturing environment is essential.

• Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and presentation skills.

• Excellent analytical capabilities, combined with stron

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come Global BU Operations Controller , guiderai e coordinerai le attività di controllo operativo attraverso la nostra impronta produttiva globale, agendo come partner commerciale di fiducia nella leadership Operazioni. Fornirai informazioni finanziarie, analisi delle prestazioni e guida strategica per supportare il processo decisionale, mentre guiderai il team Operations Controlling e garantirai l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

In questo ruolo sarete:

• Guidare l'analisi operativa e dei costi per la BU a livello Operazioni (fattoria) (essere responsabile end-to-end per tutti gli aspetti di controllo/business partnering della BU a livello Operazioni); sostenere la contabilità dei costi, assistere in effetti e analisi delle previsioni, sviluppare e mantenere il quadro generale di reporting per il BU a livello Operazioni, sostenere la risoluzione di problemi complessi, essere in ultima analisi responsabile per il team di controllo di tutte le LEs di fabbrica, sostenere gli sviluppi del sistema ERP e garantire la conformità a livello globale.

• Controllare e coordinare i processi di pianificazione, di bilancio e di previsione a livello Operazioni.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva al BU FICO Head e ad altri stakeholder interni o esterni.

• Creare e monitorare le procedure di governance per mantenere un insieme centrale di rapporti di gestione (ad esempio DOA, matrice di controllo, ecc.).

• Essere responsabile per la produzione di core finanza gestione reporting e analisi.

• Coordinamento con Legale per garantire che le politiche e le procedure di gestione dei rischi siano implementate e gestite in modo appropriato.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione di controllo.

• Monitorare e sviluppare relazioni mensili per le entrate e le spese di una fabbrica e di tutti i siti di fabbrica consolidati; gestire e sostenere i costi di fabbrica; assistere nell'analisi dei bilanci NWC.

• Eseguire l'analisi continua del miglioramento del progetto, la nuova analisi dello sviluppo del prodotto, l'analisi strategica di approvvigionamento e altre analisi ad-hoc.

• Fornire informazioni di produzione e di costo necessarie per eseguire il processo di reporting finanziario end-to-end chiuso e interno.

• Fornire input per la pianificazione, il bilancio e i processi di previsione per l'organizzazione Finance.

• Fornire i decisori operativi chiave con informazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, portando alla minimizzazione dei costi e alla massimizzazione della redditività.

• Favorire il Team Operazioni per gestire gli aspetti quotidiani dei processi, fornendo sterzo operativo.

• Liaise with Procurement about the order intake.

• Allocare le risorse al processo di produzione.

• Sostenere i GPO nell'elaborazione di procedure per la funzione Accounting Cost, compresa la selezione e l'implementazione di report e strumenti pertinenti.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva su tutte le questioni rilevanti per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione Cost Accounting.

• Guidare l'implementazione di DXC e servizi finanziari all'interno di LE Operative.

Per avere successo è necessario:

Esperienza e istruzione

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo di 9 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nei ruoli di finanza, controllo o Business Partnering.

• Esperienza di gestione precedente, con una comprovata capacità di guidare e sviluppare team di alto livello.

• L'esperienza prioritaria in un ambiente di Ingegneria e/o Produzione è essenziale.

• Capacità linguistiche fluenti, sia scritte che parlate.

Competenze e competenze

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli, sia internamente che esternamente.

• Forte negoziazione, influenza e capacità di presentazione.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche, combinato con stron

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Als Global BU Operations Controller werden Sie die operativen Controlling-Aktivitäten in unserer globalen Fertigung vorantreiben und koordinieren und als vertrauenswürdiger Geschäftspartner für die Unternehmensführung fungieren. Sie bieten finanzielle Einblicke, Leistungsanalysen und strategische Leitlinien zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung, während Sie das Operations Controlling-Team leiten und die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele sicherstellen.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Betriebs- und Kostenanalyse für die BU auf der Ebene des Betriebs (Fabrik) vorantreiben (Ende-zu-Ende für alle Controlling- / Business-Partnering-Aspekte der BU auf Betriebsebene verantwortlich sein); Kostenrechnung unterstützen, bei der Ist- und Prognoseanalyse unterstützen, den gesamten Berichtsrahmen für die BU auf Betriebsebene entwickeln und pflegen, die Lösung komplexer Probleme unterstützen, letztlich für das Controlling-Team für alle Werks-LEs verantwortlich sein, ERP-Systementwicklungen unterstützen und die Einhaltung globaler Richtlinien sicherstellen.

• Beaufsichtigen und koordinieren Sie die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse auf operativer Ebene.

• Liefern Sie effektive und zeitnahe Kommunikation an den BU FICO Head und andere interne oder externe Stakeholder.

• Erstellen und Überwachen von Governance-Verfahren, um einen Kernsatz von Managementberichten zu verwalten (z. B. DOA, Kontrollmatrix usw.).

• Seien Sie rechenschaftspflichtig für die Erstellung von Berichten und Analysen zum Kernfinanzmanagement.

• Koordination mit Legal, um sicherzustellen, dass Risikomanagementrichtlinien und -verfahren angemessen umgesetzt und verwaltet werden.

• Identifizieren und verwalten Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen für die Controlling-Funktion.

• Überwachung und Entwicklung monatlicher Berichte über Einnahmen und Ausgaben einer Fabrik und aller Fabrikstandorte konsolidiert; Verwaltung und Steuerung der Fabrikkosten; Unterstützung bei der Analyse der NWC-Salden.

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Projektverbesserungsanalysen, neue Produktentwicklungsanalysen, strategische Beschaffungsanalysen und andere Ad-hoc-Analysen durch.

• Bereitstellung von Produktions- und Kosteninformationen, die für die Durchführung des End-to-End-Finanzabschlusses und des internen Berichterstattungsprozesses erforderlich sind.

• Geben Sie Inputs für die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse für die Finanzorganisation.

• Geben Sie wichtigen operativen Entscheidungsträgern genaue und zeitnahe Finanzinformationen, die zur Kostenminimierung und Maximierung der Rentabilität führen.

• Befähigen Sie das Operations-Team, die täglichen Aspekte der Prozesse zu verwalten und die operative Steuerung bereitzustellen.

• Verbindung mit der Beschaffung bezüglich des Auftragseingangs.

jobs.title: Fabricator/Welder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled Fabricator/Welder to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be proficient in MIG and TIG welding, with extensive experience welding stainless steel and fabricating complex assemblies. This role requires strong blueprint-reading skills, the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication challenges, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while maintaining a safe work environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform high-quality MIG and TIG welding on stainless steel components and assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, weld procedures, and work instructions.

• Read, interpret, and work from blueprints, fabrication drawings, specifications, and welding process requirements.

• Lay out, measure, mark, cut, fit, and form materials to meet dimensional and quality specifications.

• Fabricate, assemble, and repair metal components and equipment using appropriate welding and fabrication techniques.

• Troubleshoot complex fabrication and assembly issues, utilizing technical expertise and sound judgment to develop effective solutions.

• Perform self-inspections throughout the fabrication process to ensure parts and assemblies conform to print requirements, tolerances, and quality standards.

• Set up and adjust welding equipment, tooling, and welding parameters according to work specifications.

• Perform routine inspections, calibration verification, cleaning, and basic maintenance of welding equipment, machines, torches, cables, and related tools.

• Identify equipment defects and coordinate or perform minor repairs as appropriate to maintain safe and efficient operation.

• Safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to move, position, and secure materials.

• Repair worn or damaged metal components by welding and rebuilding surfaces as required.

• Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing, and soldering equipment.

• Complete required production, quality, and maintenance documentation accurately and timely.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including equipment, tools, materials, and workstations.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures, including machine safety requirements, environmental regulations, and applicable federal, state, and local health and safety standards.

• Actively participate in company safety initiatives, hazard identification activities, and continuous improvement programs.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of fabrication and welding experience in a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated proficiency in MIG and TIG welding, with a strong emphasis on stainless steel.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and fabrication specifications.

• Strong fabrication skills including material layout, cutting, fitting, forming, and assembly.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex build and fabrication challenges.

• Experience safely operating overhead cranes; forklift experience preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, kneel, reach, push, pull, and lift materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work safely around welding equipment, cranes, and industrial machinery while wearing required PPE.

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, heat, sparks, and welding fumes.

Preferred Qualifications

• AWS welding certification or equivalent.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un Fabricator/Welder altamente qualificato per unirsi al nostro team di produzione. Il candidato di successo sarà abile nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una vasta esperienza di saldatura in acciaio inossidabile e assemblaggi complessi. Questo ruolo richiede forti competenze di lettura della stampa, la capacità di risolvere e risolvere le sfide di fabbricazione, e un impegno a produrre lavoro di alta qualità, mantenendo un ambiente di lavoro sicuro. Duità e responsabilità essenziali

• Eseguire la saldatura MIG e TIG di alta qualità su componenti e assemblaggi in acciaio inossidabile in conformità con disegni di ingegneria, procedure di saldatura e istruzioni di lavoro.

• Leggere, interpretare e lavorare da progetti, disegni di fabbricazione, specifiche e requisiti di processo di saldatura.

• Allacciare, misurare, marcare, tagliare, adattare e formare materiali per soddisfare le specifiche dimensionali e di qualità.

• Realizzare, assemblare e riparare componenti e attrezzature metalliche utilizzando tecniche di saldatura e fabbricazione appropriate.

• Risoluzione problemi complessi problemi di fabbricazione e montaggio, utilizzando competenze tecniche e giudizio sonoro per sviluppare soluzioni efficaci.

• Eseguire le auto-ispezione durante tutto il processo di fabbricazione per garantire parti e assemblaggi conformi a requisiti di stampa, tolleranze e standard di qualità.

• Impostare e regolare le attrezzature di saldatura, utensili e parametri di saldatura secondo le specifiche di lavoro.

• Eseguire ispezioni di routine, verifica della calibrazione, pulizia e manutenzione di base di attrezzature di saldatura, macchine, torce, cavi e strumenti correlati.

• Identificare i difetti dell'apparecchiatura e coordinare o eseguire riparazioni minori nel modo appropriato per mantenere un funzionamento sicuro ed efficiente.

• Azionare in modo sicuro gru a testa alta, carrelli elevatori e altri dispositivi di manipolazione del materiale per spostare, posizionare e proteggere i materiali.

• Riparare i componenti metallici usurati o danneggiati, saldando e ricostruendo le superfici come richiesto.

• Assistere con la manutenzione e la riparazione di saldatura, brasatura e attrezzature di saldatura.

• Completa la documentazione di produzione, qualità e manutenzione richiesta con precisione e tempestiva.

• Mantenere una zona di lavoro pulita, organizzata e sicura, tra cui attrezzature, strumenti, materiali e postazioni di lavoro.

• Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza dell'azienda, compresi i requisiti di sicurezza della macchina, le normative ambientali e gli standard federali, statali e locali per la salute e la sicurezza.

• Partecipa attivamente a iniziative di sicurezza aziendale, attività di identificazione dei rischi e programmi di miglioramento continuo.

• Eseguire altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza di fabbricazione e saldatura in un ambiente di produzione.

• Dimostrata competenza nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una forte enfasi sull'acciaio inossidabile.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare i progetti, disegni tecnici e specifiche di fabbricazione.

• Forti capacità di fabbricazione tra cui layout di materiale, taglio, montaggio, formazione e assemblaggio.

• Capacità di risolvere e risolvere complesse sfide di costruzione e di fabbricazione.

• Esperienza di funzionamento sicuro gru a soffitto; esperienza carrello elevatore preferito.

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno nella lavorazione della qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente di produzione veloce.

Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di stare e camminare per lunghi periodi durante la giornata di lavoro.

• Capacità di piegare, ginocchiare, raggiungere, spingere, tirare e sollevare materiali fino a 50 libbre.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo sicuro intorno alle apparecchiature di saldatura, gru e macchinari industriali durante l'usura del PPE richiesto.

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di produzione con esposizione a rumore, calore, scintille e fumi di saldatura.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Certificazione di saldatura AWS o equivalente.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Hersteller/Welder, der unserem Produktionsteam beitritt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das MIG- und WIG-Schweißen beherrschen, mit umfangreicher Erfahrung beim Schweißen von Edelstahl und der Herstellung komplexer Baugruppen. Diese Rolle erfordert starke Blueprint-Lesefähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche und Lösung von Fertigungsherausforderungen sowie die Verpflichtung, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeiten zu produzieren und gleichzeitig eine sichere Arbeitsumgebung zu gewährleisten. Wesentliche Pflichten und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Führen Sie hochwertiges MIG- und TIG-Schweißen auf Edelstahlkomponenten und -baugruppen gemäß technischen Zeichnungen, Schweißverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen durch.

• Lesen, Interpretieren und Arbeiten von Blaupausen, Fertigungszeichnungen, Spezifikationen und Schweißprozessanforderungen.

• Legen, messen, markieren, schneiden, passen und formen Sie Materialien, um Dimensions- und Qualitätsspezifikationen zu erfüllen.

• Herstellung, Montage und Reparatur von Metallkomponenten und -geräten unter Verwendung geeigneter Schweiß- und Fertigungstechniken.

• Beheben Sie komplexe Herstellungs- und Montageprobleme, indem Sie technisches Fachwissen und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen nutzen, um effektive Lösungen zu entwickeln.

• Führen Sie während des gesamten Herstellungsprozesses Selbstinspektionen durch, um sicherzustellen, dass Teile und Baugruppen den Druckanforderungen, Toleranzen und Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

• Einrichten und Anpassen von Schweißgeräten, Werkzeugen und Schweißparametern gemäß Arbeitsspezifikationen.

• Führen Sie Routineinspektionen, Kalibrierungsprüfung, Reinigung und grundlegende Wartung von Schweißgeräten, Maschinen, Brennern, Kabeln und verwandten Werkzeugen durch.

• Identifizieren Sie Gerätefehler und koordinieren oder führen Sie kleinere Reparaturen durch, um einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Betreiben Sie sicher Overhead-Krane, Gabelstapler und andere Materialfördergeräte, um Materialien zu bewegen, zu positionieren und zu sichern.

• Reparieren Sie verschlissene oder beschädigte Metallteile durch Schweißen und Rekonstruktion von Oberflächen nach Bedarf.

• Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Reparatur von Schweiß-, Löt- und Lötgeräten.

• Vervollständigen Sie die erforderliche Produktions-, Qualitäts- und Wartungsdokumentation genau und zeitnah.

• Pflegen Sie einen sauberen, organisierten und sicheren Arbeitsbereich, einschließlich Ausrüstung, Werkzeuge, Materialien und Arbeitsstationen.

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren des Unternehmens, einschließlich der Anforderungen an die Maschinensicherheit, der Umweltvorschriften und der geltenden Bundes-, Landes- und lokalen Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards.

• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Sicherheitsinitiativen des Unternehmens, Aktivitäten zur Gefahrenidentifizierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprogrammen.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben und spezielle Projekte wie zugewiesen durch.

Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Fertigungs- und Schweißerfahrung in einer Fertigungsumgebung.

• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in MIG und TIG Schweißen, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Edelstahl.

• Fähigkeit, Blaupausen, technische Zeichnungen und Fertigungsspezifikationen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Starke Fertigungsfähigkeiten einschließlich Materiallayout, Schneiden, Passen, Formen und Montage.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Build- und Fertigungsherausforderungen zu beheben und zu beheben.

• Erleben Sie sicher arbeitende Overhead-Krane; Gabelstapler Erfahrung bevorzugt.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für hochwertige Verarbeitung.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Fertigungsumgebung zu arbeiten.

Physikalische Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, während des Arbeitstages längere Zeit zu stehen und zu gehen.

• Fähigkeit, sich häufig zu beugen, zu knien, zu erreichen, zu schieben, zu ziehen und Materialien bis zu 50 Pfund zu heben.

• Die Fähigkeit, sicher um Schweißgeräte, Kräne und Industriemaschinen zu arbeiten, während das Tragen erfordert PSA.

• Fähigkeit, in einer Fertigungsumgebung mit Lärm, Hitze, Funken und Schweißdämpfen zu arbeiten.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• AWS Schweißzertifizierung oder gleichwertig.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Nous recherchons un fabricant/soudeur hautement qualifié pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Le candidat retenu sera compétent en soudage MIG et TIG, avec une vaste expérience de soudage en acier inoxydable et de fabrication d'assemblages complexes. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en lecture de plans, la capacité de résoudre les problèmes de fabrication et de les résoudre, ainsi qu'un engagement à produire un travail de haute qualité tout en maintenant un environnement de travail sécuritaire. Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Effectuez un soudage MIG et TIG de haute qualité sur des composants et des assemblages en acier inoxydable conformément aux plans techniques, aux procédures de soudage et aux instructions de travail.

• Lire, interpréter et travailler à partir de plans, de dessins de fabrication, de spécifications et de procédés de soudage.

• Disposer, mesurer, marquer, couper, monter et former des matériaux pour répondre aux spécifications dimensionnelles et de qualité.

• Fabrication, montage et réparation de composants et d'équipements métalliques à l'aide de techniques appropriées de soudage et de fabrication.

• Dépanner les problèmes complexes de fabrication et d'assemblage, en utilisant l'expertise technique et le jugement solide pour développer des solutions efficaces.

• Effectuer des auto-inspections tout au long du processus de fabrication pour s'assurer que les pièces et les assemblages sont conformes aux exigences d'impression, aux tolérances et aux normes de qualité.

• Mettre en place et ajuster l'équipement de soudage, l'outillage et les paramètres de soudage selon les spécifications de travail.

• Effectuer des inspections de routine, la vérification de l'étalonnage, le nettoyage et l'entretien de base des équipements de soudage, des machines, des torches, des câbles et des outils connexes.

• Identifier les défauts de l'équipement et coordonner ou effectuer des réparations mineures, selon le cas, pour assurer un fonctionnement sûr et efficace.

• Utilisez en toute sécurité des grues, des chariots élévateurs et d'autres équipements de manutention des matériaux pour déplacer, positionner et sécuriser les matériaux.

• Réparation des composants métalliques usés ou endommagés par soudage et reconstruction des surfaces au besoin.

• Aider à l'entretien et à la réparation du matériel de soudage, de brasage et de soudure.

• Remplir la documentation requise sur la production, la qualité et la maintenance avec exactitude et en temps opportun.

• Maintenir une zone de travail propre, organisée et sécuritaire, y compris l'équipement, les outils, les matériaux et les postes de travail.

• Suivez toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité de l'entreprise, y compris les exigences de sécurité des machines, les règlements environnementaux et les normes de santé et de sécurité fédérales, étatiques et locales applicables.

• Participer activement aux initiatives de sécurité de l'entreprise, aux activités d'identification des dangers et aux programmes d'amélioration continue.

• Exécuter d'autres tâches et des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.

Qualifications requises

• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience de fabrication et de soudage dans un environnement de fabrication.

• Compétence démontrée en matière de soudage MIG et TIG, avec un accent particulier sur l'acier inoxydable.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des plans, des dessins techniques et des spécifications de fabrication.

• Fortes compétences en fabrication, y compris la disposition des matériaux, la coupe, le montage, le formage et l'assemblage.

• Capacité de résoudre les problèmes complexes de construction et de fabrication.

• Expérimentez des grues aériennes en toute sécurité; expérience de chariot élévateur préféré.

• Pleine attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur d'un travail de qualité.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe dans un environnement de fabrication rapide.

Exigences physiques

• Capacité de se tenir debout et de marcher pendant de longues périodes tout au long de la journée de travail.

• Aptitude à plier, agenouiller, atteindre, pousser, tirer et soulever des matériaux jusqu'à 50 livres.

• Capacité de travailler en toute sécurité autour des équipements de soudage, des grues et des machines industrielles tout en portant l'EPI nécessaire.

• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement de fabrication avec exposition au bruit, à la chaleur, aux étincelles et aux vapeurs de soudage.

Qualifications privilégiées

• Certification de soudage AWS ou équivalent.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Group Legal Team in Winterthur and contribute your expertise to a global, publicly listed industrial company. In this highly visible role, you will report directly to the Head Group Legal / Deputy General Counsel and act as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership and key corporate functions across the Group.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate the legal workstream of domestic and cross-border M&A transactions, including acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic investments, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including, joint venture arrangements, technology agreements, sales terms and conditions, and procurement and supply contracts

• Advise on financing transactions, including bond issuances, syndicated and bilateral credit facilities, and provide legal support to the Treasury function on a wide range of financing-related matters

• Oversee and coordinate litigation, arbitration and other dispute resolution matters across the Group, including the management of external counsel

• Oversee the preparation and execution of Annual General Meetings and contribute to the legal review of the Company's Annual Report and Non-Financial Report

• Support the Head Group Legal / Corporate Secretary in matters relating to the Board of Directors, its committees and the Executive Committee

Your profile:

• Master of Law degree and Swiss Bar admission

• Minimum of 5+ years of relevant post-qualification experience, ideally gained in a leading law firm and/or the legal department of an international industrial company

• Demonstrated experience in M&A and Swiss corporate law, ideally complemented by exposure to antitrust and sanction law as well as capital markets and stock exchange regulations

• Business-oriented legal professional with strong judgment, a pragmatic mindset and the ability to balance legal risks with commercial objectives

• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with experience interacting confidently with senior executives, Board members and key external stakeholders

• Digitally savvy, with a strong interest in technology, AI-enabled solutions and modern ways of working

What we offer you

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.)

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Central workplace, only 5 minutes from Winterthur train station

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sur le rôle

Rejoignez notre équipe juridique du Groupe à Winterthur et apportez votre expertise à une entreprise industrielle mondiale et cotée en bourse. Dans le cadre de ce rôle très visible, vous relèverez directement du chef du groupe des avocats juridiques et adjoints et agirez à titre de conseiller juridique de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs et des principales fonctions du groupe.

Principales responsabilités :

• Diriger et coordonner le volet juridique des opérations nationales et transfrontalières de fusions-acquisitions, y compris les acquisitions, les cessions, les coentreprises et les autres investissements stratégiques, en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes et les conseillers externes

• Ébauche, examen et négociation d'un large éventail d'accords commerciaux complexes, y compris des accords de coentreprise, des accords technologiques, des modalités de vente et des marchés d'approvisionnement

• Donner des conseils sur les opérations de financement, y compris les émissions d'obligations, les facilités de crédit syndiquées et bilatérales, et fournir un appui juridique à la fonction du Trésor sur un large éventail de questions liées au financement

• Superviser et coordonner les litiges, l'arbitrage et d'autres questions de règlement des différends dans l'ensemble du Groupe, y compris la gestion des conseils externes

• Superviser la préparation et l'exécution des assemblées générales annuelles et contribuer à l'examen juridique du rapport annuel et du rapport non financier de la Société

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Application Engineer develops technical proposals for projects including proposing modifications to the standard design and configures the using design and costing tools. Works independently and develops technical responses to the customer.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Applies in-depth knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

• Screens customer's inquiries to ensure they contain all information required to submit a quotation.

• Liaises with sales /customers to obtain any missing information.

• Collects, understands, and interprets customer’s requirements for new and/or operating data from customer’s existing systems

• Development of the technical proposal/quotation, including equipment description and specifications, and reviews and negotiates necessary technical revisions with the customer.

• Responds to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance, in a timely manner.

• Upon customer order, reviews/approves the scope of supply and creates job file per Sulzer specifications.

• Understands and provides solutions to large and/or complex problems

• Requires independent judgement, initiative and sound decision making

SECONDARY FUNCTIONS

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and participate in project initiation as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering

• 5+ years’ experience in technical sales work with an understanding of how to interpret customer’s technical requirements

• Basic understanding of unit operations and wastewater analysis

• Conceptual system aptitude

• Excellent communication skills

• Self-motivated and takes initiatives

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Open to learning

• Élaborer des propositions de valeur claires et des cadres de positionnement pour les lignes de produits de base, y compris les pompes, les technologies de séparation, les services d'équipement rotatif, les bioplastiques (PLA) et la surveillance numérique

• Lead One Sulzer cible les verticales prioritaires: eau/eaux usées, pétrole et gaz, traitement chimique, énergie, aliments et boissons, et hydrogène vert

• Traduire le récit de la durabilité de Sulzer, décarbonisation, hydrogène vert, CCUS, économie circulaire, en positionnement crédible et différencié du marché

• Lancer des messages différenciés pour les offres de services et de services après-vente de Sulzer, en tirant parti de l'expansion du réseau mondial de services et des partenariats avec les clients à long terme

• Définir des plans de commercialisation annuels et mener des campagnes de commercialisation en alignement w marketing régional et numérique

• Mettre en place des processus de pratiques exemplaires pour le lancement de produits, l'élaboration de contenus et l'exécution de campagnes entre les divisions

Engagement des intervenants et collaboration intersectorielle

• Agir comme interface marketing clé avec les Présidents de Division, les Chefs de Région, les Chefs de Ventes et de Gestion de Produits VP à travers Flow, Services et Chemtech

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.
· Collaborate with the component engineering team and department supervisor to develop, refine, and optimize fixturing and tooling designs.
· Reverse engineering and part design improvement.
· Develop customer specific and driven scopes.
· Evaluate inspection results for rotating and stationary gas turbine components (e.g., buckets, nozzles, shrouds, casings)
· Creation of incoming and outgoing disposition reports ensuring technical accuracy.
· Creation and development of inspection and repair forms, repair specifications, written process specification, and component drawings (2D/3D prints and models).
· Work with department supervisor and shop technicians to ensure process, repair, and tooling viability. As well as to optimize, refine and streamline production workflow.

• Project Management: Manage multiple projects using Microsoft Project to meet departments monthly deliverables and budget targets.
· Order materials for jobs – Specify material from vendors – Write Purchase Orders.
· Develop industry knowledge about competition, vendors, and gas turbine advancements applicable to Sulzer’s business.
· Work with inside and outside sales representatives to provide technical support during customer meetings.
· Work with the component engineering group to develop and maintain drawings, inspection forms and prints.
· Work on and manage special projects per manager’s instructions.
· Develop tooling, processes, documentation, and specifications for flow testing IGT components.
· Help maintain and improve flow test equipment.
· Attend bid meetings / Interact with Customers.
· In-shop (and at times off-site) evaluation and reporting on components.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:
· Bachelor's degree in engineering, Sciences, or related field / equivalent experience and training.
· Knowledge in rotating/stationary equipment repairs or similar machinery.

• Proficiency in all MS office software; particularly with Excel and Project.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced shop environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
· Be knowledgeable of and enforce safety in all aspects and areas of the position, and with fellow co-workers throughout Sulzer’s various environments, includes those of our customers and vendors.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)
