Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.
· Collaborate with the component engineering team and department supervisor to develop, refine, and optimize fixturing and tooling designs.
· Reverse engineering and part design improvement.
· Develop customer specific and driven scopes.
· Evaluate inspection results for rotating and stationary gas turbine components (e.g., buckets, nozzles, shrouds, casings)
· Creation of incoming and outgoing disposition reports ensuring technical accuracy.
· Creation and development of inspection and repair forms, repair specifications, written process specification, and component drawings (2D/3D prints and models).
· Work with department supervisor and shop technicians to ensure process, repair, and tooling viability. As well as to optimize, refine and streamline production workflow.

• Project Management: Manage multiple projects using Microsoft Project to meet departments monthly deliverables and budget targets.
· Order materials for jobs – Specify material from vendors – Write Purchase Orders.
· Develop industry knowledge about competition, vendors, and gas turbine advancements applicable to Sulzer’s business.
· Work with inside and outside sales representatives to provide technical support during customer meetings.
· Work with the component engineering group to develop and maintain drawings, inspection forms and prints.
· Work on and manage special projects per manager’s instructions.
· Develop tooling, processes, documentation, and specifications for flow testing IGT components.
· Help maintain and improve flow test equipment.
· Attend bid meetings / Interact with Customers.
· In-shop (and at times off-site) evaluation and reporting on components.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:
· Bachelor's degree in engineering, Sciences, or related field / equivalent experience and training.
· Knowledge in rotating/stationary equipment repairs or similar machinery.

• Proficiency in all MS office software; particularly with Excel and Project.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced shop environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
· Be knowledgeable of and enforce safety in all aspects and areas of the position, and with fellow co-workers throughout Sulzer’s various environments, includes those of our customers and vendors.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Senior Business Controller services as the primary financial liasion between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial and project management activities. This position has responsibility for all of Latin America. Key Responsibilities:

• Overseeing the accuracy and productivity of day-to-day activities for inventory management, backlog tracking, customer order profitability, and utilization metrics.

• Leading strategic planning to align sales and operations, large captial projects, and working capital planning.

• Managing and tracking capital and operating projects, including billing and revenue recognition to ensure financial objectives are met.

• Develop the annual budget and manage detailed financial planning for country-specific operations

• Refresh rolling forecasts to reflect changing business and economic conditions

• Perform plan analytics to identify risks and opportunitites, develop risk management strategies, and provide actionable insights to mitigate financial risks.

• Define costing outcomes, develop cost frameworks, and ensure accurate cost control with a focus on optimizing local operations.

What you bring:

• University degree in Finance or Accoutning

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• At least 7 years of experience with Controlling in a manufacturing or industrial enviroment.

• Strong understanding of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning.

• Experience with SAP

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

We offer:

• Benefits Over Law

• Savings Fund

• Training

• Christmas bonus over low

• Development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
I servizi di Senior Business Controller come principale legame finanziario tra le operazioni di produzione locale e il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE), garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e un'efficace esecuzione delle principali attività di gestione finanziaria e di progetto. Questa posizione ha responsabilità per tutta l'America Latina. Responsabilità chiave:

• Superare l'accuratezza e la produttività delle attività quotidiane per la gestione dell'inventario, il monitoraggio del backlog, la redditività dell'ordine del cliente e le metriche di utilizzo.

• Promuovere la pianificazione strategica per allineare le vendite e le operazioni, grandi progetti di prigionia e pianificazione dei capitali di lavoro.

• Gestione e monitoraggio dei capitali e dei progetti operativi, tra cui fatturazione e riconoscimento dei ricavi per garantire obiettivi finanziari.

• Sviluppare il bilancio annuale e gestire la pianificazione finanziaria dettagliata per le operazioni specifiche del paese

• Aggiornare le previsioni per riflettere le mutevoli condizioni economiche e commerciali

• Eseguire l'analisi del piano per identificare i rischi e le opportunitÃ, sviluppare strategie di gestione del rischio e fornire informazioni attuabili per mitigare i rischi finanziari.

• Definire i risultati dei costi, sviluppare i framework dei costi e garantire un controllo accurato dei costi con l'obiettivo di ottimizzare le operazioni locali.

Cosa porti:

• Laurea in Finanza o Accoutning

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione dell'inventario, il controllo dei costi e la gestione del progetto

• Almeno 7 anni di esperienza con Controlling in un ambiente produttivo o industriale.

• Forte comprensione del controllo dei costi, del budget e della pianificazione finanziaria.

• Esperienza con SAP

• Esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense è un plus

Cosa ti offriamo

Offriamo:

• Vantaggi sulla legge

• Fondo di risparmio

• Formazione

• bonus di Natale su basso

• Piano di sviluppo

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior Business Controller ist die primäre finanzielle Verbindung zwischen lokalen Fertigungsbetrieben und dem Center of Excellence (CoE), die eine nahtlose Koordination und effektive Durchführung wichtiger Finanz- und Projektmanagementaktivitäten gewährleistet. Diese Position trägt Verantwortung für ganz Lateinamerika. Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Überwachung der Genauigkeit und Produktivität der täglichen Aktivitäten für Bestandsmanagement, Backlog-Tracking, Kundenauftrag Rentabilität und Auslastung Metriken.

• Führende strategische Planung zur Abstimmung von Vertrieb und Betrieb, Großprojekten und Betriebskapitalplanung.

• Verwaltung und Nachverfolgung von Kapital- und Betriebsprojekten, einschließlich Abrechnung und Umsatzerfassung, um sicherzustellen, dass die finanziellen Ziele erreicht werden.

• Entwicklung des Jahresbudgets und Verwaltung der detaillierten Finanzplanung für länderspezifische Operationen

• Auffrischung der rollierenden Prognosen zur Berücksichtigung der sich ändernden Geschäfts- und Wirtschaftsbedingungen

• Planen Sie Analysen, um Risiken und Chancen zu identifizieren, Risikomanagementstrategien zu entwickeln und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zur Minderung finanzieller Risiken zu liefern.

• Definieren Sie Kalkulationsergebnisse, entwickeln Sie Kostenrahmen und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue Kostenkontrolle mit Schwerpunkt auf der Optimierung lokaler Abläufe.

Was Sie mitbringen:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen oder Accouting

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in den Bereichen Bestandsmanagement, Kostenkontrolle und Projektmanagement

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit Controlling in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

• Starkes Verständnis von Kostenkontrolle, Budgetierung und Finanzplanung.

• Erfahrung mit SAP

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik und Qlik Sense ist ein Plus

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Wir bieten:

• Vorteile gegenüber dem Gesetz

• Sparkasse

• Ausbildung

• Weihnachtsbonus über niedrig

• Entwicklungsplan

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le contrôleur d'entreprise principal assure la liaison financière principale entre les activités manufacturières locales et le Centre d'excellence (CdE), assurant une coordination transparente et l'exécution efficace des principales activités de gestion financière et de projet. Cette position a la responsabilité de toute l'Amérique latine. Principales responsabilités :

• Superviser l'exactitude et la productivité des activités quotidiennes pour la gestion des stocks, le suivi de l'arriéré, la rentabilité des commandes et les mesures d'utilisation.

• Diriger la planification stratégique pour harmoniser les ventes et les opérations, les grands projets captifs et la planification du fonds de roulement.

• Gestion et suivi des projets d'immobilisations et d'exploitation, y compris la facturation et la comptabilisation des revenus, afin de s'assurer que les objectifs financiers sont atteints.

• Élaborer le budget annuel et gérer la planification financière détaillée des opérations par pays

• Actualiser les prévisions de roulement pour tenir compte de l'évolution des conditions économiques et commerciales

• Effectuer des analyses du plan afin de déterminer les risques et les possibilités, d'élaborer des stratégies de gestion des risques et de fournir des renseignements concrets pour atténuer les risques financiers.

• Définir les résultats en matière de coûts, élaborer des cadres de coûts et assurer un contrôle précis des coûts en mettant l'accent sur l'optimisation des opérations locales.

Ce que vous apportez:

• Diplôme universitaire en Finance ou Accoutning

• Expérience éprouvée en gestion des stocks, en contrôle des coûts et en gestion de projet

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience avec Controlling dans une fabrication ou un environnement industriel.

• Connaissance approfondie du contrôle des coûts, de la budgétisation et de la planification financière.

• Expérience avec SAP

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous offrons:

• Avantages juridiques

• Fonds d ' épargne

• Formation

• Bonus de Noël plus bas

• Plan de développement

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Regional Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group Data & Analytics Sr. Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reports and dashboards, and providing insights to support strategic and operational decisions. This role ensures data accuracy and supports data governance initiatives. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Regional Data Analyst
Job Description | Business Intelligence Team

Sulzer offers a wealth of opportunities to drive your career in the direction you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.
Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team as we accelerate our data transformation across the Services Division. This is a role at the intersection of business intelligence, analytics, and technology — for someone who not only understands what the business needs and translates it into impactful dashboards and analysis, but who actively looks for smarter, faster ways to do it.
We are not looking for someone who waits to be handed a tool. We want someone with a builder mindset — who sees a repetitive process and immediately thinks about how to streamline it, who stays genuinely close to what technology can do, and who brings proposals to the table without being asked.
About the Role

As a Business Intelligence & Data Analyst, you will serve as the bridge between regional business stakeholders and our data ecosystem. You will own dashboard development end-to-end, support data quality and governance, and act as a trusted analytics resource for teams spanning Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain.
Beyond delivery, you will be expected to continuously challenge how things are done — identifying opportunities to leverage emerging tools and technologies to make the team and the business work smarter.
What You Will Be Doing

Dashboard Development & Governance

• Gather and translate business requirements into well-structured, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses

• Develop and maintain dashboards in Qlik Sense, ensuring consistent look, feel, and logic across all BI outputs

• Manage development as a project — define scope, align with stakeholders, meet deadlines, and iterate based on feedback

• Develop a deep understanding of our data ecosystem — sources, structures, and how data flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms

• Ensure all dashboards are self-explanatory, actionable, and require minimal training to use

• Maintain documentation of dashboards, data models, and processes

• Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance forums as a reference point for end-users across the region

Data Quality & Governance

• Proactively identify data quality issues and support the relevant teams to define and implement improvement procedures

Analytics & Insights

• Proactively analyse trends across the region, sub-regions, and product lines to surface relevant business insights

• Serve as the primary analytics resource for the region, supporting teams with complex questions that go beyond standard dashboard views

• Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses — leveraging the best available tools to deliver faster, more thorough insights

• Actively engage with regional and sub-regional management to understand their data requirements and support strategic decisions

• Guide regional ambassadors on how to navigate and use existing dashboards independently

Training & Enablement

• Design and deliver training sessions on effective use of BI dashboards and data tools

• Build a culture of data literacy across the region

• Act as a consultant and help desk contact for dashboard-related questions

Insight Communication

• Support

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Group Data & Analytics Sr. Analyst è responsabile per l'analisi di set di dati complessi, lo sviluppo di report e dashboard, e fornisce informazioni per supportare le decisioni strategiche e operative. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza dei dati e supporta le iniziative di governance dei dati. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area di lavoro e lavorano indipendentemente con la supervisione generale. Analizzatore dei dati regionali
Descrizione del lavoro | Business Intelligence Team

Sulzer offre un sacco di opportunità per guidare la vostra carriera nella direzione che si desidera, a seconda delle vostre competenze e interessi. Vi invitiamo a fare domanda se siete pronti a fare il passo successivo.
Unisciti al team Business Intelligence & Analytics di Sulzer accelerando la nostra trasformazione dei dati in tutta la Divisione Servizi. Questo è un ruolo all'incrocio di business intelligence, analisi e tecnologia — per qualcuno che non solo comprende ciò che il business ha bisogno e lo traduce in dashboard e analisi di impatto, ma che attivamente cerca modi più intelligenti e più veloci per farlo.
Non stiamo cercando qualcuno che aspetta di essere consegnato uno strumento. Vogliamo qualcuno con una mentalità di costruttore — che vede un processo ripetitivo e pensa immediatamente a come semplificarlo, che rimane sinceramente vicino a ciò che la tecnologia può fare, e che porta proposte al tavolo senza essere chiesto.
Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di Business Intelligence & Data Analyst, servirai come ponte tra gli stakeholder aziendali regionali e il nostro ecosistema dei dati. Possiederai lo sviluppo del cruscotto end-to-end, supporterai la qualità dei dati e la governance, e agirai come una risorsa di analisi attendibile per i team che si occupano di vendite, operazioni, finanza e Supply Chain.
Al di là della consegna, ci si aspetta di sfidare continuamente come le cose sono fatte — identificare le opportunità di sfruttare strumenti e tecnologie emergenti per rendere il team e il lavoro business più intelligente.
Cosa farai

Sviluppo e governance del Dashboard

• Raccogliere e tradurre i requisiti aziendali in cruscotti e analisi ben strutturati e responsabili delle decisioni

• Sviluppare e mantenere cruscotti in Qlik Sense, assicurando un aspetto coerente, sensazione e logica in tutte le uscite BI

• Gestire lo sviluppo come progetto — definire lo scopo, allineare con gli stakeholder, rispettare le scadenze, e iterare basato su feedback

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione del nostro ecosistema dei dati — fonti, strutture e come i dati fluiscono su piattaforme CRM, ERP e cloud

• Assicurarsi che tutte le dashboard siano autoesplicative, azionabili e richiedono una formazione minima da usare

• Mantenere la documentazione di dashboard, modelli di dati e processi

• Partecipa a forum di governance ERP, CRM e BI come punto di riferimento per gli utenti finali in tutta la regione

Qualità e governance dei dati

• Identificare attivamente i problemi di qualità dei dati e supportare i team rilevanti per definire e implementare procedure di miglioramento

Analisi e informazioni

• Analisi proattiva delle tendenze in tutta la regione, nelle sottoregioni e nelle linee di prodotto per visualizzare le informazioni aziendali rilevanti

• Servire come risorsa di analisi primaria per la regione, sostenere i team con domande complesse che vanno oltre le viste standard del cruscotto

• Condurre analisi ad hoc e deep-dive — sfruttando i migliori strumenti disponibili per fornire informazioni più veloci e approfondite

• Impegnarsi attivamente con la gestione regionale e subregionale per comprendere i loro requisiti di dati e sostenere le decisioni strategiche

• Guida gli ambasciatori regionali su come navigare e utilizzare dashboard esistenti in modo indipendente

Formazione & Abilitazione

• Progettare e fornire sessioni di formazione su un uso efficace di dashboard BI e strumenti di dati

• Costruire una cultura dell'alfabetizzazione dei dati in tutta la regione

• Agire come consulente e help desk contatto per le domande relative alla dashboard

Comunicazione dell'opinione

• Supporto

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Group Data & Analytics Sr. Analyst ist für die Analyse komplexer Datensätze, die Entwicklung von Berichten und Dashboards sowie die Bereitstellung von Erkenntnissen zur Unterstützung strategischer und operativer Entscheidungen verantwortlich. Diese Rolle gewährleistet die Datengenauigkeit und unterstützt Data Governance-Initiativen. Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Regionaler Datenanalyst
Stellenbeschreibung: Business Intelligence Team

Sulzer bietet eine Fülle von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, abhängig von Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu gehen.
Treten Sie dem Business Intelligence & Analytics-Team von Sulzer bei, um unsere Datentransformation in der gesamten Serviceabteilung zu beschleunigen. Dies ist eine Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business Intelligence, Analytics und Technologie - für jemanden, der nicht nur versteht, was das Unternehmen braucht und in wirkungsvolle Dashboards und Analysen übersetzt, sondern aktiv nach intelligenten, schnelleren Möglichkeiten sucht, dies zu tun.
Wir suchen nicht jemanden, der darauf wartet, ein Werkzeug zu bekommen. Wir wollen jemanden mit einer Builder-Mentalität - der einen sich wiederholenden Prozess sieht und sofort darüber nachdenkt, wie er rationalisiert werden kann, der wirklich nah dran bleibt, was Technologie leisten kann und der Vorschläge auf den Tisch bringt, ohne gefragt zu werden.
Über die Rolle

Als Business Intelligence & Data Analyst bilden Sie die Brücke zwischen regionalen Business Stakeholdern und unserem Daten-Ökosystem. Sie besitzen die Dashboard-Entwicklung Ende-zu-Ende, unterstützen die Datenqualität und -Governance und fungieren als vertrauenswürdige Analyseressource für Teams aus den Bereichen Sales, Operations, Finance und Supply Chain.
Über die Lieferung hinaus wird von Ihnen erwartet, dass Sie ständig herausfordern, wie die Dinge gemacht werden - und Möglichkeiten identifizieren, neue Tools und Technologien zu nutzen, um das Team und die Geschäftsarbeit intelligenter zu machen.
Was Sie tun werden

Dashboard Entwicklung & Governance

• Sammeln und Übersetzen von Geschäftsanforderungen in gut strukturierte, entscheidungsfähige Dashboards und Analysen

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Dashboards in Qlik Sense, um konsistentes Aussehen, Gefühl und Logik in allen BI-Ausgaben zu gewährleisten

• Verwalten Sie die Entwicklung als Projekt - definieren Sie den Umfang, stimmen Sie sich mit den Stakeholdern ab, halten Sie Fristen ein und iterieren Sie basierend auf Feedback

• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis unseres Daten-Ökosystems - Quellen, Strukturen und wie Daten über CRM-, ERP- und Cloud-Plattformen fließen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Dashboards selbsterklärend und umsetzbar sind und eine minimale Schulung erfordern.

• Dokumentation von Dashboards, Datenmodellen und Prozessen

• Teilnahme an ERP-, CRM- und BI-Governance-Foren als Referenz für Endbenutzer in der gesamten Region

Datenqualität & Governance

• Proaktives Identifizieren von Datenqualitätsproblemen und Unterstützung der relevanten Teams bei der Definition und Implementierung von Verbesserungsverfahren

Analytics & Insights

• Proaktive Analyse von Trends in der Region, Subregionen und Produktlinien, um relevante Geschäftserkenntnisse zu gewinnen

• Als primäre Analyseressource für die Region dienen und Teams bei komplexen Fragen unterstützen, die über die Standard-Dashboard-Ansichten hinausgehen

• Durchführung von Ad-hoc- und Deep-Dive-Analysen – Nutzung der besten verfügbaren Tools, um schnellere, gründlichere Erkenntnisse zu liefern

• Aktiv mit dem regionalen und subregionalen Management zusammenarbeiten, um ihre Datenanforderungen zu verstehen und strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen

• Führen Sie regionale Botschafter dazu, wie Sie unabhängig voneinander navigieren und vorhandene Dashboards verwenden können

Training & Enablement

• Design und Durchführung von Schulungen zur effektiven Nutzung von BI-Dashboards und Datentools

• Aufbau einer Kultur der Datenkompetenz in der gesamten Region

• Handeln Sie als Berater und Helpdesk-Kontakt für Dashboard-Fragen

Insight Kommunikation

• Unterstützung

Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des données et appuie les initiatives de gouvernance des données. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels expérimentés qui appliquent les connaissances pratiques d'un domaine d'emploi et travaillent indépendamment avec une supervision générale. Analyste régional des données
Description du travail

Sulzer offre une multitude d'opportunités pour conduire votre carrière dans la direction que vous voulez, en fonction de vos compétences et intérêts. Nous vous invitons à postuler si vous êtes prêt à faire l'étape suivante.
Rejoignez l'équipe de SulzerS Business Intelligence & Analytics alors que nous accélérons notre transformation des données à travers la Division des Services. Il s'agit d'un rôle à l'intersection de l'intelligence d'affaires, de l'analyse et de la technologie — pour quelqu'un qui non seulement comprend ce dont l'entreprise a besoin et le traduit en tableaux de bord et en analyses d'impact, mais qui cherche activement des moyens plus intelligents et plus rapides de le faire.
Nous ne cherchons pas quelqu'un qui attend de recevoir un outil. Nous voulons quelqu'un avec un état d'esprit de construction — qui voit un processus répétitif et réfléchit immédiatement à la façon de le rationaliser, qui reste vraiment proche de ce que la technologie peut faire, et qui apporte des propositions à la table sans être interrogé.
À propos du rôle

En tant qu'analyste de l'information commerciale et des données, vous servirez de pont entre les intervenants commerciaux régionaux et notre écosystème de données. Vous posséderez un tableau de bord de développement de bout en bout, supporterez la qualité des données et la gouvernance, et agirez comme une ressource analytique de confiance pour les équipes couvrant les ventes, les opérations, les finances et la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
Au-delà de la prestation, on s'attend à ce que vous mettiez continuellement au défi la façon dont les choses sont faites, c'est-à-dire qu'il est possible de tirer parti des nouveaux outils et technologies pour rendre l'équipe et l'entreprise plus intelligentes.
Ce que vous ferez

Développement et gouvernance du tableau de bord

• Rassembler et traduire les exigences opérationnelles en tableaux de bord et analyses bien structurés et décisionnels

• Élaborer et maintenir des tableaux de bord dans Qlik Sense, en assurant une apparence, une sensation et une logique cohérentes pour tous les extrants BI

• Gérer le développement en tant que projet — définir la portée, s'aligner avec les parties prenantes, respecter les échéances, et itérer sur la base de la rétroaction

• Développer une compréhension approfondie de notre écosystème de données — sources, structures et comment les flux de données sur les plateformes CRM, ERP et cloud

• S'assurer que tous les tableaux de bord sont auto-explicables, exploitables et nécessitent une formation minimale à utiliser

• Maintenir la documentation des tableaux de bord, des modèles de données et des processus

• Participer aux forums de gouvernance du PGI, du CRM et du BI comme point de référence pour les utilisateurs finals de la région

Qualité des données et gouvernance

• Identifier les problèmes de qualité des données et aider les équipes compétentes à définir et à mettre en œuvre des procédures d ' amélioration

Analyse et analyses

• Analyser de façon proactive les tendances dans la région, les sous-régions et les gammes de produits afin de faire ressortir les perspectives d'affaires pertinentes

• Servir de principale ressource analytique pour la région, soutenir les équipes avec des questions complexes qui vont au-delà des vues standard du tableau de bord

• Effectuer des analyses ponctuelles et approfondies — en tirant parti des meilleurs outils disponibles pour fournir des informations plus rapides et plus approfondies

• Collaborer activement avec la gestion régionale et sous-régionale pour comprendre leurs besoins en données et appuyer les décisions stratégiques

• Guider les ambassadeurs régionaux sur la façon de naviguer et d'utiliser les tableaux de bord existants de façon indépendante

Formation et activation

• Concevoir et dispenser des séances de formation sur l'utilisation efficace des tableaux de bord et des outils de données BI

• Bâtir une culture de littératie dans la région

• Agir en tant que consultant et personne-ressource pour les questions liées au tableau de bord

Insight Communication

• Appui

jobs.title: Press Brake Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Fabricator / Press Brake Operator to join our manufacturing team. This position is primarily responsible for operating NC Press Brake to produce high-quality stainless-steel components according to engineering drawings and specifications. The ideal candidate will also assist with a variety of fabrication tasks, including operating a manual shear, rolling machine, drill press, and metal cutting saws. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate NC press brake equipment to form stainless steel sheet metal components.

• Read, interpret, and follow engineering drawings, blueprints, work instructions, and specifications.

• Measure, mark, and lay out cuts and bends on metal materials accurately.

• Operate a manual shear machine to cut metal to required dimensions.

• Use hand and power tools, including angle grinders and deburring tools, to finish fabricated parts.

• Operate fabrication equipment such as:
• Metal rolling machines

• Drill presses

• Large band saws and/or cold saws

• Other sheet metal fabrication equipment as needed

• Inspect finished parts to ensure they meet dimensional and quality requirements.

• Perform basic machine setup, tooling changes, and routine equipment maintenance.

• Maintain an organized and safe work area.

• Follow all company safety procedures and wear required PPE.

• Work collaboratively with supervisors and team members to meet production schedules and quality standards.
Qualifications
Required Skills and Experience

• Previous experience in metal fabrication, sheet metal manufacturing, or press brake operation.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, and work orders.

• Strong understanding of measurement tools, including tape measures, calipers, squares, and other precision measuring instruments.

• Experience measuring, marking, and laying out material for fabrication.

• Ability to safely operate fabrication and metalworking equipment.

• Experience using hand and power tools, including angle grinders.

• Basic mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with stainless steel sheet metal.

• Experience setting up and operating NC or CNC press brakes.

• Forklift certification or experience (if applicable).

• Knowledge of fabrication best practices and quality inspection methods.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, reach, stoop, and lift materials.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.

• Ability to safely work around moving machinery and industrial equipment.

• Ability to wear required safety equipment, including:
• Safety glasses

• Steel-toed footwear

• Hearing protection

• Cut-resistant gloves

• Enhanced PPE as required by the task or work area

Work Environment

• Manufacturing and fabrication shop environment.

• Frequent exposure to metal dust, noise, moving equipment, and fabrication processes.

• Work primarily involves stainless steel sheet metal fabrication.

• Strict adherence to safety procedures and PPE requirements is essential.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China,

Informazioni sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un esperto e motivato Fabricator / Press Brake Operator per unirsi al nostro team di produzione. Questa posizione è principalmente responsabile per l'operazione NC Press Brake per produrre componenti in acciaio inox di alta qualità secondo disegni e specifiche di ingegneria. Il candidato ideale sarà anche aiutare con una varietà di compiti di fabbricazione, tra cui il funzionamento di una cinghia manuale, laminatoio, trapano, e seghe di taglio in metallo. Principali responsabilità

• Impostare e utilizzare l'apparecchiatura di freno di pressa NC per formare componenti in lamiera di acciaio inossidabile.

• Leggere, interpretare e seguire disegni di ingegneria, progetti, istruzioni di lavoro e specifiche.

• Misurare, marcare, e stendere tagli e curve su materiali metallici con precisione.

• Operare una macchina manuale di taglio per tagliare il metallo alle dimensioni richieste.

• Utilizzare utensili manuali e di potenza, tra cui smerigliatrici angolari e strumenti di sbavatura, per finire parti fabbricate.

• Apparecchiature di fabbricazione di funzionamento come:
• Macchine per la laminazione

• Presse per trapano

• Seghe a banda larga e/o seghe fredde

• Altre attrezzature per la fabbricazione di lamiera come necessario

• Ispezionare parti finite per garantire che soddisfino i requisiti dimensionali e di qualità.

• Eseguire l'impostazione di base della macchina, le modifiche degli utensili e la manutenzione delle attrezzature di routine.

• Mantenere una zona di lavoro organizzata e sicura.

• Seguire tutte le procedure di sicurezza dell'azienda e indossare PPE richiesto.

• Lavorare in collaborazione con i supervisori e i membri del team per soddisfare i programmi di produzione e gli standard di qualità.
Qualifiche
Competenze e Esperienze necessarie

• Esperienza precedente nella fabbricazione di metallo, nella produzione di lamiera o nel funzionamento del freno di pressa.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti, disegni di negozio e ordini di lavoro.

• Forte comprensione degli strumenti di misura, comprese le misure a nastro, pinze, quadrati e altri strumenti di misura di precisione.

• Esperienza di misurazione, marcatura, e la posa di materiale per la fabbricazione.

• Capacità di operare in modo sicuro attrezzature di fabbricazione e lavorazione dei metalli.

• Esperienza utilizzando utensili manuali e di potenza, tra cui smerigliatrici angolari.

• Abilità meccanica di base e capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.
Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza di lavoro con lamiera di acciaio inossidabile.

• Sperimenta l'impostazione e il funzionamento dei freni di pressione NC o CNC.

• Certificazione o esperienza del carrello elevatore (se applicabile).

• Conoscenza delle migliori pratiche di fabbricazione e metodi di ispezione di qualità.
Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di stare e camminare per lunghi periodi durante la giornata di lavoro.

• Capacità di piegare, raggiungere, stoop e sollevare materiali.

• Capacità di sollevare e trasportare fino a 50 sterline su base regolare.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo sicuro intorno a macchine mobili e attrezzature industriali.

• Capacità di indossare attrezzature di sicurezza necessarie, tra cui:
• Occhiali di sicurezza

• Calzature in acciaio

• Protezione uditiva

• Guanti resistenti al taglio

• PPE potenziato come richiesto dal compito o dalla zona di lavoro

Ambiente di lavoro

• Produzione e fabbricazione negozio ambiente.

• Spesso esposizione a polvere di metallo, rumore, apparecchiature mobili e processi di fabbricazione.

• Il lavoro riguarda principalmente la fabbricazione di lamiera di acciaio inossidabile.

• L'adesione rigorosa alle procedure di sicurezza e ai requisiti del DPI è essenziale.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• congedo paterna pagato

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina,

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen qualifizierten und motivierten Hersteller / Press Brake Operator, um unser Produktionsteam zu verstärken. Diese Position ist in erster Linie für den Betrieb von NC Press Brake verantwortlich, um hochwertige Edelstahlkomponenten nach technischen Zeichnungen und Spezifikationen herzustellen. Der ideale Kandidat wird auch bei einer Vielzahl von Fertigungsaufgaben helfen, einschließlich des Betriebs einer manuellen Schere, einer Walzmaschine, einer Bohrpresse und Metallschneidsägen. Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Aufbau und Betrieb von NC-Pressebremsgeräten zur Bildung von Edelstahlblechkomponenten.

• Lesen, interpretieren und befolgen Sie technische Zeichnungen, Blaupausen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Spezifikationen.

• Messen, markieren und legen Sie Schnitte und Biegungen auf Metallmaterialien genau aus.

• Betreiben Sie eine manuelle Schermaschine, um Metall auf die erforderlichen Abmessungen zu schneiden.

• Verwenden Sie Hand- und Elektrowerkzeuge, einschließlich Winkelschleifern und Entgratwerkzeugen, um hergestellte Teile zu fertigen.

• Betrieb von Fertigungsanlagen wie:
• Metallwalzmaschinen

• Bohrpressen

• Großbandsägen und/oder Kaltsägen

• Sonstige Ausrüstung für die Blechherstellung nach Bedarf

• Prüfen Sie die fertigen Teile, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Maß- und Qualitätsanforderungen erfüllen.

• Führen Sie grundlegende Maschineneinstellungen, Werkzeugänderungen und routinemäßige Wartung der Ausrüstung durch.

• Pflegen Sie einen organisierten und sicheren Arbeitsbereich.

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsverfahren des Unternehmens und tragen Sie die erforderliche PSA.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Vorgesetzten und Teammitgliedern zusammen, um Produktionspläne und Qualitätsstandards zu erfüllen.
Qualifikationen
Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung

• Frühere Erfahrungen in der Metallherstellung, Blechherstellung oder im Betrieb der Abkantpresse.

• Fähigkeit, Blaupausen, Shop-Zeichnungen und Arbeitsaufträge zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Messinstrumenten, einschließlich Maßbändern, Messschiebern, Quadraten und anderen Präzisionsmessgeräten.

• Erleben Sie das Messen, Markieren und Legen von Material für die Herstellung.

• Fähigkeit, Fertigungs- und Metallbearbeitungsgeräte sicher zu betreiben.

• Erfahrung mit Hand- und Elektrowerkzeugen, einschließlich Winkelschleifern.

• Grundlegende mechanische Eignung und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, selbstständig und als Teil eines Teams zu arbeiten.
Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Edelstahlblech.

• Erfahrung in der Einrichtung und Bedienung von NC- oder CNC-Abkantpressen.

• Gabelstapler-Zertifizierung oder Erfahrung (falls zutreffend).

• Kenntnis der bewährten Herstellungsverfahren und Qualitätsprüfungsmethoden.
Physikalische Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, während des Arbeitstages längere Zeit zu stehen und zu gehen.

• Fähigkeit, Materialien häufig zu biegen, zu erreichen, zu bücken und zu heben.

• Fähigkeit, regelmäßig bis zu 50 Pfund zu heben und zu tragen.

• Fähigkeit, um sich bewegende Maschinen und Industrieanlagen sicher zu arbeiten.

• Fähigkeit, die erforderliche Sicherheitsausrüstung zu tragen, einschließlich:
• Schutzbrille

• Schuhwerk aus Stahl

• Gehörschutz

• Schnittsichere Handschuhe

• Verbesserte PSA entsprechend den Anforderungen des Aufgaben- oder Arbeitsbereichs

Arbeitsumgebung

• Fertigungs- und Fertigungsbetriebsumfeld.

• Häufige Exposition gegenüber Metallstaub, Lärm, beweglichen Geräten und Herstellungsprozessen.

• Die Arbeit umfasst in erster Linie die Herstellung von Edelstahlblechen.

• Die strikte Einhaltung der Sicherheitsverfahren und PSA-Anforderungen ist unerlässlich.

Nous recherchons un manufacturier / opérateur de freins à pression compétent et motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Cette position est principalement responsable de l'exploitation du frein à pression NC pour produire des composants en acier inoxydable de haute qualité selon les plans et les spécifications techniques. Le candidat idéal participera également à diverses tâches de fabrication, notamment l'utilisation d'un cisaillement manuel, d'une machine à rouler, d'une presse à forer et de scies à découper. • Expérimentez l'utilisation d'outils manuels et électriques, y compris des meuleuses à angle.

• Aptitude mécanique de base et compétences de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe.
Qualifications privilégiées

• Expérience de travail avec la tôle d'acier inoxydable.

• Expérimentez la mise en place et le fonctionnement des freins à pression NC ou CNC.

• Certification ou expérience de chariot élévateur (le cas échéant).

• Capacité de travailler en toute sécurité autour de machines et d'équipements industriels mobiles.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and innovative development solutions that enable a successful and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Sr. Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Senior Accountant provides support to the financial team in various tasks and responsibilities. He is responsible for managing the accounting of the entire Record to Report (RTR) process within the Group's companies in France, ensuring the accuracy of the data and compliance with Sulzer's accounting standards and internal rules. In addition, it supports general accounting processes in the areas of "Procurement to Pay" (PTP) and "Order to Cash" (OTC), where necessary.

Participate in the closing of the period, including by closing the auxiliary general ledger of accounts receivable and suppliers and making the reconciliation with the general ledger
Oversee the end-of-month and end-of-year processes; participating in the preparation of accounting entries, balance sheet reconciliations and analysis of differences
Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, including profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and cash flow tables
Participate in accounting entry of invoices without purchase order
Assist the Shared Financial Services Team in Capital Management Activities
Work closely with the Reporting & Analytics team to analyze financial data and provide financial performance information, identify trends and variances to support operational decisions
Ensure coordination with other services and shared financial services teams to ensure that all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
Participate in budgeting and forecasting processes, providing expertise on financial aspects and projections; working closely with the national financial officer
Liaise with tax experts to ensure accuracy and timeliness of tax returns and compliance
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of accounting processes and implement continuous improvement initiatives
Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, using technologies and best practices; ensure compliance with policies, procedures and models
Provide timely and accurate financial reporting to senior management and stakeholders
Ensure that all financial reports and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
Liaise with auditors and ensure that audits are carried out with minimal adjustments
Ensure that internal financial controls are in place and respected for processes under this function
Assist the national accounting officer in the management of requests from internal and external auditors and ensure that the accounting team provides the required information

• Training and experience
University degree in finance, accounting, business management or related fields
At least 5-7 years of accounting experience, with a marked specialization in general accounting and financial reporting in an industrial environment
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihre Expertise und innovativen Entwicklungslösungen zu erweitern, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Accounting Sr. Officer ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung von Buchhaltungsvorgängen, einschließlich Zeitschrifteneinträgen, Abstimmungen und Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle stellt die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards sicher und unterstützt Audits und Aktivitäten zum Monatsende. Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Der Senior Accountant unterstützt das Finanzteam bei verschiedenen Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten. Er ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung der Buchhaltung des gesamten Record-to-Report-Prozesses (RTR) innerhalb der Unternehmen der Gruppe in Frankreich, um die Genauigkeit der Daten und die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards und internen Vorschriften von Sulzer zu gewährleisten. Darüber hinaus unterstützt sie bei Bedarf allgemeine Buchhaltungsprozesse in den Bereichen „Procurement to Pay“ (PTP) und „Order to Cash“ (OTC).

Beteiligen Sie sich am Abschluss der Periode, einschließlich durch Schließen des zusätzlichen Hauptbuchs der Forderungen und Lieferanten und Abgleich mit dem Hauptbuch
Überwachung der Prozesse zum Ende des Monats und zum Ende des Jahres; Teilnahme an der Erstellung von Buchungseinträgen, Bilanzabstimmungen und Analyse von Differenzen
Erstellen Sie genaue und zeitnahe Abschlüsse, einschließlich Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen, Bilanzen und Cashflow-Tabellen
Beteiligen Sie sich an der buchmäßigen Erfassung von Rechnungen ohne Bestellung
Unterstützen Sie das Shared Financial Services Team bei Capital Management-Aktivitäten
Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Reporting & Analytics-Team zusammen, um Finanzdaten zu analysieren und finanzielle Performance-Informationen bereitzustellen, Trends und Abweichungen zu identifizieren, um operative Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Gewährleistung der Koordination mit anderen Diensten und geteilten Finanzdienstleistungsteams, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Finanztransaktionen ordnungsgemäß verbucht und im Hauptbuch ausgewiesen werden
Teilnahme an Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozessen, Bereitstellung von Fachwissen zu finanziellen Aspekten und Projektionen; enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem nationalen Finanzbeamten
Kontakt mit Steuerexperten, um die Genauigkeit und Aktualität der Steuererklärungen und die Compliance sicherzustellen
Überwachung von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), um die Effektivität von Buchhaltungsprozessen zu bewerten und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung umzusetzen
Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Finanzprozesse unter Einsatz von Technologien und bewährten Verfahren; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Modellen
Bereitstellung einer zeitnahen und genauen Finanzberichterstattung für die Geschäftsleitung und die Stakeholder
Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Finanzberichte und -prozesse den International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und den Sulzer-Vorschriften entsprechen
Kontaktaufnahme mit Auditoren und Gewährleistung, dass Audits mit minimalen Anpassungen durchgeführt werden
Gewährleistung, dass interne Finanzkontrollen für Prozesse im Rahmen dieser Funktion vorhanden sind und eingehalten werden
Unterstützung des nationalen Rechnungsführers bei der Bearbeitung von Anträgen interner und externer Rechnungsprüfer und Gewährleistung, dass das Rechnungsführungsteam die erforderlichen Informationen bereitstellt

• Ausbildung und Erfahrung
Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen
Mindestens 5-7 Jahre Buchhaltungserfahrung, mit einer ausgeprägten Spezialisierung auf allgemeine Buchhaltung und Finanzberichterstattung in einem industriellen Umfeld

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. ASM Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

ASM Qualifications:

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

• Understanding of basic financial statements

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Oversee and resolve warranty claims for pumps, mechanical seals, drivers, and auxiliary systems through technical investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to enhance reliability, reduce warranty costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the complete warranty claim lifecycle from receipt to closure.

• Evaluate warranty entitlement and determine liability based on contractual terms and technical findings.

• Lead claim investigations and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).

• Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Engineering, QA/QC, Production, Procurement, Service, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

• Serve as the primary customer contact for warranty-related matters.

• Maintain clear communication with customers and provide regular claim status updates.

• Participate in customer meetings and present investigation findings and recommendations.

• Conduct site visits, inspections, and troubleshooting activities as required.

• Support field service teams during warranty investigations.

• Monitor warranty costs and support recovery from suppliers when applicable.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote lessons learned to prevent recurrence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.

• 5–10 years of experience in pumps, rotating equipment, field service, reliability, or warranty management.

• Knowledge of API 610, API686, API 682, and rotating equipment practices is preferred.

• Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCA/RCFA)

• Pump & Mechanical Seal Troubleshooting

• Vibration & operating Data Analysis

• Customer Relationship Management

• Technical Report Writing

• Problem Solving

• Communication & Presentation Skills

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

• Supporta il Global Process Owner (GPO) con implementazioni di sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il grafico dei conti e delle gerarchie, assicurando che riflette la struttura aziendale attuale e i requisiti di reporting

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fare tutte le attività di chiusura dell'Anno tecnico come l'equilibrio portare avanti, le creazioni della gamma di numeri, chiusura di AA

• Sostenere il processo di riconciliazione intercompany in Coprocess e Tagetik (fisso varianze)

È necessario avere successo:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 2-3 anni di esperienza in Contabilità con una forte attenzione al registro generale e alla rendicontazione finanziaria

• CPA, ACCA, CMA o certificazione equivalente

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Capacità comprovata di gestire più priorità in un ambiente a scadenza

• Forte capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante all'unità aziendale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e software di contabilità

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense è un plus

• Competenza in inglese e francese

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto permanente.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager to build and oversee a Field Service team. The team will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, is a division of Sulzer Ltd, and is a global leader in the development and supply of pumping solutions and related equipment to its key markets oil and gas, power, general industries (mining, metals, food, CPI & fertilizers) and water. We provide a challenging and rewarding work environment where diversity is valued as a key driver for success.

Job Overview:
Reporting to the National Sales Manager, the Account Manager - Western Canada, promotes the sales and services (parts and repairs) of Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit products (pumps, mixers, agitators, compressors etc.) and accessories to established and new customers within the Account Manager’s area of responsibility. By providing technical and commercial proposals in response to inquiries, and interfacing between customers and company facilities, our successful candidate will primarily work independently with occasional guidance from the National Sales Manager PPI.

In this role you will be accountable for:

• Selling Sulzer Pumps Industry products and services (parts and repairs) to established customers.

• Sourcing and developing new customers, growing future business while protecting the existing base; develop growth in new areas within existing customer base.

• Negotiate orders including all technical, commercial and legal details to the mutual satisfaction of customers and the Company.

• Calling on prospective customers; maintain contracts with customers in relation to their requirements.

• Secure and renew orders; arrange delivery dates and other peripherals integral to selling.

• Travel to customer locations to insure close and regular face-to-face contact.

• Customer meetings during and outside normal business hours on a regular basis consistent with expense budgets and good business practices.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Ideally a Bachelor's degree in Engineering , or five (5) plus years related experience in pumps and hydraulics.

• Relevant experience and strong knowledge in marketing and selling of industry related equipment (pumps, motors etc.)

• Experience in pulp & paper and metal industries would be ideal.

• Excellent written, verbal, negotiation and interpersonal skills in English without supervision or oversight

• Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimal direct supervision

• Outgoing personality

• Ability to accept rejection and still maintain a positive attitude

• Proficient in math and computer skills; skilled with Microsoft Office applications, SAP knowledge preferred.

• Strong ability to utilize technical knowledge and analytical skills to resolve problems and objections from both internal and external forces

• Willingness to travel overnight (vehicle and air) on a routine basis with occasional travel, as required for the given assignment/territory

• Valid driver’s license with good driving record

• Physical Requirements: Lifting up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

• Company pension

• Dental care

• Disability insurance

• Employee assistance program

• Extended health care

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Vision care

• Work from home

Eligibility to Apply: Must be a Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or have a valid work permit.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Administrative Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Service Center Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting daily operations within a fast-paced service environment. This position is responsible for coordinating purchase orders, managing logistics, supporting work order processes, and maintaining accurate system transactions across multiple platforms (Salesforce and SAP). The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable wearing many hats in an unstructured, dynamic setting. Key Responsibilities

• Order & Procurement Management
• Process and manage purchase orders (POs) in Salesforce and SAP

• Receive and review POs for direct materials

• Create, place, and receive POs for indirect materials

• Establish vendor terms and maintain supplier communications

• Logistics & Operations Coordination

• Track materials and ensure timely delivery to support operations

• Perform receipt transactions and maintain accurate inventory records

• Work Order & Job Coordination

• Book jobs and ensure accurate scheduling within system tools

• Maintain status management and provide updates on work order progress

• Customer & Vendor Interaction

• Serve as a key point of contact for inquiries related to orders and services

• Financial & System Transactions

• Ensure accurate data entry and documentation across all systems

• Support booking and job costing activities as needed

• Familiarity with ERP/CRM systems such as SAP and Salesforce

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, unstructured environment

• Proactive mindset with strong attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer service skills

Key Competencies

• Adaptability and flexibility (“wear many hats”)

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Time management and prioritization

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Team-oriented with a customer-first approach

Work Environment

• Fast-paced, operations-focused service center

• Dynamic and evolving priorities

• Hands-on role requiring interaction across multiple functions

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Warehouse Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for coordinating activities to support the successful completion of orders. Plays a supporting role in the coordination of departments involved in delivering quality products in compliance with customer specifications and department/company policies and procedures. Performs related tasks from receiving/expediting, motor modifications & testing, preparation and shipment, as well as warehouse/inventory organization. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Maintain and operate forklifts and overhead cranes.

• Receive items into the ERP system, after resolving any data omissions and discrepancies which prevent accurate processing.

• Maintain a filing system for goods receipts and physically place items in storage locations.

• Physically receive items by unloading vehicles, accepting deliveries and forwarding documents to the New Product department.

• Package and prepare items for shipping. Create Bills of Lading and other shipping paperwork. Contact freight companies to coordinate logistics. Document condition via photos.

• Coordinate pick-ups and deliveries with internal and external transport contacts.

• Expedite and support activities related to items in process to ensure readiness for on time shipment.

• Determine method of shipment when not specified by customer and arrange pick-up by transporter.

• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including Mechanics, Machinists, Shipping/ Receiving, Sales, and Management.

• Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments.

• Maintain inventory of warehouse and shipping materials.

• Perform specialized tasks as required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 3-5 years of experience in related work environment

• Certified forklift operator

• Ability to read and understand internal and external requirements of purchase orders, packing slips and other documentation.

• Computer proficiency with knowledge of Logistics systems (Portals), Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and ERP systems (D365 strongly preferred).

• General knowledge of electro-mechanical equipment. Proficiency in mechanical tasks, motor modifications, and testing.

• Must have own tools, basic hand tools, wrenches, socket set, impact driver, drill and calipers.

• Ability to operate specialized testing equipment and other equipment as needed.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and organizational skills.

• Ability to act and work independently, adapt to change and have attention to detail.

• Must be able to work weekends and overtime at short notice as well as be on-call periodically.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Conoscenza generale delle apparecchiature elettromeccaniche. Competenza in compiti meccanici, modifiche motorie e test.

• Deve avere propri strumenti, strumenti di base, chiavi, set socket, driver di impatto, trapano e pinze.

• Capacità di operare attrezzature di prova specializzate e altre attrezzature come necessario.

• Forte capacità comunicative verbali e scritte e capacità organizzative.

• Capacità di agire e lavorare in modo indipendente, adattarsi al cambiamento e avere attenzione ai dettagli.

• Deve essere in grado di lavorare fine settimana e straordinario a breve preavviso, così come essere on-call periodicamente.
