descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le mécanicien industriel de moteurs et de générateurs démonte, inspecte, nettoie, répare, réassemble et supporte les essais de moteurs, de générateurs, de pompes et d'équipements rotatifs connexes. Ce rôle appuie l'équipement essentiel de la mission pour les services publics, l'infrastructure de l'eau, l'exploitation minière, la fabrication, les semi-conducteurs, l'aérospatiale, l'agriculture, la production alimentaire et d'autres marchés industriels.

On encourage les candidats qui ont l'inclination mécanique, du perfectionnement des techniciens aux mécaniciens expérimentés, à présenter leur candidature; l'expérience d'un atelier automobile direct est utile, mais pas requise pour tous les candidats.

Les mécaniciens travaillent dans une boutique spécialisée, axée sur l'équipe, aux côtés des éoliennes, des machinistes, des soudeurs, des techniciens d'essai, des ingénieurs et des superviseurs pour résoudre ensemble des problèmes de réparation difficiles. Phoenix, Arizona

Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Démonter, inspecter, réparer, tester et réassembler des moteurs industriels, des générateurs, des pompes, des boîtes de vitesses et des équipements électromécaniques connexes utilisés dans l'industrie lourde.

• Travaux sur des équipements rotatifs de grande valeur servant à l'électricité, à l'eau, aux mines, à la fabrication, aux semi-conducteurs, à l'aérospatiale, à l'agriculture, à la production alimentaire et à d'autres marchés industriels.

• Examiner et évaluer l'état de l'équipement, les dommages, les preuves de défaillance, les exigences en matière de réparation et la facilité d'entretien.

• Effectuer des tests de diagnostic électrique à basse tension et haute tension et des inspections électriques connexes sur les moteurs et les générateurs.

• Dépanner les problèmes mécaniques et électromécaniques à l'aide des résultats d'essais, des résultats d'inspection, des dessins, des antécédents de réparation et de l'expérience pratique.

• Retirez, installez, installez, ajustez et réparez les composants mécaniques pendant le démontage, le remontage, la réparation de l'atelier et le service sur place.

• Inspecter les composants mécaniques et électriques pour l'usure, les dommages, la surchauffe, le suivi, la contamination, les problèmes d'ajustement et d'autres problèmes de réparation.

• Mesurer, vérifier et enregistrer les dimensions critiques à l'aide de micromètres, de coulisses, d'indicateurs de cadran, de jauges de forage et d'autres outils de mesure de précision.

• Identifier, marquer, organiser, protéger, nettoyer et documenter les pièces pendant le démontage et la réparation.

• Effectuer l'alignement, les contrôles d'ajustement, l'inspection mécanique, les contrôles électriques, les contrôles opérationnels et l'inspection finale.

• Utiliser des outils et des équipements de réparation de moteurs industriels après une formation appropriée.

• Lisez et appliquez les instructions de travail, les champs de réparation, les dessins, les spécifications du client et les exigences de qualité.

• Travailler directement avec des équipes compétentes pour effectuer les réparations correctement et efficacement.

• Documenter les résultats de l'inspection, les résultats des essais, les mesures, les résultats des réparations et les travaux effectués.

• Suivez toutes les procédures de sécurité, de qualité, d'environnement, d'essai électrique, de levage, de gréement et d'atelier.

• Maintenir les outils, l'équipement, les pièces et les aires de travail dans un état propre, organisé et sécuritaire.

• Exécuter d'autres fonctions connexes telles qu'elles sont assignées.

Connaissances, compétences et capacités

• Forte aptitude mécanique.

• Utilisation sécuritaire des outils à main, des outils électriques et des instruments de mesure.

• Capacité de suivre des instructions verbales et écrites, des instructions de travail et des procédures de sécurité.

• Forte organisation, habitudes de documentation et attention aux détails.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe après une formation appropriée.

• Communication claire avec les superviseurs et les collègues.

• Une grande attention à la sécurité, la qualité et l'exécution.

Qualités minimales

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent.

• Aptitude mécanique et forte volonté d'apprendre.

• Capacité d'effectuer du travail physique en toute sécurité dans un environnement industriel.

• Capacité de suivre les procédures de sécurité, les instructions de travail et les exigences de qualité.

Qualifications privilégiées

• Expérience en entretien industriel, réparation mécanique, réparation d'équipement rotatif, automobile, diesel, équipement lourd, aviation, militaire, fabrication

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Project Manager is responsible for managing experienced professionals and overseeing the implementation of short-term strategies and policies. The role involves planning, organizing, and controlling resources for technical projects, ensuring quality standards, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees. Key Responsibilities
Develop detailed work plans, schedules, and project estimates.
Conduct risk analysis and monitor progress against milestones and budgets.
Provide technical and analytical guidance to project teams.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and review deliverables.
Liaise with users to analyze and document requirements.
Manage vendor tasks and review deliverables where applicable.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Required Skills:

Strong project management and leadership skills.
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to manage complex technical projects.
Experience in cross-functional team coordination.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Gym re-imbursement

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer (Electromechanical Services)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Mechanical Engineer for our Pasadena electromechanical service center. This role is primarily based on-site, splitting time between hands-on mechanical work, shop inspections, precision measurements, engineering documentation, and occasional field service overhauls. You will serve as the technical point of contact for customers and work in close coordination with our repair shop, machine shop, and internal quotation teams to drive heavy rotating equipment repairs from teardown to assembly.

Location: Pasadena, TX Service Center (with up to 40% field service assignments)

Key Responsibilities:

• Support day-to-day shop and field operations, including rotating equipment inspections, teardowns, repair evaluations, and hands-on overhauls (with field service assignments up to 40% as required).

• Collaborate with the machine shop, quotation team, and internal stakeholders on mechanical findings to define accurate repair scopes.

• Perform or verify precision measurements using micrometers and calipers, document findings clearly, and complete assigned tasks on schedule.

• Create and update CAD drawings (SolidWorks or Autodesk) to document design or repair changes for customer review.

• Act as the primary mechanical point of contact for customers during on-site inspections and repair evaluations.

Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

Preferred Background (3+ years total across one or more areas):

• Rotating equipment repair or overhaul

• Rotating equipment manufacturing

• Rotating equipment package design and assembly

• Field service for mechanical equipment

• Vibration analysis or diagnostics

Technical Skills & Knowledge:

• Proficient with CAD software ( SolidWorks or Autodesk )

• Working knowledge of: Rolling element bearings and sleeve/babbitt bearings. Mechanical seals and oil seals. Shaft alignment. Vibration spectrums and interpretation.

• Comfortable using precision measuring tools (micrometers and calipers)

• Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred ( on-the-job training provided ).

What we offer you

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with 6% company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Gym membership and wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a high-impact, results-driven Business Development Director with a deep, hands-on comprehension of the pumping world, industrial markets, and municipal space to lead growth initiatives and commercial operations for our FLOW division. Operating in a strict Business-to-Business (B2B) environment, this leader will drive strategic Growth Driver Plans (GDP), champion channel partner and distributor networks, and directly oversee and mentor our Regional Marketing Team and our Order Entry/Sales Support Processing Team .

If you possess a strong commercial background rooted in pumps and fluid handling, combined with process optimization (LEAN/VBSS) and team leadership—and are based within practical traveling distance of our Easley, SC facility—we want to hear from you.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

• Spearhead business development tailored specifically to the municipal and industrial water/pumping markets, partnering with Regional Sales Heads and Segment Heads to execute monthly Growth Driver Plans (GDP).

• Optimize, support, and expand our network of distributors and channel partners across the industrial and municipal space to maximize market reach.

• Direct, mentor, and align the Regional Marketing team and the Order Entry Processing team to ensure seamless workflow, high morale, and tight coordination between marketing, sales operations, and order fulfillment.

• Drive the execution and high user adoption of sales optimization tools (Salesforce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf), monitoring utilization and resolving roadblocks to internal efficiency.

• Apply LEAN, VBSS, or similar continuous improvement methodologies to identify and remove waste in internal business processes, order entry, and customer-facing workflows.

• Oversee data mining, ERP data accessibility, and management-level dashboards to track Order Intake (OI), Sales, and rolling forecasts.

• Liaise with Finance and Strategy to support budgeting, regular pipeline reviews, CRM maintenance, and the preparation of high-level corporate presentations.

Job Requirements & Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Marketing, or a related commercial/technical field (Master’s / MBA preferred).

• 8+ years of progressive commercial experience— with a mandatory, hands-on background in the municipal or industrial pumping world (B2B) . Must possess a thorough, practical comprehension of industrial channel partners, manufacturer's reps, and equipment distributors.

• Proven track record of managing, developing, and motivating cross-functional teams (specifically including marketing professionals and order entry/processing or customer service operations).

Location & Travel Requirements:

• Residency: Must reside within regional proximity and manageable traveling distance to our Easley, SC facility (preferred states: South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, or the Midwest).

• Work Style: Remote-compatible role with the flexibility for routine travel to the Easley, SC office and key regional locations as business needs dictate.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Ger

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Il titolare del lavoro lavorerà a stretto contatto con Regional Head of Sales, Segment Head e il proprio team per guidare iniziative strategiche e tattiche (PIL), gestire il team di marketing, garantire l'integrazione e l'utilizzo di strumenti di ottimizzazione aziendale, e generalmente sostenere il team di gestione delle vendite. La posizione assicurerà che le iniziative del PIL siano organizzate e eseguite mensilmente e facilitino la raccolta dei dati del TTI richiesto. Il marketing regionale darà priorità alle attività che sono in linea con queste iniziative. I processi e gli strumenti di eccellenza aziendale (Salesforce, CPQ, ecc.) saranno supportati dalla guida dell'adozione e dell'esecuzione degli strumenti di monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e dall'escalation di eventuali blocchi stradali o problemi di adozione, nonché dalla supervisione della nuova gestione dell'ordine di prodotto. Uno sfondo in LEAN/VBSS o simile è considerato vantaggioso per identificare le opportunità di semplificare i processi aziendali soprattutto da un'efficienza interna e/o dalla prospettiva del cliente. Posizione mirata: A distanza di viaggio di Easley, SC Principali responsabilità e compiti
• Organizzare e sostenere le iniziative del PIL
• Partner con le teste del segmento per sviluppare, tracciare e segnalare i vari piani di azione
• Lavorare con il personale degli analisti aziendali per automatizzare la raccolta dei dati TTI
• Raccogliere e comunicare i dati delle prestazioni, le intuizioni di mercato e le opportunità per assistere i team di vendita e servizi (collegare i dati di KPI, struttura, gestione visiva, ecc.)
• Coordinare le attività dei responsabili del marketing regionale
• Combinare la promozione del marketing, l'analisi e il PIL/iniziativa insieme per coordinare e concentrare le risorse
• Superare la gestione della comunicazione di marketing e iniziative di marketing
• Supporta programmi di sviluppo dei partner
• Sostenere la leadership di vendita per creare e gestire il flusso di comunicazione sul principale interno sociale ed esterno
• Concentrati sull'esecuzione e sulla rimozione dei rifiuti nei processi aziendali, principalmente nelle attività di Vendite e Servizi, Drive Sales Support dipartimento che fornisce informazioni ai leader di vendita per facilitare le aziende.
• Organizzare e supervisionare l'estrazione dati, l'accessibilità ai dati in vari sistemi (ERP)
• Creazione e manutenzione del cruscotto di livello di gestione
• Supporta la raccolta e l'analisi dei dati di Business Intelligence.
• Coordinare con altre funzioni che SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf e altri sistemi principali sono sviluppati in base alle esigenze aziendali.
• Liaise with Finance e with Strategy (Processo di costruzione, per segmento, per Regione, per prodotto)
• Regolare revisione della Pipeline e manutenzione CRM
• Trainer per SalesForce
• Gestione delle previsioni, sia per OI (Order Intake) che per Vendite
• Partner con i leader di vendita e il personale di sviluppo aziendale per monitorare l'esecuzione tempestiva dei compiti chiave
• Assistere con preparazione per presentazioni e report aziendali Cosa ti offriamo
• Tempo a pagamento competitivo
• 12 Azienda Pagamenti all'anno
• Programma bonus annuale
• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi
• Società pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, Azienda pagato vita assicurazione
• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato
• Contributi di sicurezza a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di occupazione
• Rimborso/Assistenza educativa
• Rimborso trimestrale Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Position: Designer I

Actuellement, nous avons une ouverture immédiate pour un Designer I dans notre installation de Burnaby.

Dans notre installation de Burnaby, nous fournissons des services et des produits liés à la pompe, y compris le soutien technique sur le terrain, la conception et l'analyse hydrauliques/mécaniques, les réparations des pompes, les essais de performance, les pompes mises à niveau, les pompes en double ou en remplacement, les paquets de pompes et les pièces de rechange. Sur place, nous disposons d'un espace de fabrication couvert de 5600 m2 comprenant un atelier de machines, une zone de réparation/montage et deux sites d'essai de pompes avec une puissance maximale de 15 000 HP avec une vitesse de 50/60 hertz.

En tant que membre de notre département d'ingénierie, vous assisterez, au niveau subalterne, dans la conception et le traitement des commandes de pompes centrifuges, de composants et d'équipement; préparerez des plans de conception; interpréterez les exigences de conception; effectuerez des calculs; créerez et modifierez des dessins; créerez des Bills of Materials (BOM) et créerez d'autres documents d'ingénierie conformément aux spécifications du client et aux politiques de l'entreprise.

• Exécuter d'autres tâches au besoin.

Qualifications
Notre candidat idéal aura :

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou diplôme en technologie de conception mécanique, y compris des cours tels que la conception mécanique, hydraulique, la rédaction assistée par ordinateur (2D/3D), etc.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical equipment.
Perform preventive maintenance and document findings.
Replace or fabricate parts as needed.
Maintain tools and ensure safe working conditions.
Collaborate with production teams to minimize downtime.
Train and support junior mechanics.
Follow safety and operational procedures.

Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.
Strong mechanical aptitude and diagnostic skills.
Experience with industrial machinery and tools.

Knowledge of safety regulations and maintenance procedures.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Pasadena, Texas

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Flow Equipment division and play a key role in delivering competitive and technically robust solutions for large-scale infrastructure and energy projects. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, and our global manufacturing network, you will lead the preparation of complex tenders, develop technical solutions, assess project risks, and support customers throughout the bidding process. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineering professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with commercial insight in an international environment. Main responsibilities:

• Prepare high-quality technical and commercial tenders for infrastructure and energy projects, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and on-time delivery.

• Review customer specifications and analyze technical requirements to develop optimal pumping solutions.

• Collaborate with specialist departments and manufacturing sites to define and configure pumps, accessories, and related systems.

• Evaluate technical and commercial project risks and develop mitigation strategies during the bidding phase.

• Support customers and sales teams with technical consultations, specifications, and proposal presentations.

• Manage supplier and subcontractor enquiries, evaluate quotations, and lead technical discussions when required.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the tender preparation process to ensure a competitive and compliant offer.

• Participate in customer negotiations and ensure a smooth handover from tendering to project execution teams after contract award.

• Maintain accurate data and documentation within sales and tendering systems.

What you need to succeed:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in tendering, sales engineering, project management, pump engineering, or a related field.

• Strong technical knowledge of pumps, rotating equipment, and associated systems.

• Experience in complex technical tenders and commercial proposal preparation.

• Knowledge of desalination and water transport applications will be considered a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong commercial awareness combined with a customer-focused mindset.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and solve complex technical challenges.

• Fluent English.

• Availability to travel within Spain and internationally when required

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Chamartín, Madrid.

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Flow Equipment division and play a key role in delivering competitive and technically robust solutions for large-scale infrastructure and energy projects. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, and our global manufacturing network, you will lead the preparation of complex tenders, develop technical solutions, assess project risks, and support customers throughout the bidding process. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineering professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with commercial insight in an international environment. Main responsibilities:

• Prepare high-quality technical and commercial tenders for infrastructure and energy projects, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and on-time delivery.

• Review customer specifications and analyze technical requirements to develop optimal pumping solutions.

• Collaborate with specialist departments and manufacturing sites to define and configure pumps, accessories, and related systems.

• Evaluate technical and commercial project risks and develop mitigation strategies during the bidding phase.

• Support customers and sales teams with technical consultations, specifications, and proposal presentations.

• Manage supplier and subcontractor enquiries, evaluate quotations, and lead technical discussions when required.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the tender preparation process to ensure a competitive and compliant offer.

• Participate in customer negotiations and ensure a smooth handover from tendering to project execution teams after contract award.

• Maintain accurate data and documentation within sales and tendering systems.

What you need to succeed:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in tendering, sales engineering, project management, pump engineering, or a related field.

• Strong technical knowledge of pumps, rotating equipment, and associated systems.

• Experience in complex technical tenders and commercial proposal preparation.

• Knowledge of desalination and water transport applications will be considered a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong commercial awareness combined with a customer-focused mindset.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and solve complex technical challenges.

• Fluent English.

• Availability to travel within Spain and internationally when required

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Chamartín, Madrid.

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Über die Rolle

Treten Sie der Flow Equipment Division von Sulzer bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung wettbewerbsfähiger und technisch robuster Lösungen für große Infrastruktur- und Energieprojekte. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Engineering, Project Management und unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk leiten Sie die Vorbereitung komplexer Ausschreibungen, entwickeln technische Lösungen, bewerten Projektrisiken und unterstützen Kunden während des gesamten Ausschreibungsprozesses. Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für einen Ingenieur, der es genießt, technisches Know-how mit kommerziellen Einblicken in einem internationalen Umfeld zu kombinieren. Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Bereiten Sie qualitativ hochwertige technische und kommerzielle Ausschreibungen für Infrastruktur- und Energieprojekte vor, um Genauigkeit, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und pünktliche Lieferung zu gewährleisten.

• Überprüfen Sie die Kundenspezifikationen und analysieren Sie die technischen Anforderungen, um optimale Pumpenlösungen zu entwickeln.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Fachabteilungen und Produktionsstätten zusammen, um Pumpen, Zubehör und verwandte Systeme zu definieren und zu konfigurieren.

• Bewerten Sie technische und kommerzielle Projektrisiken und entwickeln Sie Minderungsstrategien während der Ausschreibungsphase.

• Unterstützen Sie Kunden und Vertriebsteams bei technischen Beratungen, Spezifikationen und Angebotspräsentationen.

• Verwalten Sie Lieferanten- und Subunternehmeranfragen, bewerten Sie Angebote und führen Sie bei Bedarf technische Diskussionen.

• Pflegen Sie genaue Daten und Dokumentationen innerhalb von Verkaufs- und Ausschreibungssystemen.

Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Ausschreibungen, Vertriebstechnik, Projektmanagement, Pumpentechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Starkes technisches Wissen über Pumpen, rotierende Geräte und zugehörige Systeme.

• Erfahrung in komplexen technischen Ausschreibungen und der Vorbereitung kommerzieller Vorschläge.

• Kenntnisse über Entsalzungs- und Wassertransportanwendungen werden als großer Vorteil angesehen.

• Hervorragendes Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in internationalen und multidisziplinären Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Starkes kommerzielles Bewusstsein kombiniert mit einer kundenorientierten Denkweise.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen.

• fließend Englisch.

• Verfügbarkeit für Reisen innerhalb Spaniens und international bei Bedarf

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie die Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.

• Essensgutscheine.

• Zugang zu einem freiwilligen flexiblen Vergütungssystem, das es den Mitarbeitern ermöglicht, ihr Gehaltspaket zu optimieren (z. B. Krankenversicherung, Transport, Kinderbetreuung)

• Werden Sie Teil eines erfahrenen und internationalen Teams.

• Ein gutes Vibe Arbeitsumfeld.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ihre Karriere in einem soliden und gut etablierten internationalen Unternehmen auszubauen.

• Seien Sie Teil einer dynamischen Organisation, die sich einer kontinuierlichen Transformation und Verbesserung unterzieht.

• Bürostandort: Chamartín, Madrid.

* Zusätzliche Vorteile können je nach Position und Standort gelten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

• Forte connaissance technique des pompes, de l'équipement rotatif et des systèmes associés.

• Expérience dans la préparation d'offres techniques complexes et de propositions commerciales.

• La connaissance des applications du dessalement et du transport par eau sera considérée comme un avantage important.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes internationales et multidisciplinaires.

• Forte sensibilisation commerciale associée à un état d'esprit axé sur le client.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de gérer plusieurs priorités et de résoudre des défis techniques complexes.

• Anglais.

• Disponibilité pour voyager en Espagne et à l'étranger au besoin

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

• Faites partie d'une équipe expérimentée et internationale.

• Un bon environnement de travail.

• L'occasion de développer votre carrière au sein d'une entreprise internationale solide et bien établie.

• Faites partie d'une organisation dynamique en constante transformation et amélioration.

• Lieu des bureaux: Chamartín, Madrid.

* Des avantages supplémentaires peuvent s'appliquer selon le poste et l'emplacement.

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

• Störungen und Schäden analysieren, Ursachen feststellen und passende Lösungen umsetzen

• Service- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten in der Werkstatt sowie direkt beim Kunden vor Ort durchführen

• Anlagen und Maschinen nach abgeschlossenen Arbeiten wieder in Betrieb nehmen und auf ihre Funktion prüfen

• Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen mit Fachwissen und Praxiserfahrung unterstützen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen, um Erfahrungen auszutauschen und gemeinsam die beste Lösung zu finden

• Sicherstellen, dass Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards jederzeit eingehalten werden

• Technische Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Mechatroniker (m/w/d) oder in einem vergleichbaren Beruf

• Erfahrung im Service, in der Instandhaltung oder bei der Reparatur von rotierenden Maschinen

• Freude an Fehlersuche, Ursachenanalyse und technischen Herausforderungen

• Praktische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, Wissen und Erfahrungen mit Kollegen zu teilen

• Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Arbeit

• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Montageeinsätzen

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Order Booking person reviews the order received in line with Sulzer standard policy for order receipt. After thorough review of order in terms of scope, price, quantity this register in SAP. This is first step which shall be without any error to avoid any issue at later stage of project. Key Responsibilities

• Review customer purchase orders received from the Sales/Tendering team against the approved quotation and PO documentation to ensure alignment.

• Identify and promptly highlight any discrepancies related to scope, pricing, quantity, payment terms, delivery terms, or contractual conditions before order booking.

• Thoroughly review and interpret customer contracts, identify potential commercial and operational risks, and communicate concerns to the Sales and Tendering teams for resolution.

• Possess sound knowledge of Incoterms, payment terms, applicable taxes, duties, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Accurately process order bookings for pumps and spare parts with a commitment to zero-error execution .

• Coordinate and conduct internal kick-off meetings with relevant stakeholders for pump orders and critical/high-value spare parts orders.

• Create and maintain order booking records, including generation of order codes and customer master codes whenever required.

• Prepare, review, and submit Order Acknowledgements to customers using established standard checklists and procedures.

• Conduct regular order booking review meetings with the Sales and Tendering teams and provide bi-weekly status and performance reports.

• Maintain strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Excel, and demonstrate hands-on experience with SAP.

• Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills while interacting with internal and external stakeholders.

• Possess knowledge of pumps, compressors, couplings, and related rotating equipment; such experience will be considered a distinct advantage.

Work experience : 4+ years
Expertise (e.g. professional, technical): Exposure to engineering product
Education: Level: Graduate
Languages: English & Hindi Soft skills: SAP & MS office

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays

Long service award

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Application & Tendering Engineer is responsible for developing technical and commercial solutions for municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, supporting the preparation of competitive bids and tenders.
The role combines process understanding, application engineering, and tendering activities, with a strong focus on selecting, designing, and integrating treatment technologies based on customer requirements, project constraints, and applicable standards.
The engineer acts as a technical interface between Sales, Engineering, and external stakeholders, contributing to solution definition from early tender stage through project handover. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Tendering & Proposal Development

• Analyze RFQs, tender documents, and technical specifications related to wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) , both civil and industrial .

• Develop complete technical and commercial proposals , ensuring compliance with process requirements, client expectations, and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with internal departments (process engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, finance, projects) to collect inputs for bids.

• Perform cost estimation, material take-offs, and preparation of BOQs for water and wastewater treatment solutions.

• Ensure timely and accurate submission of tenders and clarification responses.

Application Engineering & Process Support

• Provide pre-sales technical and process support to Sales and customers.

• Define and recommend process solutions and equipment for:

• Preliminary and primary treatment

• Secondary (biological) treatment

• Tertiary and polishing steps

• Sludge treatment and handling (where applicable)

• Size and configure treatment units and packages (e.g. screens, grit removal, clarification, filtration, sludge equipment).

• Prepare process descriptions, technical datasheets, layouts, and technical clarifications .

• Support and participate in technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with customers, consultants, EPC contractors, and authorities.

Client, Consultant & Vendor Interface

• Liaise with clients, consultants, technology partners, and EPC contractors to clarify process and technical aspects during the tender phase.

• Interface with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain quotations, technical data, and delivery information.

• Align technical solutions with international standards and specifications (e.g. EN, ISO, local standards, project-specific requirements).

Post‑Bid Support & Project Handover

• Follow up on submitted tenders and support post‑bid technical clarifications and negotiations .

• Contribute to contract review from a technical and scope-of-supply perspective .

• Ensure a structured handover of awarded projects to the execution team, including all technical, commercial, and process documentation.

Organizational & Knowledge Sharing

• Support and mentor junior application or tendering engineers .

• Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, tools, and templates .

• Share know‑how on wastewater treatment technologies and applications within the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (with clear exposure to water/wastewater treatment).

• 4–7 years of experience in application engineering, tendering, or technical sales within the water and wastewater treatment sector .

• Proven experience with municipal and/or industrial wastewater treatment processes .

• Strong understanding of treatment technologies, plant layouts, and process interfaces .

• Experience in tenders for EPC or public sector projects is a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager looking to join a global engineering leader where you'll play a critical role in delivering complex projects across some of the world's most important industries? At Sulzer, we're specialists in fluid engineering, helping customers maximise the reliability, performance and efficiency of their operations. With annual sales exceeding CHF 3.6 billion, approximately 13,000 employees worldwide and a strong global reputation for innovation and excellence, Sulzer offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career within a business that keeps critical industries moving.

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing. Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across all industries. If you're looking to make a real impact in a fast-paced environment where engineering expertise, innovation and customer focus come together, Sulzer offers the platform to take your career to the next level. What You'll Be Doing

• Managing multiple engineering and service projects simultaneously from initiation through to completion.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams including engineering, production, procurement and operations.

• Developing and maintaining project schedules, budgets and resource plans.

• Monitoring project performance, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.

• Ensuring projects are delivered in compliance with safety, quality and contractual requirements.

• Managing project reporting and providing regular updates to internal and external stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• Proven experience in a Project Manager role within engineering, manufacturing, industrial services or a related technical environment.

• Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Experience managing project budgets, schedules and commercial performance.

• Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Project Management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent) – desirable, not essential.

• Experience within rotating equipment, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), manufacturing or industrial engineering sectors.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer will be responsible for the technical execution and successful delivery of pumping system projects, ensuring adherence to specifications, budget, and schedule.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in developing project plans, schedules, estimates, and monitoring progress against milestones.

• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and contractual requirements throughout project execution.

• Coordinate with vendors and suppliers while tracking deliverables, procurement activities, and material deliveries to site.

• Manage interdisciplinary coordination to achieve project objectives within schedule, budget, and required quality standards.

• Promote and coordinate the resolution of technical issues and provide recommendations to Project Management.

• Participate in technical meetings with customers and suppliers, including HAZOP, P&ID, and 3D Model Reviews, ensuring timely closure of actions.

• Coordinate the preparation and issuance of project documentation, including specifications, plans, requisitions, and other discipline deliverables.

• Review bid requisitions, technical evaluations, tabulations, and recommendations for equipment and material awards.

• Identify, control, and monitor project changes, ensuring proper processing of potential change orders and project impacts.

• Support Production activities, manage day-to-day interfaces with internal and external stakeholders, conduct weekly project reviews, and promote effective project management practices.

Qualifications / Requirements

• BSc or MSc in Engineering; Project Management specialization preferred.

• PMP Certification.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in the Energy & Infrastructure sector or related industries.

• Strong understanding of project management principles and planning tools.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience working with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong English communication and negotiation skills.

• Ability to work independently and support international assignments.

• Effective decision-making, teamwork, and coordination skills.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s transformation journey as a lead IT Project Manager and play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact IT initiatives. You’ll have the opportunity to manage a diverse project portfolio, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the modernization of our IT landscape by identifying opportunities for leveraging technology to drive business growth, improve processes and enhance productivity. This is a unique chance to drive meaningful change and develop your career in a dynamic, global environment.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

Portfolio & Project Management

• Lead and guide overall execution of multiple IT Projects , ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic priorities.

• Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery , budget adherence and manage interdepen dencies between projects.

• Maintain project documentation, status reports, and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.

Governance & Methodology

• Apply and promote consistent project management methodologies, tools, and reporting standards.

• Ensure compliance with governance frameworks and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management

• Build strong relationships with business leaders and IT stakeholders to ensure project objectives meet business needs , leading the IT project Steering Committees.

• Act as a key point of contact for project-related communication and issue resolution .

• Proactively engage in business partnering, acting as a trusted advisor to business divisions and supporting the identification, prioritization, and management of IT demand s to maximize value delivery.

Demand Management

• Lead the demand management process by capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing business requirements, ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic objectives and resource availability.

• Facilitate transparent decision-making on project selection and resource allocation.

Vendor & Financial Management

• Support vendor selection, contract management, and performance tracking for project-related services.

• Assist in project budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance tracking.

Operational Excellence

• Drive efficiency in project delivery and resource allocation.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across project processes and tools.

Sulzer Core Ambition Program

• Actively contribute to the SulzerCore Ambition Program by ensuring that all project and portfolio activities support the organizations goals and strategic ambitions.

Team Collaboration & Development

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to a culture of accountability and excellence.

• Mentor junior project managers or team members as needed.

• Drive efficiency across IT operations, including resource allocation, vendor management, and performance tracking.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across the IT landscape, including consolidation of tools and platforms.

OneSulzer Culture

• Promote and embody the OneSulzer mindset by fostering collaboration with an “ Entrepreneurial sp irit and teamwork ” , challenging the status quo, and supporting a unified, “Customer focus” culture across all divisions and teams.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• 9+ years of professional experience in IT and business/industry environments

• At least 5 years of experience in team management and leadership roles

• Strong experience with project methods and methodologies

• Solid knowledge of operating models (Ops Models)

• Proven

Portfolio & Project Management

• Guidare e guidare l'esecuzione complessiva di più progetti IT , garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità strategiche di Sulzer.

• Monitorare il progresso del progetto, gestire i rischi e garantire la consegna tempestiva, l'aderenza del bilancio e gestire le densità interdipendenti tra i progetti.

• Mantenere documentazione di progetto, rapporti di stato e dashboard per la leadership e gli stakeholder.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei quadri di governance e contribuire a elaborare iniziative di miglioramento.

• Costruire relazioni forti con i leader aziendali e gli stakeholder IT per garantire che gli obiettivi del progetto soddisfino le esigenze aziendali, guidando i comitati direttivi del progetto IT.

• Agire come punto chiave di contatto per la comunicazione e la risoluzione dei problemi relativi al progetto.

• Proattivamente impegnarsi in business partnering, agendo come consulente affidabile per le divisioni aziendali e sostenendo l'identificazione, la priorità e la gestione della domanda IT s per massimizzare la consegna del valore.

Gestione della domanda

• Condurre il processo di gestione della domanda catturando, valutando e privilegiando i requisiti aziendali, garantendo l’allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici di Sulzer e la disponibilità delle risorse.

• Facilita il processo decisionale trasparente sulla selezione dei progetti e l'assegnazione delle risorse.

Fornitore e gestione finanziaria

• Selezione del fornitore di supporto, gestione del contratto e monitoraggio delle prestazioni per i servizi legati al progetto.

• Assistere nel budgeting del progetto, previsione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni finanziarie.

Eccellenza operativa

• Efficienza dell'azionamento nella consegna del progetto e allocazione delle risorse.

• Campione continuo miglioramento e semplificazione attraverso processi e strumenti di progetto.

Programma di ambizione del nucleo di Sulzer

• Contribuire attivamente al Programma Ambition SulzerCore assicurando che tutte le attività di progetto e di portafoglio supportino gli obiettivi delle organizzazioni e le ambizioni strategiche.

Collaborazione e sviluppo del team

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali e contribuire a una cultura di responsabilità ed eccellenza.

• Mentor junior project manager o membri del team come necessario.

• Efficienza dell'azionamento attraverso le operazioni IT, tra cui allocazione delle risorse, gestione dei fornitori e monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

• Campione continuo miglioramento e semplificazione attraverso il paesaggio IT, compreso il consolidamento di strumenti e piattaforme.

Cultura di OneSulzer

• Promuovere ed incarnare la mentalità di OneSulzer promuovendo la collaborazione con una cultura “Enrepreneurial sp irit and teamwork ”, sfidando lo status quo, e sostenendo una cultura unificata “Customer focus” in tutte le divisioni e team.

Esperienza desiderata & Qualifiche

• 9+ anni di esperienza professionale in ambienti IT e business/industria

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione del team e ruoli di leadership

• Forte esperienza con metodi e metodologie di progetto

• Conoscenza solida dei modelli operativi (Ops Models)

• Approvazione

Vous aurez l'occasion de gérer un portefeuille de projets diversifié, de collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et de contribuer à la modernisation de notre paysage informatique en identifiant les possibilités de tirer parti de la technologie pour stimuler la croissance des entreprises, améliorer les processus et améliorer la productivité. C'est une chance unique de conduire un changement significatif et de développer votre carrière dans un environnement dynamique et mondial.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

Gestion de portefeuille et de projet

• Diriger et guider l'exécution globale de plusieurs projets de TI, en assurant l'alignement avec les priorités stratégiques de Sulzer.

• Surveiller l'avancement du projet, gérer les risques et assurer l'exécution en temps voulu, le respect du budget et gérer les interdépendances entre les projets.

• Tenir à jour la documentation du projet, les rapports de situation et les tableaux de bord à l'intention des dirigeants et des intervenants.

Gouvernance et méthodologie

• Appliquer et promouvoir des méthodes, des outils et des normes de gestion de projet uniformes.

• Assurer le respect des cadres de gouvernance et contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration des processus.

Gestion des parties prenantes

• Établir des relations solides avec les chefs d'entreprise et les intervenants en TI pour s'assurer que les objectifs du projet répondent aux besoins opérationnels, en dirigeant les comités directeurs du projet de TI.

• Agir comme point de contact principal pour la communication et la résolution des problèmes liés au projet.

• S'engager activement dans des partenariats d'affaires, agir à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès des divisions d'affaires et appuyer l'identification, la hiérarchisation et la gestion de la demande de TI afin de maximiser la prestation de valeur.

Gestion de la demande

• Diriger le processus de gestion de la demande en saisissant, en évaluant et en hiérarchisant les besoins opérationnels, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les objectifs stratégiques de Sulzer et la disponibilité des ressources.

• Faciliter la prise de décisions transparentes sur la sélection des projets et l'affectation des ressources.

Gestion des fournisseurs et des finances

• Appuyer la sélection des fournisseurs, la gestion des contrats et le suivi du rendement des services liés aux projets.

• Aider à la budgétisation des projets, aux prévisions et au suivi du rendement financier.

Excellence opérationnelle

• Favoriser l'efficacité de l'exécution des projets et de l'affectation des ressources.

• Promouvoir l'amélioration continue et la simplification des processus et des outils du projet.

Programme d'ambition de base de Sulzer

• Contribuer activement au Programme d'ambition de SulzerCore en veillant à ce que toutes les activités de projet et de portefeuille appuient les buts et les ambitions stratégiques des organisations.

Collaboration et développement d'équipes

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et contribuer à une culture de responsabilité et d'excellence.

• Mentor gestionnaire de projet junior ou membre de l'équipe au besoin.

• Favoriser l'efficacité des opérations de TI, y compris l'affectation des ressources, la gestion des fournisseurs et le suivi du rendement.

• Champion de l'amélioration continue et de la simplification dans le paysage informatique, y compris la consolidation des outils et des plateformes.

OneSulzer Culture

• Promouvoir et incarner l'état d'esprit d'OneSulzer en favorisant la collaboration avec un groupe d'entrepreneurs et de travail d'équipe, en contestant le statu quo et en soutenant une culture unifiée, axée sur le client, dans toutes les divisions et équipes.

Expérience et qualifications souhaitées

• 9 ans et plus d'expérience professionnelle dans les environnements IT et affaires/industrie

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en gestion d'équipe et en leadership

• Forte expérience des méthodes et méthodologies des projets

• Connaissance approfondie des modèles d'exploitation (modèles d'exploitation)

• Prouvé

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Under limited supervision, performs all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications / Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: CNC Machinist / Programmer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Reads blueprints, programs or adjusts G-code, and sets up CNC machines to cut and shape raw materials into precision parts. Responsible for monitoring production runs, measuring finished parts with precision tools, and performing routine machine maintenance. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Complete all documentation pertaining to the work assignment

• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Machine personnel, Supervisor, and Lead Man

• Operating a machine consists of:

• Able to lift large, heavy equipment using the crane or spreader bar setup when required

• Operate manual and automatic feeds to 0.0002" as required for final cuts

• Operate machine to make complex angle cuts and threading where multiple speeds and feeds

• are required

• Complete assigned jobs start to finish with little or no supervision.

• This includes the ability to perform the following:

• Perform intermediate trigonometry to help determine tooling required to machine the part and best matching method

• Read blue prints, drawings and sketches that may require intermediate math and problems solving skills to calculate dimensions not specified on print

• Help Maintain Equipment, this includes the following:

• Check / Add oil

• Clean machine after each shift

• Place tooling in correct location and organize

• Dispose of and properly document left over machining stock (New Parts, Met Samples)

• Q.C. all manufactured parts prior to removing from machine and informing the Department Supervisor of the following items:

• When/If item is de-burred

• Once dimensions are verified per print

• Alert Supervisor if there are any discrepancies

• Steps required before part is complete

• Remain physically active from start of shift to end of shift, including, but is not limited to:

• Sweeping

• Cleaning Area

• Organize tooling

• Operating Machine

• Organize project parts

• Operate CNC

• Planning — work with Department Supervisor to develop a machining plan:

• Determine what tools will be required

• Determine pre-programmable steps

• Determine manual programming steps

• Determine the best loading position to accommodate the machining requirements

• Locate / Load all required tools for the Project in the correct tool holder

• Correctly program the tools and offsets for each tool in the holder CNC — Operation

• Stay attentive while the CNC is running

• Load proper material / parts

• Be able to quickly shut down or change the program to prevent detrimental damage to the machine or personnel safety

• Calculate / Anticipate tool offset changes due to wear during the machine process CNC — Maintenance

• Maintain Oil Levels as required

• Clean area as required

• Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time

• Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project

• Have and maintain ability to use and operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders and

• forklifts

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Completion of a CNC machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Lies Blaupausen, programmiert oder passt den G-Code an und richtet CNC-Maschinen ein, um Rohstoffe zu Präzisionsteilen zu schneiden und zu formen. Verantwortlich für die Überwachung von Produktionsläufen, die Messung von Fertigteilen mit Präzisionswerkzeugen und die routinemäßige Wartung der Maschine. WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN

• Füllen Sie alle Unterlagen aus, die sich auf den Arbeitsauftrag beziehen

• Enge und klare Kommunikation mit den anderen Abteilungen, Maschinenpersonal, Supervisor und Lead Man

• Der Betrieb einer Maschine besteht aus:

• Kann große, schwere Ausrüstung mit dem Kran oder Spreader Bar Setup heben, wenn erforderlich

• Bedienen Sie manuelle und automatische Zuführungen zu 0,0002" wie für Endschnitte erforderlich"

• Bedienen Sie die Maschine, um komplexe Winkelschnitte und Gewinde zu machen, wo mehrere Geschwindigkeiten und Vorschub

• sind erforderlich

• Vollständige zugewiesene Jobs beginnen mit wenig oder keiner Aufsicht zu enden.

• Dies beinhaltet die Fähigkeit, Folgendes durchzuführen:

• Führen Sie eine Zwischentrigonometrie durch, um die für die Bearbeitung des Teils erforderlichen Werkzeuge und die beste Übereinstimmungsmethode zu bestimmen

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Key Responsibilities

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Sr. Coordinator is responsible for coordinating field service activities including installation, configuration, calibration, and repair of technical products and systems at customer locations. This role supports service delivery and may guide other professional-level staff in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
The Field Service Supervisor plays a key role in ensuring that all services are executed with quality, efficiency, and safety. This role acts as a bridge between the customer and the national technical team, working closely with the Operations Director, the Operations Backoffice and the Workshop Coordinator. The supervisor is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of all field activities (maintenance, incidents, breakdowns, commissioning, and supervision).

Key Responsibilities

• Technical team coordination: Assign daily tasks to field technicians based on priorities and workload, ensuring efficient execution.

• Materials and resources control: Ensure that technicians have the necessary tools, materials, and documentation to complete tasks quickly and effectively.

• Work order monitoring: Follow up on work orders, validate the technical closure, and ensure that all required information is included (photos, reports, readings, etc.).

• Direct customer communication: Plan and coordinate field activities with the customer, ensuring that work can be carried out safely and within the agreed timelines.

• Maintenance contract planning and tracking: Verify that all related documentation is up to date and that maintenance activities are carried out in accordance with contractual requirements.

• Continuous improvement: Propose operational and procedural improvements based on field reality, and analyze the causes of rework and recurring incidents.

What you need to succeed
Experience & Technical Background

• Proven experience in field service supervision or coordination within an industrial environment (e.g. civil construction, hydraulic installations, industrial maintenance).

• Strong technical knowledge and diagnostic skills , with the ability to support and guide field technicians.

• Experience working with field service management tools , work orders, and technical reporting.

• Hands‑on exposure to on‑site customer environments , managing incidents, breakdowns, and maintenance activities.

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to work autonomously while coordinating and prioritizing activities of a distributed field team.

• Strong communication and customer‑oriented mindset , with proven experience dealing directly with customers on site.

• Structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Problem‑solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Languages & Mobility

• High level of English (able to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and customers).

• Availability to travel across Iberia as required by field activities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Company car as a tool of trade

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Coordinatore (Field) Service Sr. è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività di servizio sul campo, tra cui installazione, configurazione, calibrazione e riparazione di prodotti e sistemi tecnici nelle sedi dei clienti. Questo ruolo supporta la fornitura di servizi e può guidare altri personale di livello professionale in situazioni non routine. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a personale di livello professionale che lavora autonomamente e può coordinare le attività di altri personale di livello professionale, soprattutto in situazioni non di routine. Il Field Service Supervisor svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire che tutti i servizi siano eseguiti con qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Questo ruolo funge da ponte tra il cliente e il team tecnico nazionale, lavorando a stretto contatto con il Direttore Operativo, il Backoffice Operativo e il Coordinatore Workshop. Il supervisore è responsabile della gestione end-to-end di tutte le attività sul campo (manutenzione, incidenti, guasti, messa in servizio e supervisione). Principali responsabilità
• Coordinamento tecnico del team: Assegnare compiti quotidiani ai tecnici di campo basati su priorità e carico di lavoro, garantendo un'esecuzione efficiente.
• Controllo dei materiali e delle risorse: Assicurarsi che i tecnici abbiano gli strumenti necessari, i materiali e la documentazione per completare i compiti in modo rapido ed efficace.
• Monitoraggio dell'ordine di lavoro: Seguire gli ordini di lavoro, convalidare la chiusura tecnica e garantire che tutte le informazioni richieste siano incluse (foto, report, letture, ecc.).
• Comunicazione diretta del cliente: pianificare e coordinare le attività sul campo con il cliente, assicurando che il lavoro possa essere effettuato in modo sicuro e entro i termini concordati.
• Pianificazione e tracciamento del contratto di manutenzione: verifica che tutta la documentazione relativa è aggiornata e che le attività di manutenzione sono svolte in conformità con i requisiti contrattuali.
• Miglioramento continuo: Proporre miglioramenti operativi e procedurali basati sulla realtà del campo, e analizzare le cause di rilavoro e incidenti ricorrenti. Cosa devi avere successo Esperienza & Sfondo tecnico
• Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione del servizio sul campo o nel coordinamento in un ambiente industriale (ad esempio costruzione civile, impianti idraulici, manutenzione industriale).
• Forte conoscenza tecnica e competenze diagnostiche, con la capacità di supportare e guidare i tecnici del campo.
• Esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di gestione dei servizi di campo , ordini di lavoro e reporting tecnico.
• Esposizione manuale agli ambienti dei clienti in loco, gestione di incidenti, guasti e attività di manutenzione. Competenze e competenze
• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina e privilegia le attività di un team di campo distribuito.
• Forte comunicazione e mentalità orientata al cliente , con esperienza comprovata che si occupa direttamente con i clienti in loco.
• Approccio strutturato e proattivo, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente.
• Mindset problem-solving e orientamento continuo miglioramento. Lingue e mobilità
• Alto livello di inglese (in grado di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni e i clienti).
• Disponibilità per viaggiare attraverso Iberia come richiesto dalle attività sul campo. Cosa ti offriamo
• Un contratto permanente.
• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.
• Biglietti del ristorante
• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.
• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.
• Auto aziendale come strumento di commercio
• Altri vantaggi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda

• Hands-on-Exposition gegenüber Kundenumgebungen vor Ort, Management von Vorfällen, Pannen und Wartungsaktivitäten. Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen
