jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. We are looking for a FP&A Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team in our Madrid Center of Excellence. In this role, you will support several business entities across the EMEA region, acting as a trusted finance partner and providing insightful financial analysis that drives business performance and strategic decision-making.
This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working in an international environment, collaborating with stakeholders across different countries, and turning financial data into meaningful business insights.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

• Lead budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning activities for assigned entities.

• Prepare and analyze monthly financial results, identifying variances, risks and opportunities.

• Support management reporting by providing meaningful analysis and recommendations.

• Drive profitability analysis and business performance monitoring across key financial metrics.

• Partner with Finance Business Partners and operational stakeholders to support strategic decision-making.

• Monitor and analyze operating expenses, headcount, working capital and other key performance indicators.

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring data accuracy and timely reporting.

• Participate in CAPEX planning, investment analysis and related reporting.

• Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls and Sulzer financial policies.

• Improve reporting processes, dashboards and financial planning tools through automation and standardization initiatives.

• Collaborate closely with global and regional teams within the Sulzer Finance organization.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Madrid Finance Center of Excellence.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Controlling or similar finance roles.

• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and performance analysis.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.

• Advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and planning tools such as Tagetik, Qlik Sense, Power BI or ERP systems is considered an advantage.

• Ability to communicate complex financial information to non-finance stakeholders.

• Experience working in an international or shared services environment is a plus.

• Fluency in English is mandatory.

• Additional European languages are a plus.

• Proactive, collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improveme

In questo ruolo, supporterai diverse entità aziendali nella regione EMEA, agendo come partner finanziario affidabile e fornendo analisi finanziarie approfondite che guidano le prestazioni aziendali e il processo decisionale strategico.

• Lead budgeting, previsioni e attività di pianificazione a lungo termine per le entità assegnate.

• Preparare e analizzare i risultati finanziari mensili, identificare le variazioni, rischi e opportunità.

• Gestione del supporto reporting fornendo analisi e raccomandazioni significative.

• Analisi della redditività e monitoraggio delle prestazioni aziendali attraverso metriche finanziarie chiave.

• Partner con Finance Business Partners e stakeholder operativi per supportare il processo decisionale strategico.

• Monitorare e analizzare le spese operative, il conteggio, il capitale di lavoro e altri indicatori chiave delle prestazioni.

• Supporta le attività di chiusura di fine mese e fine anno, garantendo accuratezza dei dati e report tempestivi.

• Partecipa alla pianificazione CAPEX, all'analisi degli investimenti e alla relativa segnalazione.

• Assicurare il rispetto di IFRS, controlli interni e politiche finanziarie Sulzer.

• Migliorare i processi di reporting, dashboard e strumenti di pianificazione finanziaria attraverso iniziative di automazione e standardizzazione.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team globali e regionali all'interno dell'organizzazione Sulzer Finance.

• Contribuisci a iniziative di miglioramento continuo all'interno del Madrid Finance Center of Excellence.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato.

• Minimo 3-5 anni di esperienza nella pianificazione finanziaria e nell'analisi, controllo o simili ruoli finanziari.

• Forte conoscenza del bilancio, della previsione, della modellazione finanziaria e dell'analisi delle prestazioni.

• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con una forte attenzione ai dettagli.

• Competenze avanzate di Excel; l'esperienza con strumenti di reporting e pianificazione come Tagetik, Qlik Sense, Power BI o sistemi ERP è considerato un vantaggio.

• Capacità di comunicare informazioni finanziarie complesse agli stakeholder non finanziari.

• L'esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di servizi internazionali o condivisi è un vantaggio.

• La fluidità in inglese è obbligatoria.

• Altre lingue europee sono un plus.

• Mindset attivo e collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire più priorità.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto permanente.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Buoni pasti.

• Accesso a un regime volontario di compensazione flessibile che consente ai dipendenti di ottimizzare il loro pacchetto salariale (ad esempio assicurazione sanitaria, trasporto, assistenza all'infanzia)

• Partecipa a un team esperto e internazionale.

• Un ambiente di lavoro di buona atmosfera.

• L'opportunità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno di una solida e consolidata società internazionale.

• Essere parte di un'organizzazione dinamica in fase di trasformazione e miglioramento continuo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. We are looking for a FP&A Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team in our Madrid Center of Excellence. In this role, you will support several business entities across the EMEA region, acting as a trusted finance partner and providing insightful financial analysis that drives business performance and strategic decision-making.
This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working in an international environment, collaborating with stakeholders across different countries, and turning financial data into meaningful business insights.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

• Lead budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning activities for assigned entities.

• Prepare and analyze monthly financial results, identifying variances, risks and opportunities.

• Support management reporting by providing meaningful analysis and recommendations.

• Drive profitability analysis and business performance monitoring across key financial metrics.

• Partner with Finance Business Partners and operational stakeholders to support strategic decision-making.

• Monitor and analyze operating expenses, headcount, working capital and other key performance indicators.

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring data accuracy and timely reporting.

• Participate in CAPEX planning, investment analysis and related reporting.

• Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls and Sulzer financial policies.

• Improve reporting processes, dashboards and financial planning tools through automation and standardization initiatives.

• Collaborate closely with global and regional teams within the Sulzer Finance organization.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Madrid Finance Center of Excellence.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Controlling or similar finance roles.

• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and performance analysis.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.

• Advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and planning tools such as Tagetik, Qlik Sense, Power BI or ERP systems is considered an advantage.

• Ability to communicate complex financial information to non-finance stakeholders.

• Experience working in an international or shared services environment is a plus.

• Fluency in English is mandatory.

• Additional European languages are a plus.

• Proactive, collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improveme

Sur le rôle

Le Contrôleur est chargé d'appuyer l'intégrité financière de l'organisation par des rapports exacts, la conformité et les contrôles internes. Ce rôle consiste à préparer des états financiers, à faciliter les vérifications et à assurer le respect des normes et des politiques comptables.

• Améliorer les processus de rapport, les tableaux de bord et les outils de planification financière grâce à des initiatives d'automatisation et de normalisation.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes mondiales et régionales de l'organisation Sulzer Finance.

• Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein du Centre d'excellence financier de Madrid.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, économie, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en planification financière et analyse, contrôle ou rôles financiers semblables.

• Connaissance approfondie de la budgétisation, des prévisions, de la modélisation financière et de l'analyse des résultats.

• Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec une grande attention aux détails.

• Compétences Excel avancées; l'expérience avec les outils de reporting et de planification tels que Tagetik, Qlik Sense, Power BI ou les systèmes ERP est considérée comme un avantage.

• Capacité de communiquer des renseignements financiers complexes aux intervenants non financiers.

• L'expérience de travail dans un environnement de services internationaux ou partagés est un atout.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire.

• Les autres langues européennes sont un plus.

• Une attitude proactive et collaborative avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de gérer de multiples priorités.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

• Faire partie d'une organisation dynamique en constante transformation et m'améliorer

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, with a proud history dating back to 1834. Through our Rotating Equipment Services division, we deliver world-class maintenance, repair, and upgrade solutions for critical turbomachinery, including steam turbines, industrial gas turbines, aeroderivatives, and large compressors. Our Services team specializes in ensuring the reliability and longevity of rotating equipment and turbomachinery assets for customers in oil & gas, power generation, and industrial sectors.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be at the forefront of delivering these solutions. Working on rotating equipment across diverse client sites worldwide, you’ll ensure critical assets operate at peak performance. Location: Flexible – Can be based anywhere in the UK
Travel: Domestic and international travel, both onshore and offshore

Key Responsibilities

• Install, remove, repair, commission, and maintain rotating equipment onshore and offshore.

• Dismantle, inspect, and report on equipment condition using standard field service documentation.

• Compile detailed inspection and commissioning reports, liaising with internal teams and clients.

• Reassemble and test equipment following engineering best practices and OEM standards.

• Ensure compliance with client and company safety procedures at all times.

• Provide professional client interaction to minimize downtime and maintain strong relationships.

What We’re Looking For

• We’re seeking a time-served mechanical engineer with proven practical experience in the maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment,

• Flexibility and willingness to travel, both domestically and internationally, including offshore assignments.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in challenging environments.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and delivering solutions under pressure.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with clients and internal teams.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Offshore allowances

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Sulzer Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è un leader globale nei servizi di ingegneria dei fluidi e attrezzature rotanti, con una storia orgogliosa risalente al 1834. Attraverso la nostra divisione Rotating Equipment Services, forniamo soluzioni di manutenzione, riparazione e aggiornamento di livello mondiale per turbomacchine critiche, tra cui turbine a vapore, turbine a gas industriali, aeroderivati e compressori di grandi dimensioni. Il nostro team di Servizi è specializzato nel garantire l'affidabilità e la longevità delle attrezzature rotanti e dei beni turbo-macchine per i clienti in settori petroliferi, di produzione di energia e industriali.

Come Field Service Engineer, sarete in prima linea nella fornitura di queste soluzioni. Lavorando su attrezzature rotanti attraverso diversi siti client in tutto il mondo, vi assicurerete che i beni critici operano a prestazioni di punta. Posizione: Flessibile – Può essere basato ovunque nel Regno Unito
Viaggi: viaggi nazionali e internazionali, sia onshore che offshore

Principali responsabilità

• Installare, rimuovere, riparare, commissionare e mantenere le attrezzature rotanti onshore e offshore.

• Smantellare, ispezionare e riferire sulle condizioni dell'attrezzatura utilizzando la documentazione standard del servizio sul campo.

• Compilare i rapporti di ispezione e messa in servizio dettagliati, legare con le squadre interne e i clienti.

• Riassemblare e testare le attrezzature seguendo le migliori pratiche ingegneristiche e gli standard OEM.

• Assicurare la conformità alle procedure di sicurezza del cliente e dell'azienda in ogni momento.

• Fornire interazione cliente professionale per minimizzare i tempi di fermo e mantenere relazioni forti.

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere meccanico a tempo con comprovata esperienza pratica nella manutenzione e revisione delle attrezzature rotanti,

• Flessibilità e volontà di viaggiare, sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, inclusi incarichi off-shore.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in ambienti difficili.

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving, con un approccio proattivo per la risoluzione dei problemi e la fornitura di soluzioni sotto pressione.

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per levigare efficacemente con i clienti e le squadre interne.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Uno stipendio base competitivo

• Programma di bonus a livello aziendale

• Opportunità di straordinario pagate

• Indennità offshore

• 33 giorni di congedo annuale.

• Contributi pensionistici definiti.

• L'accesso a Medicash ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.

• Sostegno confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping più l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.

• Auto personale a noleggio per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.

• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Come titolare del MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Cadet Adult Volunteers con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Als Field Service Engineer stehen Sie an vorderster Front bei der Bereitstellung dieser Lösungen. Durch die Arbeit an rotierenden Geräten an verschiedenen Kundenstandorten weltweit stellen Sie sicher, dass kritische Assets mit Spitzenleistung arbeiten. Standort: Flexibel - Kann überall in Großbritannien ansässig sein
Reisen: Inländische und internationale Reisen, sowohl Onshore als auch Offshore

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Installieren, entfernen, reparieren, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung von rotierenden Geräten Onshore und Offshore.

• Demontage, Inspektion und Bericht über den Zustand der Ausrüstung unter Verwendung der Standard-Außendienstdokumentation.

• Erstellen Sie detaillierte Inspektions- und Inbetriebnahmeberichte und arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams und Kunden zusammen.

• Neumontage und Testausrüstung nach Best Practices und OEM-Standards.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Sicherheitsverfahren für Kunden und Unternehmen jederzeit.

jobs.title: Winder/Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing.

Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across a wide range of industries.

Due to continued growth, we're looking for a skilled Winder/Fitter to join our team. As a Winder/Fitter, you will play a key role in the repair, refurbishment, manufacture and assembly of electrical rotating equipment and components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Carrying out winding, fitting and assembly activities on a range of electrical equipment.

• Manufacturing and installing coils and windings to specification.

• Stripping, inspecting and rebuilding motors, generators and associated equipment.

• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation.

• Supporting electrical and mechanical testing activities.

• Identifying faults and assisting with repair solutions.

• Maintaining high levels of quality, housekeeping and safety within the workshop.

• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and best practice across the business.
What We're Looking For

• Previous experience in an engineering, fitting, manufacturing or repair environment.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical instructions.

• Attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team.

• Wire winding experience would be a distinct advantage.

• Experience working on motors, generators or other rotating equipment.

• Coil manufacturing or rewind experience.

• Electrical testing knowledge and experience.

• Engineering apprenticeship or equivalent technical qualification.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Sulzer Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Con sede presso il nostro Birmingham Service Centre, lavorerai da una delle strutture più avanzate del suo genere nel Regno Unito. Inaugurato nel 2021 a seguito di un importante investimento, questo Centro di Eccellenza costruito appositamente da 8.000 mq è stato progettato intorno ai principi di produzione magra ed è dotato di tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, capacità di lavorazione avanzate e produzione additiva all'avanguardia.

Funzionamento 24/7, il sito offre soluzioni di manutenzione, riparazione e revisione di livello mondiale per pompe, motori, generatori, compressori, turbine e altre apparecchiature di rotazione critiche in una vasta gamma di settori.

A causa della crescita continua, stiamo cercando un Winder/Fitter esperto per unirsi al nostro team. Come Winder/Fitter, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella riparazione, ristrutturazione, produzione e assemblaggio di apparecchiature e componenti rotanti elettrici, assicurando che tutto il lavoro sia completato in modo sicuro, efficiente e ai massimi standard di qualità.

Le responsabilità chiave includono:

• Eseguire attività di avvolgimento, montaggio e montaggio su una gamma di apparecchiature elettriche.

• Produzione e installazione di bobine e avvolgimento a specifiche.

• Stripping, ispezionare e ricostruire motori, generatori e attrezzature associate.

• Leggere e interpretare disegni di ingegneria e documentazione tecnica.

• Supporta attività di test elettrici e meccanici.

• Identificare guasti e assistere con soluzioni di riparazione.

• Mantenere elevati livelli di qualità, pulizia e sicurezza all'interno del laboratorio.

• Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo e migliori pratiche in tutto il business.
Cosa stiamo cercando

• Esperienza precedente in un ambiente di ingegneria, montaggio, produzione o riparazione.

• Forte attitudine meccanica e abilità pratiche di problem solving.

• Capacità di interpretare disegni di ingegneria e istruzioni tecniche.

• Attenzione ai dettagli con l'impegno di fornire un lavoro di alta qualità.

• Un atteggiamento positivo e la volontà di lavorare come parte di una squadra.

• L'esperienza di avvolgimento del filo sarebbe un vantaggio distinto.

• Esperienza di lavoro su motori, generatori o altre attrezzature rotanti.

• Coil produzione o riavvolgere l'esperienza.

• Conoscenza ed esperienza dei test elettrici.

• Apprendistato di ingegneria o qualifica tecnica equivalente.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Uno stipendio base competitivo

• Programma di bonus a livello aziendale

• Opportunità di straordinario pagate

• 33 giorni di congedo annuale.

• Contributi pensionistici definiti.

• L'accesso a Medicash ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.

• Sostegno confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping più l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.

• Auto personale a noleggio per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.

• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Come titolare del MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Cadet Adult Volunteers con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. SUMMARY:
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or hands on training

• G-Code programming is a plus

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• At least 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Ability to work overtime as required

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

Typical Work Schedule

• 6 A.M - 2 P.M M-F

• Overtime 2 P.M - 4 P.M as Needed

• One Scheduled Weekend On-Call per Month

• One Scheduled Holiday On-Call per Year

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Lead Machine Operator è responsabile della supervisione del funzionamento di macchinari e attrezzature al piano di produzione, garantendo prestazioni ottimali e l'aderenza agli standard di sicurezza e qualità. Questo ruolo fornisce indicazioni per altri operatori di macchine e supporta le attività di risoluzione e manutenzione dei problemi.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a personale di livello professionale che lavora autonomamente e può coordinare le attività di altri personale di livello professionale, soprattutto in situazioni non di routine. SUMMARY:
Installa e gestisce macchine utensili, tra cui HBM, VBM, torni, fresatrici, smerigliatrici ID/OD, piallatrici e fori, senza assistenza, seguendo il manuale di policy e procedure di reparto, per la produzione e la ricondizionatura di componenti per gli standard di cliente, OEM e industria. Interpreta disegni meccanici, progetti, e schizzi ed esegue taglio di metallo di precisione, rettifica, sagomatura e montaggio. Misura componenti, parti e materie prime con strumenti di misura di precisione, manometri e strumenti. Lavori sotto supervisione limitata.

FUNZIONI ESSENTIALI:

• Esegui layout, imposta e gestisce macchine utensili convenzionali come richiesto

• Legge e interpreta tutti i disegni, tra cui dimensionamento geometrico e tolerazione

• Progettare configurazioni e metodi in cui nessuno esiste

• Istruisce il personale di altri negozi in tecniche di lavorazione adeguate

• Migliorare costantemente i metodi per offrire una maggiore qualità con costi migliorati

QUALIFICA:

• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente

• Completamento di un programma di apprendistato macchinista o mani su formazione

• La programmazione G-Code è un plus

• Capacità di tenere tolleranze strette e condurre ispezioni dei componenti

• Capacità dimostrata di impostare in modo efficace tutti, o almeno la maggior parte delle seguenti macchine: I.D./O.D. Grinder, tornio a torre, tornio motore, mulino a ginocchio, trapano radiale, fresatura orizzontale, fresatura verticale e mulino a pianale

• Capacità di eseguire con un minimo di supervisione diretta

• Conoscenza di lavorazione della geometria e dell'applicazione degli utensili

• Conoscenza di funzionamento degli effetti dei mangimi e delle velocità

• Almeno 4 anni di esperienza nei negozi di macchine sull'attrezzatura precedente

• Volontà di lavorare in un ambiente di squadra

• Capacità di lavorare straordinario come richiesto

DEMANDE PHYSICHE

• Durante l'esecuzione dei compiti di questo lavoro, a volte sarebbe richiesto di stare in piedi, camminare, sedersi, raggiungere con mani e braccia, salire o equilibrio, stoop o ginocchio, parlare e sentire, e utilizzare dita e mani per sentire oggetti.

• Capacità di sollevare e/o muoversi fino a 50 libbre

Programma di lavoro tipico

• 6 A.M. - 2 P.M M-F

• Overtime 2 P.M - 4 P.M come necessario

• Un week-end programmato per mese

• Una vacanza programmata su richiesta per anno

Quanto sopra è destinato a descrivere il contenuto generale di, e i requisiti per, le prestazioni di questo lavoro. Non deve essere interpretato come una esaustiva dichiarazione di doveri, responsabilità o requisiti.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto risparmio sanitario corrispondente

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• congedo paterna a pagamento

• Rimborso palestra

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Der Lead Machine Operator ist verantwortlich für die Überwachung des Betriebs von Maschinen und Anlagen auf der Produktionsfläche, um eine optimale Leistung und die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards zu gewährleisten. Einrichtet und betreibt Werkzeugmaschinen, einschließlich HBM, VBM, Drehmaschinen, Fräsmaschinen, ID / OD-Schleifmaschinen, Hobel und Bohrung, ohne Hilfe, nach Abteilungsrichtlinien und Verfahren manuell, um Komponenten nach Kunden-, OEM- und Industriestandards herzustellen und zu überholen. Interpretiert mechanische Zeichnungen, Blaupausen und Skizzen und führt Präzisionsmetallschneiden, Schleifen, Formen und Passen durch. • Führt Layouts durch, richtet ein und betreibt konventionelle Werkzeugmaschinen nach Bedarf

• Lesen und Interpretieren aller Zeichnungen, einschließlich geometrischer Dimensionierung und Tolerierung

• Designs Setups und Methoden, wo es keine gibt

• Leistungsfähigkeit mit einem Minimum an direkter Aufsicht

• Kenntnisse der Werkzeuggeometrie und -anwendung

• Kenntnisse der Auswirkungen von Feeds und Geschwindigkeiten

• Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Maschinenwerkstätten auf den oben genannten Geräten

• Bereitschaft, in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten

• Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf Überstunden zu leisten

jobs.title: Material Handler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Material Handler is responsible for the accurate management, tracking, movement, staging, and distribution of raw materials, components, and finished parts throughout the shop. This position supports production operations by ensuring materials are available when needed, maintaining inventory accuracy, processing material transactions in SAP, and coordinating with production personnel, planners, and coordinators. The Material Handler also transports materials, tools, and equipment between the facility and outside vendors using company vehicles, including trucks and trailers. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Release and issue materials to production jobs in accordance with work orders and manufacturing schedules.

• Track and maintain accurate inventory records for raw materials, components, consumables, and finished parts.

• Process inventory transactions, material movements, and work order activities using SAP.

• Coordinate with Operations, Production Coordinators, Planners, Supervisors, and other departments regarding material requirements and job status.

• Communicate effectively through Outlook email, telephone, and other communication platforms to support shop activities.

• Move, organize, stage, and deliver materials to designated workstations to ensure efficient workflow and uninterrupted production.

• Verify quantities, part numbers, and material specifications before issuing materials to jobs.

• Maintain accurate records of material receipts, transfers, returns, and inventory adjustments.

• Conduct cycle counts and assist with physical inventory activities to ensure inventory accuracy.

• Receive and inspect incoming materials and verify shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and receiving documentation.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, cranes, and other material handling equipment as required.

• Operate company trucks and trailers to transport parts, tools, and materials between company facilities and external vendors.

• Pick up and deliver materials, tooling, and supplies from suppliers and outside service providers as needed.

• Ensure materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, and protected from damage.

• Maintain clean, organized, and safe material storage and staging areas.

• Follow all company safety policies, quality requirements, and operating procedures.

• Assist with continuous improvement initiatives related to inventory control, material flow, and production support.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Experience in material handling, inventory control, warehouse operations, or manufacturing support environments.

• Working knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and general computer applications.

• Ability to read and interpret work orders, inventory records, and production documentation.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

• Ability to operate or become certified on forklifts and other material handling equipment.

• Experience operating trucks and trailers for material transportation.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, and pull materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and reach for extended periods.

• Ability to safely operate forklifts, trucks, trailers, and material handling equipment.

• Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions when making vendor deliveries and pickups.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan incl

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Material Handler is responsible for the accurate management, tracking, movement, staging, and distribution of raw materials, components, and finished parts throughout the shop. This position supports production operations by ensuring materials are available when needed, maintaining inventory accuracy, processing material transactions in SAP, and coordinating with production personnel, planners, and coordinators. The Material Handler also transports materials, tools, and equipment between the facility and outside vendors using company vehicles, including trucks and trailers. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Release and issue materials to production jobs in accordance with work orders and manufacturing schedules.

• Track and maintain accurate inventory records for raw materials, components, consumables, and finished parts.

• Process inventory transactions, material movements, and work order activities using SAP.

• Coordinate with Operations, Production Coordinators, Planners, Supervisors, and other departments regarding material requirements and job status.

• Communicate effectively through Outlook email, telephone, and other communication platforms to support shop activities.

• Move, organize, stage, and deliver materials to designated workstations to ensure efficient workflow and uninterrupted production.

• Verify quantities, part numbers, and material specifications before issuing materials to jobs.

• Maintain accurate records of material receipts, transfers, returns, and inventory adjustments.

• Conduct cycle counts and assist with physical inventory activities to ensure inventory accuracy.

• Receive and inspect incoming materials and verify shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and receiving documentation.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, cranes, and other material handling equipment as required.

• Operate company trucks and trailers to transport parts, tools, and materials between company facilities and external vendors.

• Pick up and deliver materials, tooling, and supplies from suppliers and outside service providers as needed.

• Ensure materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, and protected from damage.

• Maintain clean, organized, and safe material storage and staging areas.

• Follow all company safety policies, quality requirements, and operating procedures.

• Assist with continuous improvement initiatives related to inventory control, material flow, and production support.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Experience in material handling, inventory control, warehouse operations, or manufacturing support environments.

• Working knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and general computer applications.

• Ability to read and interpret work orders, inventory records, and production documentation.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

• Ability to operate or become certified on forklifts and other material handling equipment.

• Experience operating trucks and trailers for material transportation.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, and pull materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and reach for extended periods.

• Ability to safely operate forklifts, trucks, trailers, and material handling equipment.

• Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions when making vendor deliveries and pickups.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan incl

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi

Le machiniste de niveau voyage est responsable de la mise en place et de l'exploitation de l'équipement d'usinage conformément aux politiques et procédures ministérielles. Ce rôle implique la fabrication et le reconditionnement des composants pour répondre aux normes des fabricants et de l'industrie. Ce rôle consiste à utiliser des tours et des moulins à commande manuelle et CNC, et à interpréter des dessins et des croquis mécaniques pour exécuter des travaux de haute qualité. Principales responsabilités :

• Effectue des mises en page, met en place et exploite des machines.

• Lire et interpréter les procédures, les ordres de travail et les dessins techniques pour répondre aux spécifications.

• Appliquer la connaissance des métaux et des alliages, y compris les aciers inoxydables et au carbone.

• Améliore la mise en place et les méthodes pour améliorer la qualité et les coûts.

• Exploiter la grue et les chariots élévateurs en toute sécurité, conformément aux directives du superviseur.

• Exécuter d'autres tâches au besoin.

• Maintenir une présence régulière et fiable.

• Maintient un poste de travail sûr, soigné et ordonné

• Aide au démontage, à l'inspection et au remontage de l'équipement de pompe au besoin

• Communiquer efficacement pour assurer une transition sans heurt entre les membres de l'équipe.

• Appuyer et aider les collègues, y compris la formation et la collaboration.

• Soutient, coopère et participe à un programme de sécurité à l'échelle de l'entreprise qui comprend le respect de toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité

• Soutient et coopère au programme de qualité nucléaire de Sulzer

• Exécute d'autres fonctions selon les affectations

• Heures supplémentaires demandées

• Exploiter des chariots élévateurs, des grues, des ascenseurs homme et des ascenseurs ciseaux

• Achèvement d'un programme d'apprenti machiniste ou d'une formation équivalente.

• Au moins cinq (5) ans d'expérience dans l'usinage.

• Capacité de maintenir des tolérances étroites et d'effectuer l'inspection des composants.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des dessins techniques.

• Compétences mathématiques de base.

• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

jobs.title: CAD CAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sr. Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This role ensures that engineering solutions meet operational, safety, and environmental standards while supporting continuous improvement in plant infrastructure and equipment.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Purpose of the job
Assist CAD Supervisor & Workshop Engineer in providing data related to Reverse Engineering and repair process.

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Perform visual, material & dimensional inspection at workshop or on site for turbomachinery parts as per instruction if needed.

• Provide visual, material & dimensional inspection report if needed.

• Perform 3D scanning process using portable scanner such as Handy scan or CMM portable if needed.

• Coordination with other production department related to machining process for CNC machine, Reverse Engineering process and repair process.

• Review Inspection report related with Reverse Engineering process & repair process.

• Provide 3D model & manufacturing drawing prior to approval.

• Provide CAM program and Machining Jig drawing.

• Maintain measuring tools & CMM portable to ensure they remain fit to use.

• Contribute to the company's LEAN & safety program.

Skills & Qualifications

• Diploma Degree (D-3) in Mechanical Engineering

• Minimum 5 years’ working experience

• Understand about Engineering Technical Drawing Standard

• Understand about Mechanical Engineering Design

• Understand about machining process

• Understand about G-Code

• Understand about CNC machine (4 axis & 5 axis)

• Good communication and cooperation skills

• Fluent in English (verbal and written)

• Able to use measurement tools properly

• Able to use computer technology

• Proficient in MS Office & PDF Tools

• Proficient in CAD Software (Prefer AutoCAD Mechanical & Autodesk Inventor)

• Proficient in CAM Software such as MasterCAM X5 & Siemens NX 1973

What we offer you

• Career Opportunities

• Medical Insurance

• Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: AP Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for supporting the Center of Excellence (CoE) team in managing the daily operations of the accounts payable function, collaborating closely with the local Finance teams in the countries and an external Shared Service Center (DXC). This role will include activities related to invoice processing, supplier queries management, AP aging and the review of payment proposals. The professional is responsible for making sure that AP processes remain aligned and that global process standards are “anchored”. Job Responsibilities

• Invoices/down payment booking.

• AP account reconciliation and reporting.

• Filing and archiving.

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the countries’ Finance team and the external Shared Service Center.

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers.

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the countries’ compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist the BPO provider team (DXC) with the preparation of complex GRNI & Other Month End Accruals.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

• Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and addressing auditor inquiries related to AP processes.

Qualifications

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in accounting, with a focus on Accounts Payable preferred.

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred.

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards with focus on Purchase to Pay processes, policies and best practices.

• Excellent attention to detail; ability to identify errors and inconsistencies

• Good understanding of SAP is a plus.

• Fluent English and local language.

• Good communication skills.

• Good financial analysis and advanced accounting knowledge.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: AR Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The roleis responsible for overseeing the billing process, ensuring the accuracy of invoices and managing the accounts receivable ledger. Job Responsibilities

• Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on service agreements and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in billing details and compliance with contractual terms.

• Review and reconcile billing data for completeness and accuracy, making necessary adjustments or corrections.

• Collaborate with sales, customer service, and project management teams to gather necessary information for billing and to resolve any billing-related issues.

• Maintain and update customer billing information and records in the billing system.

• Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities, and follow up as needed; perform dunning activities where required.

• Assist with the accounts receivable process, including recording payments and updating customer ledgers.

• Perform AR, Revenue & Aging analysis

• Generate and analyze billing reports, providing insights and recommendations to improve the billing process and reduce errors. Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team on this.

Qualifications

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, billing or a similar role.

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred .

• Good communication skills and interpersonal skills at all levels both internally and externally.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition and billing process.

• Proficiency in interpreting billing reports.

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala).

• Proficiency in English.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Wexford site is a centre of excellence for wastewater pump technology, where engineering teams work hands‑on with products that end up protecting communities, infrastructure and the environment worldwide. From early development through to full certification, Wexford plays a pivotal role in turning innovative designs into proven, reliable solutions used by customers across global markets. If you enjoy seeing the real‑world impact of your work, this is a site where engineering truly matters.

As a Test Engineer, you’ll be right at the heart of that journey. Your work directly supports Product Development, Product Introduction and Continuous Technology projects, helping transform design concepts into robust, compliant products used in real‑world wastewater applications. You’ll build deep technical expertise across hydraulic, mechanical, electrical and compliance testing, working closely with local and global development teams. This is a role with real ownership, visible influence on product decisions, and the opportunity to grow your capability as Sulzer continues to invest in advanced testing and future technologies.
What you’ll be doing

• Perform hydraulic performance testing including flow, head, efficiency and NPSH

• Execute mechanical and electrical testing such as vibration, noise and motor performance

• Carry out electrical safety testing (dielectric, insulation resistance, leakage current)

• Test pumps under simulated wastewater conditions, including solids handling, clogging behaviour, wear and lifetime performance

• Project manage global testing requirements for products, aligning test strategies, resources and timelines with international teams

• Conduct performance, safety and compliance testing in line with ISO, EN, IEC, Hydraulic Institute (HI), CSA / UL, IECEEC and FM standards

• Produce regulatory‑compliant test plans, protocols and reports for certification submissions

• Support third‑party audits and inspections, including CSA (SMTC) assessments

• Analyse and interpret test data to identify trends, deviations or non‑conformities

• Investigate test failures, recommend corrective actions and support design improvements

What you bring

• A strong technical foundation in hydraulics, mechanical or electrical engineering

• Experience with test execution, validation or compliance testing in an engineering or manufacturing environment

• A structured, detail‑oriented approach combined with the confidence to work cross‑functionally

• The ability to balance hands‑on testing with documentation, analysis and stakeholder collaboration

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuous professional development

• Genuine opportunities for international mobility and long‑term progression

• Work on globally deployed wastewater technology that delivers real environmental impact

• Access to advanced test facilities and complex, varied engineering challenges

• Be part of a collaborative site with strong links to global engineering and R&D teams

• Build deep technical expertise while shaping future‑ready testing standards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer's Los Angeles Service Center (LASC) is hiring a Repair Coordinator to own the execution of pump repair jobs from order entry through final delivery.
